0What computer vision is, the course map & the exam什么是计算机视觉、课程地图与考试

Slides: W1 Introduction对应讲义：W1 Introduction

Computer vision develops theories and methods that let computers extract relevant information from digital images or videos (CS view) / algorithms and tools that automate perceptual tasks of the human visual system (engineering view). Humans are still better at "hard" tasks (ambiguous data, prior knowledge, continual learning); computers can be better at "easy" tasks (high-quality data, mathematical models, consistent training sets, single applications) — they work day and night, quantitatively, objectively and reproducibly. Human vision also has limitations (brightness, shape and motion illusions). 计算机视觉研究让计算机从数字图像或视频中提取相关信息的理论与方法（计算机科学视角），或自动完成人类视觉系统感知任务的算法与工具（工程视角）。人类仍擅长“难”任务（数据模糊、利用先验知识、持续学习）；计算机在“易”任务上可能更好（高质量数据、数学模型、一致的训练集、单一应用）——可以日夜工作，定量、客观、可复现。人类视觉也有局限（亮度、形状、运动错觉）。

LOW-LEVEL vs HIGH-LEVEL VISION低层视觉 vs 高层视觉
Low-level (image in → image out, mostly image processing): sensing, preprocessing, segmentation, description, labelling. High-level (image in → knowledge out): detection, recognition, classification, interpretation, scene analysis. Workflow: images → measurements → representation → algorithms for learning and inference. 低层（输入图像 → 输出图像，主要是图像处理）：采集、预处理、分割、描述、标记。高层（输入图像 → 输出知识）：检测、识别、分类、解释、场景分析。流程：图像 → 测量 → 表示 → 学习与推断算法。

Why not all deep learning? Deep learning is built on classical ideas (convolution, features, learning); classical methods are data-efficient, compute-efficient and interpretable — essential when labels/compute are scarce or decisions must be explained; real systems are often hybrid.为什么不全用深度学习？深度学习建立在经典思想（卷积、特征、学习）之上；经典方法省数据、省算力、可解释——在标签/算力稀缺或需解释决策时必不可少；实际系统常是混合的。

THE EXAM考试
60% of the course, on campus, closed book; you need ≥ 40% in the exam and ≥ 50% overall. The example questions are all multiple choice, mostly "which statement is incorrect/correct", plus small calculations (connected components, separable-filter operation counts) and "which kernel/algorithm/threshold method" questions. The trap is usually one wrong word (minimise vs maximise, low vs high, smooths vs enhances). Every section below ends with questions in that style. 占总成绩 60%，线下闭卷；考试需 ≥ 40%，总分需 ≥ 50%。样题全部是单选题，大多是“哪项错误/正确”，外加小计算（连通域个数、可分离滤波运算次数）以及“哪个卷积核/算法/阈值方法”类问题。陷阱通常是一个词（最小化 vs 最大化、低 vs 高、平滑 vs 增强）。下面每节末尾都有该风格的练习。

1Image formation: geometry, colour, digitisation图像形成：几何、颜色、数字化

Slides: W1 Image Formation对应讲义：W1 Image Formation

🎯 Pinhole model and projection equations; what projection preserves/loses; vanishing points; perspective vs affine/orthographic projection; radial distortion; colour spaces (RGB, HSV, YCbCr, L*a*b*) and their drawbacks; sampling, resolution, quantisation.🎯 小孔模型与投影方程；投影保留/丢失什么；消失点；透视 vs 仿射/正交投影；径向畸变；颜色空间（RGB、HSV、YCbCr、L*a*b*）及其缺点；采样、分辨率、量化。

Image formation occurs when a sensor registers radiation that has interacted with physical objects. Film alone in front of an object → completely blurred (every object point reaches every film point). Add a barrier with a pinhole (aperture) → each object point maps to one image point. Add a lens → acts like a pinhole but gathers more light.当传感器记录与物体相互作用后的辐射时就形成了图像。只在物体前放胶片 → 完全模糊（每个物点照到胶片每处）。加一块带小孔（光圈）的挡板 → 每个物点映射到唯一像点。再加透镜 → 作用同小孔，但能收集更多光。

1.1 Pinhole camera and projection1.1 小孔相机与投影

PERSPECTIVE PROJECTION透视投影
p=(x,y,z) ↦ p′=(x′,y′,−f)x′=−fzx​,y′=−fzy​​
By similar triangles; ignoring the third coordinate and mirroring: (x′,y′)=(fzx​,fzy​). Far objects appear smaller. Example: x=2,y=3,z=5,f=2⇒x′=−0.8, y′=−1.2.由相似三角形得到；去掉第三个坐标并镜像：(x′,y′)=(fzx​,fzy​)。远处物体看起来更小。例：x=2,y=3,z=5,f=2⇒x′=−0.8, y′=−1.2。

Affine (weak perspective) when scene depth is small relative to the average distance z0​: magnification m=f/z0​, (x′,y′)=(mx,my). Orthographic when m=1: (x′,y′)=(x,y).当场景深度相对平均距离 z0​ 很小时用仿射（弱透视）：放大率 m=f/z0​，(x′,y′)=(mx,my)。m=1 时为正交投影：(x′,y′)=(x,y)。

WHAT PROJECTION LOSES / PRESERVES投影丢失/保留什么
Lost: length, area and angles (parallel and perpendicular lines may not stay so). Preserved: straight lines stay straight. Parallel 3D lines meet in the image at a vanishing point; vanishing points of lines on a plane lie on a vanishing line (e.g. the horizon).丢失：长度、面积和角度（平行、垂直关系不一定保持）。保留：直线仍是直线。三维中的平行线在图像中交于消失点；同一平面上各组平行线的消失点位于一条消失线上（如地平线）。

1.2 Colour and colour spaces1.2 颜色与颜色空间

Cameras imitate the eye's response: three cone types (S, M, L ≈ blue, green, red sensitivity) → RGB images (each channel a digital image of the same size).相机模仿人眼的响应：三类视锥细胞（S、M、L ≈ 对蓝、绿、红敏感）→ RGB 图像（每个通道都是同尺寸的数字图像）。

Space空间Channels通道Use用途Drawback / key fact缺点 / 要点
RGBR, G, Bdefault in vision视觉中的默认channels strongly correlated通道高度相关
HSVHue, Saturation, Value色调、饱和度、明度intuitive; colour selection/manipulation直观；选色/调色channels confounded (H and S meaningless when V or S is low)通道相互混杂（V 或 S 很低时 H、S 无意义）
YCbCrY = brightness (luma), Cb, Cr = chromaY = 亮度，Cb、Cr = 色度fast; compression (reduce Cb/Cr resolution) — TV, JPEG快；压缩（降低 Cb/Cr 分辨率）——电视、JPEG—
L*a*b* (CIELAB)L = lightness, a* = green–red, b* = blue–yellowL = 明度，a* = 绿–红，b* = 蓝–黄"perceptually uniform": Euclidean distances make sense; Photoshop, vision“感知均匀”：欧氏距离有意义；Photoshop、视觉—

1.3 Digitisation: sampling and quantisation1.3 数字化：采样与量化

  • Spatial sampling discretises the coordinates: x=jΔx, y=kΔy on a rectangular grid (Δx,Δy = sampling intervals).空间采样把坐标离散化：在矩形网格上 x=jΔx, y=kΔy（Δx,Δy = 采样间隔）。
  • Spatial resolution = pixels per unit length. Faces are recognisable at 64×64 per face. Too little resolution → poor recognition; too much → slow and wastes memory.空间分辨率 = 单位长度的像素数。人脸在每张 64×64 像素时可识别。分辨率太低 → 识别差；太高 → 慢且浪费内存。
  • Quantisation digitises intensity: gray-level resolution per application; ~100 levels needed for realistic shading; don't use more than necessary. Bits per pixel: 8 bits = 256 levels, 12 = 4,096, 16 = 65,536, 24 = 16,777,216.量化把强度离散化：灰度级数按应用选择；逼真的明暗约需 100 级；不要超过需要。每像素比特数：8 位 = 256 级，12 位 = 4,096，16 位 = 65,536，24 位 = 16,777,216。

Practice — Sections 0–1练习 — 第 0–1 节

(Sample exam) Which statement about colour spaces is incorrect?（样题）关于颜色空间，哪项错误？

  1. The R, G, and B channels of the RGB colour space are often correlated.RGB 的 R、G、B 通道往往相关。
  2. The H and the S channel of the HSV colour space are confounded.HSV 的 H 与 S 通道相互混杂。
  3. The Y channel of the YCbCr colour space represents the brightness.YCbCr 的 Y 通道表示亮度。
  4. The a* channel of the L*a*b* colour space is the green-blue component.L*a*b* 的 a* 通道是绿–蓝分量。
a* is green–red; b* is blue–yellow.a* 是绿–红；b* 是蓝–黄。

Under perspective projection with f=4, a point at (x,y,z)=(2,6,8) projects (ignoring the flip) to…透视投影 f=4，点 (x,y,z)=(2,6,8)（忽略翻转）投影到……

  1. (8, 24)
  2. (1, 3)
  3. (0.5, 1.5)
  4. (2, 6)
x′=4⋅2/8=1, y′=4⋅6/8=3.

Which property is preserved by perspective projection?透视投影保留哪种性质？

  1. Straightness of lines直线仍为直线
  2. Lengths长度
  3. Angles between lines直线间的夹角
  4. Parallelism of lines直线的平行性
Parallel lines may meet at a vanishing point.平行线可能相交于消失点。

When is the affine (weak perspective) model appropriate?何时适合用仿射（弱透视）模型？

  1. When the object is very close to the lens物体离镜头非常近时
  2. When the lens has strong barrel distortion镜头桶形畸变严重时
  3. When scene depth is small relative to the average distance to the camera场景深度相对到相机的平均距离很小时
  4. Only when f=1只有 f=1 时
m=f/z0​ ≈ constant for all points.对所有点近似为常数。

Why is YCbCr popular in JPEG and TV?为什么 JPEG 和电视常用 YCbCr？

  1. It is perceptually uniform它在感知上均匀
  2. It separates brightness from colour, so the chroma channels can be stored at lower resolution它把亮度与颜色分开，色度通道可以用更低分辨率存储
  3. Its channels are uncorrelated by definition按定义通道不相关
  4. It is the colour space of the human cones它是人眼视锥细胞的颜色空间
Perceptual uniformity is L*a*b*.感知均匀的是 L*a*b*。

A 12-bit image can represent how many gray levels?12 位图像能表示多少个灰度级？

  1. 256
  2. 1,024
  3. 65,536
  4. 4,096
212=4096.

Which statement about digitisation is incorrect?关于数字化，哪项错误？

  1. Sampling discretises the spatial coordinates.采样把空间坐标离散化。
  2. Quantisation discretises the intensity values.量化把强度值离散化。
  3. More resolution is always better because it never costs anything.分辨率越高越好，因为没有任何代价。
  4. About 100 gray levels suffice for realistic shading for human perception.约 100 个灰度级足以让人感到逼真的明暗。
Too much resolution is slow and wastes memory.分辨率过高会变慢并浪费内存。

Which is a high-level vision task?哪项是高层视觉任务？

  1. Scene interpretation场景解释
  2. Noise suppression噪声抑制
  3. Image capture and digitisation图像采集与数字化
  4. Contrast enhancement对比度增强
High-level: image in → knowledge out.高层：输入图像 → 输出知识。

2Image processing basics: point operations, thresholding, histograms, arithmetic图像处理基础：点运算、阈值、直方图、算术运算

Slides: W1 Image Processing Basics对应讲义：W1 Image Processing Basics

🎯 Know every point operation and what its curve does; run Otsu / IsoData / Triangle thresholding; derive and compute histogram equalisation; know histogram matching; use arithmetic/logical operations and averaging to reduce noise.🎯 掌握每种点运算及其映射曲线的效果；会用 Otsu / IsoData / 三角法求阈值；推导并计算直方图均衡；了解直方图匹配；会用算术/逻辑运算和平均来降噪。

Image processing = image in → image out (suppress distortions, enhance relevant information); image analysis = image in → measurements out; computer vision = image in → interpretation out. Spatial-domain operations g(x,y)=T[f(x,y)]: point operations (T:R→R, each pixel on its own) vs neighbourhood operations (T:Rn→R, §3). Transform-domain operations (Fourier) in §4.图像处理 = 输入图像 → 输出图像（抑制失真、增强有用信息）；图像分析 = 输入图像 → 输出测量值；计算机视觉 = 输入图像 → 输出解释。空间域运算 g(x,y)=T[f(x,y)]：点运算（T:R→R，逐像素独立）vs 邻域运算（T:Rn→R，§3）。变换域（傅里叶）运算见 §4。

2.1 Point operations (intensity transformations)2.1 点运算（强度变换）

  • Contrast stretching: values below L → black, above H → white, values in [L, H] linearly scaled to the full output range ⇒ higher contrast.对比度拉伸：低于 L → 黑，高于 H → 白，[L, H] 内线性映射到整个输出范围 ⇒ 对比度提高。
  • Intensity thresholding = limiting case of stretching (L = H): produces a binary image (below → black, equal/above → white). Popular for segmentation; works only if object and background intensities differ clearly; result depends strongly on the threshold.强度阈值 = 拉伸的极限情形（L = H）：得到二值图像（低于 → 黑，大于等于 → 白）。常用于分割；仅当目标与背景强度差异明显时有效；结果强烈依赖阈值。
  • Inversion s=L−1−r (e.g. inverted mammograms help detect microcalcifications).反转 s=L−1−r（如反转乳腺 X 光片有助于发现微钙化）。
  • Log s=clog(1+r): maps a narrow range of low gray levels to a wider output range (and compresses high values); compresses dynamic range, e.g. for displaying Fourier spectra.对数 s=clog(1+r)：把窄范围的低灰度映射到更宽的输出范围（压缩高值）；压缩动态范围，如显示傅里叶频谱。
  • Power s=crγ: a family similar to log (γ < 1) and inverse log (γ > 1); gamma correction (many devices respond with a power law); general contrast manipulation.幂次 s=crγ：一族曲线，γ < 1 类似对数，γ > 1 类似反对数；伽马校正（很多设备按幂律响应）；通用的对比度调整。
  • Piecewise linear: fine-tuned, complex shapes, more user input. Includes piecewise contrast stretching and gray-level slicing (highlight a range: binary version, or brighten the range while preserving the rest).分段线性：可精细设计复杂形状，但需要更多用户输入。包括分段对比度拉伸和灰度级切片（突出某一范围：二值版本，或只提亮该范围、保留其他）。
  • Bit-plane slicing: an n-bit image has n bit-planes (151 = 10010111); plane 7 (MSB) carries most structure; useful for compression.位平面切片：n 位图像有 n 个位平面（151 = 10010111）；第 7 平面（最高位）承载大部分结构；可用于压缩。

2.2 Automatic thresholding2.2 自动阈值

OTSU, ISODATA, TRIANGLEOtsu、IsoData、三角法
Otsu: exhaustively search the threshold minimising the intra-class variance σW2​=p0​σ02​+p1​σ12​, equivalently (and much faster) maximising the inter-class varianceOtsu：穷举搜索使类内方差 σW2​=p0​σ02​+p1​σ12​ 最小的阈值，等价地（且快得多）最大化类间方差
σB2​=p0​p1​(μ0​−μ1​)2
(p0​,p1​: fractions of pixels below / at-or-above the threshold; μ: class means.) IsoData: (1) pick a threshold t; (2) compute μ0​,μ1​; (3) t=(μ0​+μ1​)/2; (4) repeat until t stops changing ⇒ threshold midway between the class means. Triangle: draw a line from the histogram peak (rp​,hp​) to the highest gray level point (rm​,hm​); choose the r with maximum distance between the line and the histogram — good when objects are small/bright on a large background (skewed, unimodal-looking histograms). Multilevel thresholding uses several thresholds.（p0​,p1​：低于/不低于阈值的像素比例；μ：类均值。）IsoData：(1) 选初始阈值 t；(2) 计算 μ0​,μ1​；(3) t=(μ0​+μ1​)/2；(4) 重复直到 t 不变 ⇒ 阈值位于两类均值中点。三角法：从直方图峰值 (rp​,hp​) 向最高灰度点 (rm​,hm​) 连线；选使直线与直方图距离最大的 r——适合大背景上的小亮目标（偏斜、看似单峰的直方图）。多级阈值使用多个阈值。
WORKED EXAMPLE例题
Pixel values {1, 2, 2, 3, 7, 8, 8, 9}. IsoData from t = 3 (class 1 = values ≥ t): μ₀ = mean{1,2,2} = 1.67, μ₁ = mean{3,7,8,8,9} = 7 ⇒ t = 4.33; then μ₀ = 2, μ₁ = 8 ⇒ t = 5; unchanged ⇒ t = 5. Otsu at t = 5: p0​=p1​=0.5, σB2​=0.25×(8−2)2=9 (the maximum).像素值 {1, 2, 2, 3, 7, 8, 8, 9}。IsoData 从 t = 3 开始（类 1 = 值 ≥ t）：μ₀ = mean{1,2,2} = 1.67，μ₁ = mean{3,7,8,8,9} = 7 ⇒ t = 4.33；然后 μ₀ = 2，μ₁ = 8 ⇒ t = 5；不再变化 ⇒ t = 5。Otsu 在 t = 5：p0​=p1​=0.5，σB2​=0.25×(8−2)2=9（最大）。

2.3 Histograms, equalisation and matching2.3 直方图、均衡化与匹配

Histogram h(r): number of pixels with gray level r; ∑r​h(r)=N; normalised p(r)=h(r)/N is a probability function. Equalisation: get equally distributed intensities over the full range — increases contrast near histogram maxima and decreases it near minima.直方图 h(r)：灰度为 r 的像素数；∑r​h(r)=N；归一化 p(r)=h(r)/N 是概率函数。均衡化：让强度在整个范围上均匀分布——在直方图峰值附近增加对比度，在谷值附近降低对比度。

HISTOGRAM EQUALISATION直方图均衡化
Want s=T(r), single-valued and monotonically increasing (so T−1 exists) with 0≤T(r)≤L−1. Continuous: ps​(s)=pr​(r)​dsdr​​. Choose the CDF:需要 s=T(r) 单值且单调递增（使 T−1 存在），并满足 0≤T(r)≤L−1。连续情形：ps​(s)=pr​(r)​dsdr​​。选用累积分布函数：
s=T(r)=(L−1)∫0r​pr​(ξ)dξ⇒ drds​=(L−1)pr​(r)⇒ ps​(s)=L−11​ (uniform)​
Discrete:离散：
sk​=T(rk​)=(L−1)j=0∑k​pr​(rj​)=MNL−1​j=0∑k​nj​
For discrete images a single mapping does not give a truly uniform histogram; adaptive approaches (multiple mappings) are needed. Constrained equalisation limits the slope of T(r) (avoids over-enhancing noise).离散图像中单一映射得不到真正均匀的直方图；需要自适应方法（多个映射）。受限均衡化限制 T(r) 的斜率（避免过度放大噪声）。

Dark crowded levels 0–3 get spread to 1–6 (more contrast there); sparse bright levels 4–7 merge into 7.拥挤的暗级 0–3 被拉开到 1–6（这里对比度增大）；稀疏的亮级 4–7 合并到 7。

Histogram matching (specification): get an image with a specified target histogram pz​. Equalise the input: s=T(r); compute the target's equalising function G(z)=(L−1)∫0z​pz​; then z=G−1(s)=G−1(T(r)). Discrete: G(zq​)=(L−1)∑i=0q​pz​(zi​), zq​=G−1(sk​). For colour, match each channel separately.直方图匹配（规定化）：得到具有指定目标直方图 pz​ 的图像。先均衡化输入：s=T(r)；计算目标的均衡化函数 G(z)=(L−1)∫0z​pz​；然后 z=G−1(s)=G−1(T(r))。离散：G(zq​)=(L−1)∑i=0q​pz​(zi​)，zq​=G−1(sk​)。彩色图像对每个通道分别匹配。

2.4 Arithmetic and logical operations; averaging2.4 算术、逻辑运算与平均

Pixel-by-pixel between two images: +, −, ×, /, AND, OR, XOR… Subtraction reveals changes (used later for motion); AND/OR with a mask select regions. Averaging N noisy images fi​=g+ni​ with zero-mean i.i.d. noise of variance σ²:两幅图逐像素运算：+、−、×、/、AND、OR、XOR……减法揭示变化（后面用于运动检测）；与掩膜做 AND/OR 可选取区域。对 N 幅含噪图像 fi​=g+ni​ 取平均（零均值独立同分布噪声，方差 σ²）：

fˉ​=N1​i∑​fi​=g+N1​i∑​ni​Var[N1​i∑​ni​]=Nσ2​ ⇒ noise std=N​σ​​

N = 16 ⇒ σ/4; N = 64 ⇒ σ/8; N = 128 ⇒ σ/11.3.N = 16 ⇒ σ/4；N = 64 ⇒ σ/8；N = 128 ⇒ σ/11.3。

(Sample exam) Which statement about intensity transformations is incorrect?（样题）关于强度变换，哪项错误？

  1. Contrast stretching linearly maps intensities between two values to the full output range.对比度拉伸把两值之间的强度线性映射到整个输出范围。
  2. Log transformation maps a narrow range of high intensities to a wider range of output values.对数变换把窄范围的高强度映射到更宽的输出范围。
  3. Power transformation can map intensities similar to log and inverse log transformations.幂次变换可以实现类似对数和反对数的映射。
  4. Piecewise linear transformations can achieve contrast stretching and intensity slicing.分段线性变换可以实现对比度拉伸和强度切片。
Log expands a narrow range of low intensities (and compresses high ones).对数变换扩展的是窄范围的低强度（并压缩高强度）。

(Sample exam style) An image shows about two dozen small bright algae on a large dark background. Which automatic thresholding method is likely best?（样题风格）图像中约二十几个小亮藻类分布在大片暗背景上。哪种自动阈值方法可能最好？

  1. maximises the intra-class variance使类内方差最大
  2. is the mean of all pixel values是所有像素的均值
  3. maximises the inter-class variance p0​p1​(μ0​−μ1​)2 (equivalently minimises intra-class variance)使类间方差 p0​p1​(μ0​−μ1​)2 最大（等价于类内方差最小）
  4. is midway between the histogram peak and the highest gray level位于直方图峰值与最高灰度之间的中点
(D) resembles the triangle method; IsoData converges to the midpoint of class means.（D）类似三角法；IsoData 收敛到两类均值的中点。

For histogram equalisation, the mapping T(r) is…直方图均衡化中，映射 T(r) 是……

  2. the probability density of rr 的概率密度

Averaging 25 independent noisy images of a static scene reduces the noise standard deviation by a factor of…对静态场景的 25 幅独立含噪图像取平均，噪声标准差缩小为原来的……

Which statement about histogram processing is incorrect?关于直方图处理，哪项错误？

3Neighbourhood operations: convolution, smoothing, median, derivatives, edges邻域运算：卷积、平滑、中值、导数、边缘

Slides: W2 Image Processing Part 1对应讲义：W2 Image Processing Part 1

🎯 Compute a convolution (with flipping); handle borders; list convolution properties; compare uniform, Gaussian and median filters; recognise derivative kernels (finite differences, Prewitt, Sobel, Laplacian) and what they do; count operations for separable filters; detect edges and sharpen.🎯 计算卷积（含翻转）；处理边界；列出卷积性质；比较均值、高斯、中值滤波；识别导数核（有限差分、Prewitt、Sobel、拉普拉斯）及其作用；计算可分离滤波的运算次数；检测边缘与锐化。

3.1 Convolution3.1 卷积

Use the gray values in a small neighbourhood (typically 3×3, 5×5, 7×7, can be other shapes) to compute each output pixel; the weights matrix is the filter/kernel. Depending on the weights, information is suppressed (filtered out) or enhanced.用一个小邻域（通常 3×3、5×5、7×7，也可是其他形状）内的灰度计算每个输出像素；权重矩阵叫滤波器/卷积核。不同权重可以抑制（滤除）或增强信息。

DISCRETE 2D CONVOLUTION二维离散卷积
o(x,y)=i=−n∑n​j=−m∑m​f(x−i,y−j)h(i,j)=k∑​l∑​f(k,l)h(x−k,y−l)​
The kernel is flipped (mirrored). Why? By definition the kernel is the impulse response: convolving an impulse image (1 at the origin) returns h itself; correlation (no flip) returns the flipped kernel h(−x,−y). For symmetric kernels the two are identical.卷积核要翻转（镜像）。为什么？按定义卷积核就是冲激响应：对冲激图像（原点为 1）卷积得到 h 本身；相关（不翻转）得到翻转后的核 h(−x,−y)。对称核两者相同。
EXAMPLE例子
Kernel h=[1  0 −1] along x (index −1, 0, +1). Convolution: o(x)=f(x+1)h(−1)+f(x)h(0)+f(x−1)h(1)=f(x+1)−f(x−1) — a central difference (rising edges → positive). Correlation with the same array would give f(x−1)−f(x+1), the opposite sign.沿 x 的核 h=[1  0 −1]（下标 −1、0、+1）。卷积：o(x)=f(x+1)h(−1)+f(x)h(0)+f(x−1)h(1)=f(x+1)−f(x−1)——中心差分（上升沿为正）。同一数组做相关得到 f(x−1)−f(x+1)，符号相反。
BORDER PROBLEM — expand the image by…边界问题——扩展图像的方法
  • Padding: constant (zero) outside — hard transitions give border artifacts (needs windowing).填充：外部为常数（零）——突变产生边界伪影（需要加窗）。
  • Clamping: repeat border pixels indefinitely — better behaviour but arbitrary.钳位：无限重复边缘像素——效果更好但缺乏理论依据。
  • Wrapping: copy values from the opposite side — implicitly used by the (fast) Fourier transform.环绕：从对侧复制像素值——（快速）傅里叶变换隐式使用。
  • Mirroring: reflect across borders — smooth, symmetric, periodic, no boundary artifacts.镜像：沿边界反射——平滑、对称、周期，无边界伪影。
CONVOLUTION IS LINEAR & SHIFT-INVARIANT; PROPERTIES卷积是线性移不变的；性质
Linearity: a1​f1​+a2​f2​↦a1​g1​+a2​g2​. Shift invariance: shifting the input shifts the output (no position is treated differently).线性：a1​f1​+a2​f2​↦a1​g1​+a2​g2​。移不变：输入平移则输出同样平移（不区分空间位置）。
f1​∗f2​=f2​∗f1​f1​∗(f2​∗f3​)=(f1​∗f2​)∗f3​f1​∗(f2​+f3​)=f1​∗f2​+f1​∗f3​​
a⋅(f1​∗f2​)=(af1​)∗f2​=f1​∗(af2​)(f1​∗f2​)′=f1′​∗f2​=f1​∗f2′​f1​∗f2​ ↔ f^​1​⋅f^​2​​
Note a(f∗g)=(af)∗(ag) (that would give a2).注意 a(f∗g)=(af)∗(ag)（那会得到 a2）。

3.2 Smoothing: uniform, Gaussian, median3.2 平滑：均值、高斯、中值

  • Uniform (mean) filter: g=N1​∑(i,j)∈N​f(x+i,y+j), kernel 91​13×3​, 251​15×5​… Reduces noise but blurs edges; weighted averaging possible.均值滤波：g=N1​∑(i,j)∈N​f(x+i,y+j)，核 91​13×3​、251​15×5​…… 降噪但模糊边缘；也可加权平均。
  • Gaussian filter gσ​(x,y)=2πσ21​e−2σ2x2+y2​. Nice properties: the only filter both separable and circularly symmetric; optimal joint localisation in space and frequency; its Fourier transform is a Gaussian; the n-fold convolution of any low-pass filter converges to a Gaussian; infinitely smooth (differentiate to any order); scales naturally with σ (scale-space).高斯滤波 gσ​(x,y)=2πσ21​e−2σ2x2+y2​。优良性质：唯一同时可分离且圆对称的滤波器；空间与频率联合定位最优；其傅里叶变换仍是高斯；任何低通滤波器多次自卷积都趋于高斯；无限光滑（可任意阶求导）；随 σ 自然缩放（尺度空间）。
  • Median filter (order-statistics, nonlinear, not a convolution): output = middle value of the sorted neighbourhood (e.g. {115,10,25,12,221,46,91,178,193} → sorted, median 91). Eliminates isolated spikes (salt-and-pepper noise) and clusters with area < n²/2 — noise pixels are removed rather than averaged. Min/max filters take the min/max instead.中值滤波（顺序统计、非线性、不是卷积）：输出 = 邻域排序后的中间值（如 {115,10,25,12,221,46,91,178,193} → 排序后中值为 91）。消除孤立尖峰（椒盐噪声）和面积 < n²/2 的像素簇——噪声像素被去除而非被平均。取最小/最大值则为最小/最大值滤波。

Unsharp masking: sharpened = input + a·(input − Gaussian-filtered input) (add back the high frequencies). Pooling: filtering + downsampling in one step (max/min/median/average, e.g. 2×2 stride 2), popular in CNNs.反锐化掩模：锐化 = 输入 + a·(输入 − 高斯滤波后的输入)（把高频加回去）。池化：一步完成滤波 + 下采样（最大/最小/中值/平均，如 2×2 步长 2），CNN 中常用。

3.3 Derivative filters3.3 导数滤波器

Approximation近似Kernel (remember: flipped in convolution)卷积核（注意卷积时会翻转）
forward前向f(x+1)−f(x)[1 −1]
backward后向f(x)−f(x−1)[1 −1]
central中心2f(x+1)−f(x−1)​½[1 0 −1]
2nd derivative二阶导数f(x+1)−2f(x)+f(x−1)[1 −2 1]
  • Gaussian derivative filters gx​,gy​,gxx​,gyy​: differentiate the Gaussian ⇒ smoothing and differentiation at a chosen scale σ (larger σ ⇒ coarser edges, less noise).高斯导数滤波 gx​,gy​,gxx​,gyy​：对高斯求导 ⇒ 在选定尺度 σ 上同时平滑与求导（σ 越大 ⇒ 边缘越粗、噪声越少）。
  • Gradient ∇f=(fx​,fy​): points in the direction of steepest intensity increase, orthogonal to isophotes; magnitude ∣∇f∣=fx2​+fy2​​ = strength of local change. Edges = thresholded local maxima of ∣∇f∣, or zero-crossings of ∇2f.梯度 ∇f=(fx​,fy​)：指向强度增长最快的方向，与等照度线正交；幅值 ∣∇f∣=fx2​+fy2​​ = 局部变化强度。边缘 = ∣∇f∣ 局部极大值再阈值化，或 ∇2f 的过零点。
  • In Fourier, the n-th derivative multiplies by (iω)n: suppresses low frequencies but blows up high frequencies (noise) ⇒ always smooth before/with differentiating.在傅里叶域，n 阶导数乘以 (iω)n：抑制低频却放大高频（噪声）⇒ 求导前/时必须先平滑。
  • Sharpening with the Laplacian: f−∇2f.拉普拉斯锐化：f−∇2f。

3.4 Separable filters — big savings3.4 可分离滤波——大幅节省计算

Uniform, Prewitt, Sobel and Gaussian kernels are outer products of 1D kernels, e.g. 161​​121​242​121​​=41​[1,2,1]T⋅41​[1,2,1]. Filter rows with the 1D kernel, then columns.均值、Prewitt、Sobel 和高斯核都是一维核的外积，如 161​​121​242​121​​=41​[1,2,1]T⋅41​[1,2,1]。先用一维核滤行，再滤列。

OPERATION COUNT FOR A K×K KERNEL (per pixel)K×K 核的运算次数（每像素）
Non-separated: K2 multiplications + K2−1 additions = 2K2−1. Separated: 2 passes × (K mult + K−1 add) = 4K−2.不分离：K2 次乘法 + K2−1 次加法 = 2K2−1。分离：2 趟 × （K 次乘 + K−1 次加）= 4K−2。
3×3: 17 vs 10. 5×5: 49 vs 18 ⇒ S/N = 18/49 = 36.7%. 7×7: 97 vs 26. Even bigger gains for larger kernels and 3D images.3×3：17 vs 10。5×5：49 vs 18 ⇒ S/N = 18/49 = 36.7%。7×7：97 vs 26。核越大、三维图像收益越大。

(Sample exam) What is the effect of the kernel [0 1 0; 1 −4 1; 0 1 0]?（样题）卷积核 [0 1 0; 1 −4 1; 0 1 0] 的作用是？

  1. Approximates the sum of first-order derivatives in x and y近似 x、y 一阶导数之和
  2. Approximates the sum of second-order derivatives in x and y近似 x、y 二阶导数之和
  3. Approximates the product of first-order derivatives近似一阶导数之积
  4. Approximates the product of second-order derivatives近似二阶导数之积
Laplacian = [1 −2 1] in x plus [1 −2 1] in y.拉普拉斯 = x 向 [1 −2 1] 加 y 向 [1 −2 1]。

(Sample exam) What does the kernel [1 0 −1; 2 0 −2; 1 0 −1] do?（样题）卷积核 [1 0 −1; 2 0 −2; 1 0 −1] 的作用是？

  2. Smoothing in x and second-order differentiation in yx 向平滑、y 向二阶求导
  3. First-order differentiation in x and smoothing in yx 向一阶求导、y 向平滑
  4. Second-order differentiation in x and smoothing in yx 向二阶求导、y 向平滑
Rows are [1 0 −1] (derivative along x); columns are [1 2 1] (smoothing along y): Sobel sx​.行为 [1 0 −1]（沿 x 求导）；列为 [1 2 1]（沿 y 平滑）：Sobel sx​。

(Sample exam) Which equation about convolution is correct?（样题）关于卷积哪个等式正确？

  1. f∗g=(g∗f)−1

Distributivity. (A): commutative, no inverse; (C) gives a2; (D): convolution ↔ product of spectra.分配律。（A）应是交换律，无逆；（C）得到 a2；（D）卷积 ↔ 频谱相乘。

Which statement about the median filter is incorrect?关于中值滤波，哪项错误？

  1. It removes salt-and-pepper noise.能去除椒盐噪声。
  2. It is a nonlinear, order-statistics filter.是非线性的顺序统计滤波。
  3. It removes pixel clusters smaller than about half the window area.能去除小于窗口面积约一半的像素簇。

🎯 Explain what frequencies mean in images; write the (D)FT and its key properties (convolution theorem!); follow the 6-step frequency filtering procedure; know low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, Gaussian and DoG filters; build and reconstruct image pyramids.🎯 解释图像中“频率”的含义；写出（离散）傅里叶变换及关键性质（卷积定理！）；掌握 6 步频域滤波流程；了解低通、高通、带通、陷波、高斯与 DoG 滤波；构建并重建图像金字塔。

4.1 Fourier's idea4.1 傅里叶的思想

Fourier (1807): any (well-behaved) function can be written as a weighted sum of sines and cosines of different frequencies: building blocks fi​(x)=ai​sin(ωi​x+ϕi​) with amplitude ai​, radial frequency ωi​, phase ϕi​ (Fourier series; square and sawtooth waves approximated by adding terms). Spatial domain: pixels themselves. Frequency domain: related to the rate of change of intensity. High frequencies = rapidly changing intensities (edges, fine detail, noise); low frequencies = large-scale structures; F(0,0) = total intensity of the image.傅里叶（1807）：任何（性质良好的）函数都能写成不同频率的正弦与余弦的加权和：基本单元 fi​(x)=ai​sin(ωi​x+ϕi​)，振幅 ai​、角频率 ωi​、相位 ϕi​（傅里叶级数；方波、锯齿波可通过叠加逼近）。空间域：像素本身。频率域：与强度的变化速率相关。高频 = 快速变化的强度（边缘、细节、噪声）；低频 = 大尺度结构；F(0,0) = 图像总强度。

DEFINITIONS定义
F(u)=∫−∞∞​f(x)e−i2πuxdxf(x)=∫−∞∞​F(u)ei2πuxdu​
F(u,v)=x=0∑M−1​y=0∑N−1​f(x,y)e−i2π(Mux​+Nvy​)f(x,y)=MN1​u,v∑​F(u,v)ei2π(Mux​+Nvy​)​
eiωx=cosωx+isinωx, ω=2πu. F=R+iI; magnitude ∣F∣=R2+I2​, phase Φ=arctan(I/R). The DFT and its inverse always exist. A real image has a conjugate-symmetric transform: F(−u,−v)=F∗(u,v) (e.g. cos(2πax)↔21​[δ(u−a)+δ(u+a)]).eiωx=cosωx+isinωx，ω=2πu。F=R+iI；幅值 ∣F∣=R2+I2​，相位 Φ=arctan(I/R)。DFT 及其逆变换总是存在。实值图像的变换共轭对称：F(−u,−v)=F∗(u,v)（如 cos(2πax)↔21​[δ(u−a)+δ(u+a)]）。
Property性质Spatial空间域Frequency频率域
Superposition叠加f1​+f2​F1​+F2​
Translation平移f(x−Δx)F(u)e−i2πuΔx

Correlation相关f⊗hF⋅H∗

4.2 Frequency-domain filtering4.2 频域滤波

Each F(u,v) depends on all pixels; Fourier images are usually centred for visualisation and processing — multiply the image by (−1)x+y (translation property with u0​=M/2,v0​=N/2).每个 F(u,v) 都依赖于所有像素；傅里叶图像通常要中心化以便显示和处理——把图像乘以 (−1)x+y（平移性质，u0​=M/2,v0​=N/2）。

THE 6-STEP PROCEDURE6 步流程
  1. Multiply f(x,y) by (−1)x+y (centring).把 f(x,y) 乘以 (−1)x+y（中心化）。
  2. Compute F(u,v) with the 2D DFT.用二维 DFT 计算 F(u,v)。
  3. Multiply by a centred filter: G=F⋅H.乘以中心化的滤波器：G=F⋅H。
  4. Inverse 2D DFT of G.对 G 做二维逆 DFT。
  5. Take the real part (imaginary part ≈ 0).取实部（虚部 ≈ 0）。
  6. Multiply by (−1)x+y again.再乘以 (−1)x+y。
  • Low-pass: keep low, attenuate high frequencies ⇒ blurred image (noise reduced).低通：保留低频、衰减高频 ⇒ 图像模糊（噪声减少）。
  • High-pass: keep high, attenuate low ⇒ edges and fine details enhanced (it does not smooth them).高通：保留高频、衰减低频 ⇒ 边缘和细节被增强（不会平滑它们）。
  • Band-pass: keep a band of frequencies.带通：保留某一频带。
  • Notch: remove (notch reject) or isolate (notch pass) specific frequencies — e.g. periodic scan-line artifacts in a satellite image.陷波：去除（陷波阻）或单独提取（陷波通）特定频率——如卫星图像中周期性的扫描线伪影。

Why use the frequency domain? By the convolution theorem, filtering can be computationally more efficient (FFT for large kernels) and filter design is often more intuitive; take the inverse transform to get the spatial filter.为什么用频率域？由卷积定理，滤波可以计算更高效（大核时用 FFT），且滤波器设计往往更直观；对其做逆变换即得空间滤波器。

GAUSSIAN ↔ GAUSSIAN; DIFFERENCE OF GAUSSIANS高斯 ↔ 高斯；高斯差分
h(x)=2π​σ1​e−2σ2x2​↔ H(u)=e−2π2σ2u2​
A wide Gaussian in space (large σ) is a narrow low-pass in frequency, and vice versa. DoG =a1​h(x;σ1​)−a2​h(x;σ2​) ⇒ a1​H(u;σ1​)−a2​H(u;σ2​): a high-/band-pass filter that approximates an inverted Laplacian (also used by SIFT).空间中宽的高斯（σ 大）在频率中是窄的低通，反之亦然。DoG =a1​h(x;σ1​)−a2​h(x;σ2​) ⇒ a1​H(u;σ1​)−a2​H(u;σ2​)：近似反转拉普拉斯的高通/带通滤波器（SIFT 也用到）。

4.3 Multiresolution: image pyramids4.3 多分辨率：图像金字塔

Small objects and fine details need high resolution; large objects can make do with low resolution; if both are present, use multiple resolutions. Downsampling loses high frequencies (aliasing if not filtered first).小目标和细节需要高分辨率；大目标低分辨率即可；两者都有时用多分辨率。下采样会丢失高频（不先滤波会混叠）。

  1. Compute an approximation: filter and downsample the input.计算近似：对输入滤波并下采样。
  2. Predict: upsample the approximation and filter (interpolate).预测：把近似上采样并滤波（插值）。
  3. Residual = input − prediction.残差 = 输入 − 预测。

Repeating gives an approximation pyramid and a prediction-residual pyramid (Laplacian-like). Reconstruction: upsample and filter the lowest-resolution approximation, add the next-higher residual, repeat.重复得到近似金字塔与预测残差金字塔（类似拉普拉斯金字塔）。重建：把最低分辨率近似上采样并滤波，加上高一层的残差，重复。

Practice — Section 4练习 — 第 4 节

(Sample exam) Which statement on image filtering is incorrect?（样题）关于图像滤波，哪项错误？

  1. Median filtering reduces noise in images.中值滤波减少噪声。
  2. Low-pass filtering results in blurry images.低通滤波使图像模糊。
  3. High-pass filtering smooths fine details in images.高通滤波平滑图像细节。
  4. Notch filtering removes specific image frequencies.陷波滤波去除特定频率。
High-pass keeps/enhances fine details; it removes smooth (low-frequency) content.高通保留/增强细节；它去除的是平滑（低频）内容。

Why is the image multiplied by (−1)x+y before the DFT?为什么做 DFT 前要把图像乘以 (−1)x+y？

  1. To centre the spectrum (shift F by M/2, N/2) so low frequencies are in the middle使频谱中心化（F 平移 M/2、N/2），低频位于中间
  2. To remove the imaginary part去掉虚部
  3. To normalise intensities归一化强度
  4. To make the filter separable让滤波器可分离
Translation property: f(x,y)ei2π(u0​x/M+v0​y/N)↔F(u−u0​,v−v0​).平移性质：f(x,y)ei2π(u0​x/M+v0​y/N)↔F(u−u0​,v−v0​)。

The value F(0,0) of an image's DFT equals…图像 DFT 的 F(0,0) 等于……

  1. the highest frequency最高频率
  2. the phase at the origin原点处的相位
  3. the noise level噪声水平
  4. the total intensity (sum of all pixels)总强度（所有像素之和）
Set u = v = 0: every exponential is 1.令 u = v = 0：所有指数项为 1。

Convolving an image with a large kernel can be faster in the Fourier domain because…用大卷积核时在傅里叶域更快，因为……

  1. the Fourier transform removes noise傅里叶变换去除噪声
  2. convolution becomes a pointwise multiplication of the spectra卷积变成频谱的逐点相乘
  3. convolution becomes addition卷积变成加法
  4. the DFT has no boundary problemDFT 没有边界问题
(It does have one: it implicitly wraps.)（其实有：它隐式环绕。）

A Difference-of-Gaussians filter acts as…高斯差分（DoG）滤波器相当于……

  1. a pure low-pass filter纯低通滤波器
  2. a median filter中值滤波器
  3. a high-/band-pass filter approximating an inverted Laplacian近似反转拉普拉斯的高通/带通滤波器
  4. a notch filter陷波滤波器
Subtracting two low-passes leaves a band of frequencies.两个低通相减剩下一个频带。

Increasing σ of a Gaussian in the spatial domain makes its Fourier transform…增大空间域高斯的 σ，其傅里叶变换会……

  1. narrower (stronger low-pass, more blur)变窄（低通更强，更模糊）
  2. wider变宽
  3. unchanged不变
  4. a high-pass filter变成高通
H(u)=e−2π2σ2u2.

How is an image reconstructed from its approximation and residual pyramids?如何从近似金字塔和残差金字塔重建图像？

  1. Average all levels对所有层取平均
  2. Take the highest-resolution approximation only只取最高分辨率的近似
  3. Multiply residuals together把残差相乘
  4. Upsample+filter the coarsest approximation, add the next residual, repeat把最粗近似上采样并滤波，加下一层残差，重复
Residual = input − prediction, so prediction + residual = input exactly.残差 = 输入 − 预测，所以预测 + 残差 = 输入（精确）。

Periodic horizontal stripes in a satellite image are best removed by…卫星图像中的周期性水平条纹最好用什么去除？

  1. histogram equalisation直方图均衡化
  2. a notch-reject filter in the Fourier domain傅里叶域的陷波阻滤波器
  3. a Sobel filterSobel 滤波
  4. bit-plane slicing位平面切片
Periodic patterns concentrate at a few frequency peaks.周期图案集中在少数几个频率峰上。

5Feature representation I: colour features, Haralick, LBP, SIFT, matching & alignment特征表示 I：颜色特征、Haralick、LBP、SIFT、匹配与配准

Slides: W3 Feature Representation Part 1对应讲义：W3 Feature Representation Part 1

🎯 Explain why features (not raw pixels) and the desirable properties; compute colour histogram/moments; build a GLCM and know Haralick descriptors; compute an LBP code (incl. rotation-invariant version); describe the 4 SIFT stages and the 128-D descriptor; match with NNDR; fit transformations by least squares and RANSAC.🎯 解释为何用特征（而非原始像素）及特征应有的性质；计算颜色直方图/颜色矩；构建 GLCM 并了解 Haralick 描述子；计算 LBP 编码（含旋转不变版本）；描述 SIFT 四个阶段与 128 维描述子；用 NNDR 匹配；用最小二乘和 RANSAC 拟合变换。

5.1 Why features?5.1 为什么需要特征？

Image features are compact vectors representing important information (blobs, edges, corners, ridges, circles, lines…), used for detection, segmentation, classification, retrieval, stitching, tracking. Raw pixels are a bad representation: they change with lighting, colour, viewing angle and camera orientation, and are highly redundant (1000×1000×3 = 3 million values).图像特征是表示重要信息（斑点、边缘、角点、脊线、圆、直线…）的紧凑向量，用于检测、分割、分类、检索、拼接、跟踪。原始像素是糟糕的表示：随光照、颜色、视角、相机朝向而变，并且高度冗余（1000×1000×3 = 300 万个值）。

DESIRABLE PROPERTIES理想性质
Reproducibility (robustness): similar points in different images get similar features despite illumination/viewpoint changes. Saliency (descriptiveness): distinct from surroundings. Compactness (efficiency): fewer and smaller features.可重复性（鲁棒性）：不同图像中的相似点即使光照/视角变化也得到相似特征。显著性（描述力）：与周围有区别。紧凑性（效率）：特征更少、更小。

5.2 Colour features5.2 颜色特征

Simplest to compute; invariant to scaling, translation and rotation (e.g. colour-based image retrieval). Colour histogram: one histogram per channel, concatenated [r0​..r255​,g0​..g255​,b0​..b255​] — the global distribution of colours. Colour moments per channel i (fij​ = value of channel i at pixel j):最易计算；对缩放、平移、旋转不变（如基于颜色的图像检索）。颜色直方图：每个通道一个直方图再拼接 [r0​..r255​,g0​..g255​,b0​..b255​]——颜色的全局分布。颜色矩（第 i 通道，fij​ = 像素 j 在通道 i 的值）：

μi​=N1​j∑​fij​σi​=(N1​j∑​(fij​−μi​)2)1/2si​=(N1​j∑​(fij​−μi​)3)1/3​

Mean, standard deviation, skewness ⇒ only 9 numbers for RGB — compact but with lower representation capability than the histogram.均值、标准差、偏度 ⇒ RGB 只有 9 个数——紧凑，但表示能力低于直方图。

5.3 Texture: Haralick features from the GLCM5.3 纹理：基于 GLCM 的 Haralick 特征

Texture = visual patterns with homogeneity that can't come from a single colour/intensity. Haralick features capture the spatial relationship between neighbouring pixels in two steps:纹理 = 具有同质性、无法由单一颜色/强度产生的视觉模式。Haralick 特征分两步刻画相邻像素间的空间关系：

  1. Build the gray-level co-occurrence matrix P(d,a)​(i1​,i2​): how often intensity i2​ occurs at distance d and orientation a from intensity i1​ (a is un-directional, so count both directions ⇒ symmetric). L levels ⇒ L×L matrix; reduce L by binning for efficiency; different (d, a) give different GLCMs.构建灰度共生矩阵 P(d,a)​(i1​,i2​)：强度 i1​ 在距离 d、方向 a 处出现强度 i2​ 的次数（a 不分正反，两个方向都计 ⇒ 对称）。L 个灰度级 ⇒ L×L 矩阵；可通过分箱减小 L；不同的 (d, a) 得到不同的 GLCM。
  2. The GLCM itself isn't a convenient descriptor ⇒ compute Haralick descriptors from it (one set per (d, a)), e.g. angular second moment/energy ∑p2, contrast ∑(i−j)2p, correlation, homogeneity ∑1+∣i−j∣p​, entropy −∑plogp.GLCM 本身不便直接当描述子 ⇒ 从中计算 Haralick 描述子（每个 (d, a) 一组），如角二阶矩/能量 ∑p2、对比度 ∑(i−j)2p、相关性、同质性 ∑1+∣i−j∣p​、熵 −∑plogp。
GLCM EXAMPLE (d = 1, a = 0°, symmetric)GLCM 例子（d = 1，a = 0°，对称）
Image (L = 3):图像（L = 3）：
001
012
122
Horizontal pairs: (0,0), (0,1), (0,1), (1,2), (1,2), (2,2). Count each pair both ways:水平相邻对：(0,0)、(0,1)、(0,1)、(1,2)、(1,2)、(2,2)。每对两个方向都计数：
012
0220
1202
2022
(0,0) appears once but counts 2 on the diagonal because both directions are counted. Often used in medical imaging for simplicity and interpretability (e.g. prostate MRI Gleason grading with kNN).(0,0) 只出现一次，但因两个方向都计，对角线上记为 2。因简单可解释常用于医学影像（如前列腺 MRI 的 Gleason 分级，配合 kNN）。

5.4 Local Binary Patterns (LBP)5.4 局部二值模式（LBP）

  1. Divide the image into cells (e.g. 16×16 or 32×32).把图像分成单元格（如 16×16 或 32×32）。
  2. For each pixel, compare with its 8 neighbours ⇒ an 8-bit number 0…255.每个像素与 8 个邻居比较 ⇒ 0…255 的 8 位数。
  3. Histogram the codes in each cell (256 bins); concatenate the cell histograms ⇒ image-level LBP descriptor.统计每个单元格中编码的直方图（256 个箱）；拼接各单元格直方图 ⇒ 图像级 LBP 描述子。

Multiresolution: vary the radius and the number of neighbours. Rotation-invariant: circularly bit-shift the code and take the smallest value (10110100 → min over shifts = 00101101 = 45); this reduces 256 patterns to 36 (some patterns have fewer than 8 distinct shifts, e.g. 11001100 has 4).多分辨率：改变半径和邻居个数。旋转不变：对编码循环移位并取最小值（10110100 → 各移位最小值 = 00101101 = 45）；把 256 种模式减少到 36 种（有些模式不足 8 种不同移位，如 11001100 只有 4 种）。

5.5 SIFT (Lowe 2004)5.5 SIFT（Lowe 2004）

Describes texture in a local region around a keypoint; invariant to scale, rotation, shift and robust to affine distortion and illumination changes.描述关键点周围局部区域的纹理；对尺度、旋转、平移不变，对仿射畸变与光照变化鲁棒。

  1. Scale-space extrema detection: L(x,y,σ)=I∗G(σ); D(x,y,σ)=L(x,y,kσ)−L(x,y,σ) (Difference of Gaussians, fixed factor k); candidate keypoints = local max/min across space and scale ⇒ scale invariance.尺度空间极值检测：L(x,y,σ)=I∗G(σ)；D(x,y,σ)=L(x,y,kσ)−L(x,y,σ)（高斯差分，固定因子 k）；在空间和尺度上的局部极大/极小为候选关键点 ⇒ 尺度不变。
  2. Keypoint localisation: 3D quadratic fit for sub-pixel optima; reject low-contrast points and edge responses (Hessian analysis).关键点定位：三维二次拟合得到亚像素极值；剔除低对比度点和边缘响应（Hessian 分析）。
  3. Orientation assignment: histogram of local gradient orientations; the dominant orientation (main peak) becomes the keypoint's orientation ⇒ rotation invariance; a second keypoint is created for any other peak > 80% of the max.方向分配：局部梯度方向直方图；主方向（最高峰）作为关键点方向 ⇒ 旋转不变；其他峰值 > 最大值 80% 时再创建一个关键点。
  4. Descriptor: at the keypoint's scale, a 4×4 array of gradient-orientation histograms with 8 bins each, weighted by magnitude (relative to the dominant orientation) ⇒ 128-D vector.描述子：在关键点尺度上，4×4 个子区域的梯度方向直方图，每个 8 个箱，按梯度幅值加权（相对主方向）⇒ 128 维向量。
DESCRIPTOR MATCHING — nearest neighbour distance ratio描述子匹配——最近邻距离比
NNDR=d2​d1​​=∥DA​−DC​∥∥DA​−DB​∥​reject the match if NNDR>0.8​
d1​, d2​: distances to the 1st and 2nd nearest neighbours in 128-D space. Ambiguous matches (two similar candidates) have NNDR ≈ 1. E.g. d1​=0.3,d2​=0.5 ⇒ 0.6 accept; d1​=0.45,d2​=0.5 ⇒ 0.9 reject.d1​、d2​：在 128 维空间中到最近和次近邻的距离。模糊匹配（两个相似候选）的 NNDR ≈ 1。例：d1​=0.3,d2​=0.5 ⇒ 0.6 接受；d1​=0.45,d2​=0.5 ⇒ 0.9 拒绝。

5.6 Spatial transformations and fitting (image stitching)5.6 空间变换与拟合（图像拼接）

Stitching: find SIFT keypoints in both images → match → find the right spatial transformation. Rigid: translation, rotation. Non-rigid: scaling, affine, perspective. In homogeneous coordinates:拼接：在两幅图中找 SIFT 关键点 → 匹配 → 求出合适的空间变换。刚性：平移、旋转。非刚性：缩放、仿射、透视。齐次坐标下：

translate​100​010​tx​ty​1​​rotate[cosαsinα​−sinαcosα​]affine​ad0​be0​cf1​​perspective​adg​beh​cfi​​​
LEAST-SQUARES FITTING最小二乘拟合
Find parameters p minimising E=∑i​∥T(xi​;p)−xi′​∥2. For affine (or translation) T this is linear: Ap=b⇒求使 E=∑i​∥T(xi​;p)−xi′​∥2 最小的参数 p。仿射（或平移）时为线性问题：Ap=b⇒
p=(ATA)−1ATb
Translation example: each match gives rows [1 0][tx​,ty​]T=xiB​−xiA​ and [0 1][tx​,ty​]T=yiB​−yiA​ ⇒ LS solution = mean displacement.平移例子：每对匹配给出 [1 0][tx​,ty​]T=xiB​−xiA​ 与 [0 1][tx​,ty​]T=yiB​−yiA​ 两行 ⇒ 最小二乘解 = 平均位移。
RANSAC (RANdom SAmple Consensus)RANSAC（随机抽样一致）
LS is hampered by outliers (wrong matches). RANSAC: (1) randomly sample the minimum number of points needed to fit the model (2 for a line, 1 match for translation); (2) solve for the model parameters; (3) score by the fraction of inliers within a threshold δ. Repeat; keep the best model (optionally refit with LS on its inliers).最小二乘会被离群点（错误匹配）带偏。RANSAC：(1) 随机抽取拟合模型所需的最少点数（直线 2 点，平移 1 对匹配）；(2) 求解模型参数；(3) 以阈值 δ 内内点比例打分。重复多次，保留最佳模型（可再用其内点做最小二乘精化）。

Practice — Section 5练习 — 第 5 节

(Sample exam) Which statement about feature descriptors is incorrect?（样题）关于特征描述子，哪项错误？

  1. Haralick features are derived from gray-level co-occurrence matrices.Haralick 特征由灰度共生矩阵导出。
  2. SIFT achieves rotation invariance by computing gradient histograms at multiple scales.SIFT 通过在多个尺度上计算梯度直方图实现旋转不变。
  3. LBP describes local image texture and can be multiresolution and rotation-invariant.LBP 描述局部纹理，可以多分辨率且旋转不变。
  4. Colour moments have lower representation capability than the colour histogram.颜色矩的表示能力低于颜色直方图。
Rotation invariance comes from orientation assignment (dominant gradient orientation); multiple scales give scale invariance.旋转不变来自方向分配（主梯度方向）；多尺度带来的是尺度不变。

How many elements does a SIFT descriptor have, and why?SIFT 描述子有多少维？为什么？

  1. 64 = 8×8 pixels64 = 8×8 像素
  2. 256 = all LBP codes256 = 所有 LBP 码
  3. 128 = 4×4 cells × 8 orientation bins128 = 4×4 个单元 × 8 个方向箱
  4. 9 = 3 moments × 3 channels9 = 3 阶矩 × 3 通道
(D) is colour moments.（D）是颜色矩。

Centre pixel 50 with neighbours (clockwise from top-left) 60, 40, 50, 70, 20, 30, 55, 45. Using "neighbour ≥ centre → 1", the LBP code is…中心像素 50，邻居（从左上角顺时针）60、40、50、70、20、30、55、45。按“邻居 ≥ 中心 → 1”，LBP 码为……

  1. 10110010 (178)
  2. 01001101 (77)
  3. 10010010 (146)
  4. 11110000 (240)
60→1, 40→0, 50→1, 70→1, 20→0, 30→0, 55→1, 45→0 ⇒ 10110010 = 128+32+16+2 = 178.

Making LBP rotation-invariant by taking the minimum over circular bit shifts reduces the number of patterns from 256 to…通过对循环移位取最小值使 LBP 旋转不变，模式数从 256 降到……

  1. 8
  2. 32
  3. 59
  4. 36
As stated in the lecture (36 rotation-invariant classes).见讲义（36 个旋转不变类）。

In SIFT matching, the best match is at distance 0.40 and the second best at 0.44. With the usual rule, the match is…SIFT 匹配中，最佳匹配距离 0.40，次佳 0.44。按通常规则，该匹配……

  1. accepted (distance is small)接受（距离很小）
  2. rejected (NNDR ≈ 0.91 > 0.8)拒绝（NNDR ≈ 0.91 > 0.8）
  3. accepted (NNDR < 1)接受（NNDR < 1）
  4. undecidable without RANSAC没有 RANSAC 无法判断
Two almost equally good candidates ⇒ ambiguous.两个几乎一样好的候选 ⇒ 匹配不明确。

Why is RANSAC preferred to plain least squares for estimating a transformation from SIFT matches?从 SIFT 匹配估计变换时，为什么 RANSAC 优于普通最小二乘？

  1. It is always faster总是更快
  2. It gives a closed-form solution有闭式解
  3. Wrong matches (outliers) can heavily bias LS; RANSAC fits minimal random samples and keeps the model with most inliers错误匹配（离群点）会严重偏置最小二乘；RANSAC 用最小随机样本拟合并保留内点最多的模型
  4. It requires no threshold不需要阈值
It needs an inlier threshold δ and many iterations.它需要内点阈值 δ 并迭代多次。

Which is NOT a desirable property of image features as listed in the lecture?以下哪项不是讲义中列出的特征理想性质？

  1. Redundancy (many highly correlated values)冗余（大量高度相关的值）
  2. Reproducibility (robustness)可重复性（鲁棒性）
  3. Saliency (descriptiveness)显著性（描述力）
  4. Compactness (efficiency)紧凑性（效率）
Redundancy is why raw pixels are bad.冗余正是原始像素不好的原因。

In SIFT, candidate keypoints are found as…SIFT 中候选关键点如何找到？

  1. maxima of the colour histogram颜色直方图的极大值
  2. pixels with the highest intensity强度最高的像素
  3. zero-crossings of the GLCMGLCM 的过零点
  4. local maxima/minima of Difference-of-Gaussian images across space and scale高斯差分图像在空间和尺度上的局部极大/极小
D=L(kσ)−L(σ).

The GLCM P(1,0∘)​ of an image with 8 gray levels has size…8 个灰度级的图像，其 GLCM P(1,0∘)​ 的尺寸为……

  1. image size与图像相同
  2. 8 × 8
  3. 8 × 1
  4. 256 × 256
L × L regardless of image size; binning reduces L.与图像大小无关，为 L × L；分箱可减小 L。

For a pure translation model fitted to matched points by least squares, the solution is…用最小二乘为匹配点拟合纯平移模型，解是……

  1. the median displacement位移的中位数
  2. the displacement of the first match第一对匹配的位移
  3. the mean displacement over all matches所有匹配的平均位移
  4. undefined无定义
(ATA)−1ATb with A made of identity blocks = average of b.其中 A 由单位块组成 = b 的平均。

6Feature representation II: feature encoding (BoW, k-means), shape features, shape context, HOG特征表示 II：特征编码（词袋、k-means）、形状特征、形状上下文、HOG

Slides: W3 Feature Representation Part 2对应讲义：W3 Feature Representation Part 2

🎯 Turn a variable number of local descriptors into one fixed-length vector with Bag-of-Words; run k-means; compute basic shape measures (circularity, compactness, elongation, eccentricity, convexity) and boundary descriptors; explain shape context matching; compute the HOG descriptor and use it for sliding-window detection.🎯 用词袋把数量不定的局部描述子变成定长向量；运行 k-means；计算基本形状度量（圆度、紧致度、伸长度、偏心率、凸性）和边界描述子；解释形状上下文匹配；计算 HOG 描述子并用于滑动窗口检测。

6.1 Feature encoding: Bag-of-Words6.1 特征编码：词袋模型

SIFT gives a variable number of local keypoint descriptors per image, but classification needs one global vector. Bag-of-(visual-)Words (BoW) encodes them into a fixed-dimensional histogram:SIFT 每幅图给出数量不定的局部描述子，但分类需要一个全局向量。（视觉）词袋 BoW 把它们编码成定长直方图：

k-MEANS CLUSTERING (unsupervised)k-means 聚类（无监督）
Initialise k cluster centres (typically randomly). Iterate: (1) assign each vector to the closest centre (Euclidean distance); (2) update each centre as the mean of its assigned vectors. Stop when converged or at max iterations. The number of iterations depends on the number of points, clusters and the initialisation.初始化 k 个聚类中心（通常随机）。迭代：(1) 把每个向量分给最近的中心（欧氏距离）；(2) 用分到该类的向量均值更新中心。停止于收敛或达到最大迭代次数。迭代次数取决于点数、类数和初始化。

Local features need not be SIFT (LBP, SURF, BRIEF, ORB); more advanced encodings: VLAD, Fisher vectors (VLFeat.org).局部特征不必是 SIFT（LBP、SURF、BRIEF、ORB）；更高级的编码：VLAD、Fisher 向量（VLFeat.org）。

6.2 Shape features6.2 形状特征

Shape is extracted after segmentation; challenges: invariance to rigid transformations, tolerance to non-rigid deformations, unknown correspondence.形状在分割之后提取；难点：对刚性变换不变、容忍非刚性形变、对应关系未知。

Measure度量Definition定义Notes备注
Net area, principal axes, convex area净面积、主轴、凸面积convex area = area of the convex hull凸面积 = 凸包面积
Convex / concave凸 / 凹convex if the segment between any two object points stays inside任意两点连线都在物体内则为凸convex hull = smallest convex set containing the object; convex deficiency = hull − object凸包 = 包含物体的最小凸集；凸缺陷 = 凸包 − 物体
Circularity圆度4πA/P2= 1 for a circle, smaller for irregular / rough / elongated boundaries (square: π/4 ≈ 0.785)圆为 1，边界不规则/粗糙/细长时更小（正方形：π/4 ≈ 0.785）
Compactness紧致度area of circle with the same perimeter ÷ object area同周长圆的面积 ÷ 物体面积= P2/4πA, inversely related to circularity= P2/4πA，与圆度成反比
Elongation伸长度length/width of the bounding box外接矩形的长/宽
Eccentricity偏心率minor axis length ÷ major axis length短轴长 ÷ 长轴长depends only on the overall elongation, not on boundary roughness只取决于整体伸长程度，与边界粗糙度无关
BOUNDARY DESCRIPTORS边界描述子
  • Chain code: list of directions (8-connected codes 0–7) between consecutive boundary points from a start point — compact boundary representation.链码：从起点开始，相邻边界点之间的方向序列（8 邻接编码 0–7）——紧凑的边界表示。
  • Local curvature κ(s): geometric 1/r(s) (osculating circle radius) or physical dτ/ds (rate of change of the tangent); convex parts positive, concave parts negative.局部曲率 κ(s)：几何定义 1/r(s)（密切圆半径），或物理定义 dτ/ds（切向量变化率）；凸处为正、凹处为负。
  • Global curvature: total bending energy B=∮κ2ds (circle has the minimum, 2π/r); total absolute curvature K=∮∣κ∣ds (convex objects have the minimum, 2π).全局曲率：总弯曲能 B=∮κ2ds（圆最小，为 2π/r）；总绝对曲率 K=∮∣κ∣ds（凸物体最小，为 2π）。
  • Radial distance: d(i)=(xi​−xˉ)2+(yi​−yˉ​)2​ from the centroid to each boundary pixel, normalised by its maximum ⇒ r(i) (scale invariant); the number of times r(i) crosses its mean measures boundary roughness.径向距离：质心到每个边界像素的距离 d(i)=(xi​−xˉ)2+(yi​−yˉ​)2​，除以最大值得 r(i)（尺度不变）；r(i) 穿过其均值的次数衡量边界粗糙度。

6.3 Shape context (Belongie et al. 2002)6.3 形状上下文（Belongie 等 2002）

A point-wise local descriptor: pick n points pi​ on the contour; for each, build a log-polar histogram of the relative positions of the other n − 1 points: hi​(k)=#{q=pi​:(q−pi​)∈bin(k)}.逐点局部描述子：在轮廓上取 n 个点 pi​；对每个点，统计其余 n − 1 个点相对位置的对数极坐标直方图：hi​(k)=#{q=pi​:(q−pi​)∈bin(k)}。

  1. Sample points on shape edges (e.g. Canny: Gaussian filtering → intensity gradient → non-maximum suppression → hysteresis thresholding → edge tracking).在形状边缘采样点（如 Canny：高斯滤波 → 强度梯度 → 非极大值抑制 → 滞后阈值 → 边缘连接）。
  2. Compute the shape context of each point.计算每个点的形状上下文。
  3. Cost matrix between shapes P and Q (χ² statistic): C(pi​,qj​)=21​∑k​hi​(k)+hj​(k)[hi​(k)−hj​(k)]2​.两形状 P、Q 间的代价矩阵（χ² 统计量）：C(pi​,qj​)=21​∑k​hi​(k)+hj​(k)[hi​(k)−hj​(k)]2​。
  4. Find the one-to-one matching π minimising H(π)=∑i​C(pi​,qπ(i)​).求最小化 H(π)=∑i​C(pi​,qπ(i)​) 的一一匹配 π。
  5. Fit a transformation (e.g. affine) by LS or RANSAC.用最小二乘或 RANSAC 拟合变换（如仿射）。
  6. Shape distance D(P,Q)=n1​∑p​minq​C(p,T(q))+m1​∑q​minp​C(p,T(q)) (+ appearance, bending-energy costs).形状距离 D(P,Q)=n1​∑p​minq​C(p,T(q))+m1​∑q​minp​C(p,T(q))（可加外观、弯曲能代价）。

6.4 Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG; Dalal & Triggs 2005)6.4 方向梯度直方图（HOG；Dalal & Triggs 2005）

Describes the distribution of gradient orientations in local areas; no segmentation needed.描述局部区域内梯度方向的分布；不需要先分割。

  1. Gradient vector (magnitude and orientation) at each pixel.计算每个像素的梯度（幅值与方向）。
  2. For each cell (e.g. 8×8 pixels), a histogram of orientations: typically 9 bins over 0–180°; each pixel votes with its gradient magnitude.每个单元（如 8×8 像素）统计方向直方图：通常 0–180° 共 9 个箱；每个像素按梯度幅值投票。
  3. Group cells into blocks (2×2 cells), block-normalise, concatenate ⇒ detection-window descriptor.把单元组成块（2×2 个单元），块内归一化，拼接 ⇒ 检测窗口描述子。
FEATURE COUNT (64×128 person window)特征数（64×128 行人窗口）
8×16 cells ⇒ 7×15 overlapping blocks (stride 1 cell); each block = 4 cells × 9 bins:8×16 个单元 ⇒ 7×15 个重叠块（步长 1 个单元）；每块 = 4 个单元 × 9 个箱：
#features=(7×15)×4×9=3,780

Detection via sliding window: compute HOG for many labelled training windows ("person" / "background"), train a classifier (e.g. SVM), then slide a window over the test image and classify each position ⇒ detector response map. Extensions: deformable parts models (fine-grained detection), detecting and tracking humans in video.滑动窗口检测：对大量带标签的训练窗口（“行人”/“背景”）计算 HOG，训练分类器（如 SVM），然后在测试图像上滑动窗口逐位置分类 ⇒ 检测响应图。扩展：可变形部件模型（细粒度检测）、视频中检测与跟踪行人。

Practice — Section 6练习 — 第 6 节

(Sample-exam style) Two classes of segmented objects have the same overall elongation (same ratio of axes) but class A has smooth boundaries and class B very jagged boundaries. Thresholding which measure separates them?（样题风格）两类分割后的物体整体伸长程度相同（轴长比相同），但 A 类边界光滑、B 类边界非常参差。对哪个度量做阈值能区分它们？

  1. Only circularity只有圆度
  2. Only eccentricity只有偏心率
  3. Both circularity and eccentricity圆度和偏心率都可以
  4. Neither都不行
Jagged boundaries increase the perimeter ⇒ lower 4πA/P2; eccentricity (axis ratio) is the same for both. Conversely, if the classes differed only in elongation (e.g. smooth circles vs smooth ellipses), both measures would work, since elongation also lowers circularity. In the real sample question look at what differs in the picture.边界参差会增大周长 ⇒ 4πA/P2 变小；偏心率（轴长比）两类相同。反之，若两类只在伸长度上不同（如光滑圆 vs 光滑椭圆），则两种度量都可行，因为伸长也会降低圆度。真实样题要看图中两类到底差在哪里。

The circularity 4πA/P2 of a square is…正方形的圆度 4πA/P2 为……

  1. 1
  2. 4/π
  3. π/4 ≈ 0.785
  4. 0.5
4πs2/(4s)2=π/4.

Bag-of-Words encoding of SIFT features…SIFT 特征的词袋编码……

  1. concatenates all 128-D descriptors of an image拼接一幅图的所有 128 维描述子
  2. maps a variable number of local descriptors to a fixed-length histogram of visual-word counts把数量不定的局部描述子映射为定长的视觉词计数直方图
  3. requires labelled data to build the vocabulary构建词典需要标注数据
  4. preserves the spatial layout of keypoints保留关键点的空间布局
The vocabulary comes from unsupervised k-means; spatial layout is discarded ("bag").词典来自无监督 k-means；空间布局被丢弃（“袋”）。

Which statement about k-means is incorrect?关于 k-means，哪项错误？

  1. It alternates assignment to the nearest centre and recomputing centres as means.交替进行“分配到最近中心”和“按均值重算中心”。
  2. The result can depend on the initialisation.结果可能依赖初始化。
  3. The number of clusters k must be chosen in advance.类数 k 需事先选定。
  4. It is a supervised learning method requiring class labels.它是需要类别标签的监督学习方法。
Unsupervised.无监督。

A HOG descriptor for a 64×128 window with 8×8 cells, 2×2-cell blocks (stride one cell) and 9 bins has how many elements?64×128 窗口、8×8 单元、2×2 单元块（步长一个单元）、9 个箱的 HOG 描述子有多少维？

  1. 3,780
  2. 1,152
  3. 4,608
  4. 945
7×15 blocks × 4 cells × 9 = 3780. (1152 = 8×16×9 would ignore blocks.)（1152 = 8×16×9 忽略了块。）

Which object has the smallest total bending energy ∮κ2ds for a given size?给定大小时，哪种物体的总弯曲能 ∮κ2ds 最小？

  1. a square正方形
  2. a star星形
  3. a circle圆
  4. a long thin ellipse细长椭圆
Circle: B=2π/r. (Any convex object minimises the total absolute curvature, 2π.)圆：B=2π/r。（任何凸物体的总绝对曲率最小，为 2π。）

Shape context describes each contour point by…形状上下文用什么描述每个轮廓点？

  1. its local curvature局部曲率
  2. a log-polar histogram of the relative positions of all other sampled contour points其余所有采样轮廓点相对位置的对数极坐标直方图
  3. its chain code链码
  4. its gradient orientation histogram over 9 bins9 个箱的梯度方向直方图
Then matched with a χ² cost and a one-to-one assignment.之后用 χ² 代价和一一分配进行匹配。

Why does HOG-based pedestrian detection not need segmentation?为什么基于 HOG 的行人检测不需要分割？

  1. It uses colour only只用颜色
  2. It uses shape context使用形状上下文
  3. It thresholds the image first先对图像阈值化
  4. It describes gradient orientation statistics in fixed cells of a window and classifies each window position (sliding window + SVM)它描述窗口内固定单元中的梯度方向统计，并对每个窗口位置分类（滑动窗口 + SVM）
Shape features (area, circularity…) do need segmentation first.形状特征（面积、圆度…）需要先分割。

7Pattern recognition I: concepts, nearest class mean, kNN, Bayesian decisions, decision trees, random forests模式识别 I：基本概念、最近类均值、kNN、贝叶斯决策、决策树、随机森林

Slides: W4 Pattern Recognition Part 1对应讲义：W4 Pattern Recognition Part 1

🎯 Use PR vocabulary precisely; apply NCM and kNN and know their pros/cons; compute Bayesian posteriors and the minimum-risk decision with a loss table; build a decision tree using entropy and information gain; explain random forests (bagging + random feature subsets) and how correlation/strength/m affect the error.🎯 准确使用模式识别术语；应用最近类均值和 kNN 并了解其优缺点；计算贝叶斯后验与带损失表的最小风险决策；用熵和信息增益构建决策树；解释随机森林（自助采样 + 随机特征子集）以及相关性/强度/m 如何影响误差。

7.1 Concepts7.1 基本概念

Pattern recognition: automatically recognise patterns and regularities in data (images, text, speech, events, recommendations). Paradigms: supervised (labelled data), unsupervised (no labels), semi-supervised (labelled + unlabelled), weakly supervised (noisy/limited/imprecise labels). So PR does not always require ground-truth labels.模式识别：自动识别数据（图像、文本、语音、事件、推荐）中的模式与规律。范式：监督（有标签）、无监督（无标签）、半监督（有标签 + 无标签）、弱监督（标签有噪声/有限/不精确）。所以模式识别不一定需要真值标签。

TERMINOLOGY术语
Objects (physical entities imaged) · regions (ideally = objects after segmentation) · classes (disjoint subsets of objects sharing features) · labels (class membership) · classification (assigning labels based on features) · classifier (the algorithm) · patterns (regularities in features) · feature vector x=[x1​,…,xd​] · feature selection (keep the most descriptive) · model (description of a class) · training samples · cost (consequence of a wrong decision) · decision boundary (between class regions in feature space). System: acquisition → preprocessing → feature extraction/selection → learning → evaluation. 物体（被成像的实体）· 区域（理想情况下 = 分割后的物体）· 类（共享特征的不相交物体子集）· 标签（类别归属）· 分类（依据特征分配标签）· 分类器（算法）· 模式（特征中的规律）· 特征向量 x=[x1​,…,xd​] · 特征选择（保留最具描述力的）· 模型（类的描述）· 训练样本 · 代价（错误决策的后果）· 决策边界（特征空间中类区域的分界）。系统流程：采集 → 预处理 → 特征提取/选择 → 学习 → 评估。

Good features are similar within a class, different between classes, invariant to position/orientation (and whatever the application needs), robust to occlusion, projective distortion, non-rigid deformation and illumination. Feature design is problem-dependent and needs domain knowledge.好特征：类内相似、类间不同、对位置/方向等（视应用而定）不变，对遮挡、投影畸变、非刚性形变和光照鲁棒。特征设计依赖具体问题，需要领域知识。

7.2 Nearest class mean (NCM) and k-nearest neighbours (kNN)7.2 最近类均值（NCM）与 k 近邻（kNN）

NCM: training computes each class centroid μk​=∣ck​∣1​∑xi​∈ck​​xi​; testing assigns x to the class with the closest centroid (Euclidean or other metric; reject if not close enough). A multimodal class can use several subclass centroids. ✓ simple, fast, good for compact well-separated classes. ✗ poor for complex (multimodal, non-spherical) classes, outliers/noise, missing data.NCM：训练时计算每类质心 μk​=∣ck​∣1​∑xi​∈ck​​xi​；测试时把 x 分给质心最近的类（欧氏或其他距离；不够近则拒绝）。多峰类可用多个子类质心。✓ 简单、快，适合紧凑且分离良好的类。✗ 对复杂（多峰、非球形）类、离群点/噪声、缺失数据效果差。

kNN: for a test sample, compute distances to all training samples, take the K nearest, and assign the majority class (Euclidean for continuous, Hamming for discrete variables).kNN：对测试样本，计算它与所有训练样本的距离，取最近的 K 个，按多数投票定类（连续变量用欧氏距离，离散变量用汉明距离）。

✓✗
very simple, intuitive, easy to implement; no a-priori assumptions; no training step; non-linear decision surfaces非常简单直观、易实现；无先验假设；没有训练步骤；决策面非线性slow for big data sets; needs homogeneous feature types and scales (normalise!); curse of dimensionality; choosing K is hard大数据集上慢；需要同质的特征类型和尺度（要归一化！）；维度灾难；K 难选

7.3 Bayesian decision theory7.3 贝叶斯决策理论

Decisions should be probabilistic (soft) and can include prior knowledge. Assume known priors p(ci​) and class-conditional distributions p(x∣ci​) (learned from data or assigned):决策应是概率性的（软决策），可以引入先验知识。假设已知先验 p(ci​) 和类条件分布 p(x∣ci​)（从数据中学习或指定）：

BAYES RULE & DECISION贝叶斯公式与决策
p(ci​∣x)=p(x)p(x∣ci​)p(ci​)​p(x)=j∑​p(x∣cj​)p(cj​)c=argimax​p(ci​∣x)=argimax​p(x∣ci​)p(ci​)​
Minimum risk when errors have different costs: loss λ(αi​∣cj​) of action αi​ when the true class is cj​; conditional risk R(αi​∣x)=∑j​λ(αi​∣cj​)p(cj​∣x); choose the action with the smallest risk.不同错误代价不同时用最小风险：真实类为 cj​ 时采取动作 αi​ 的损失 λ(αi​∣cj​)；条件风险 R(αi​∣x)=∑j​λ(αi​∣cj​)p(cj​∣x)；选风险最小的动作。
FISH EXAMPLE (lecture)鱼的例子（讲义）
salmonsea bassother
prior先验 p(c)0.30.60.1
p(length > 100 | c)0.50.30.2
p(50–100 | c)0.40.50.2
p(< 50 | c)0.10.20.6
Prior only ⇒ always "sea bass" (never predicts other classes — poor). Length 70 cm: salmon 0.4×0.3 = 0.12, sea bass 0.5×0.6 = 0.30, other 0.2×0.1 = 0.02 ⇒ sea bass. (If the likelihoods for salmon and bass were equal, the prior would decide.)只用先验 ⇒ 总是判“鲈鱼”（从不预测其他类——很差）。长度 70 cm：鲑鱼 0.4×0.3 = 0.12，鲈鱼 0.5×0.6 = 0.30，其他 0.2×0.1 = 0.02 ⇒ 鲈鱼。（若鲑鱼与鲈鱼似然相等，则由先验决定。）

With a loss table (rows = sell as, columns = true class): salmon (0, 2, 3), bass (10, 0, 4), other (20, 7, 0). For 50 < x < 100 (unnormalised posteriors 0.12, 0.30, 0.02):加入损失表（行 = 当作什么卖，列 = 真实类别）：鲑鱼 (0, 2, 3)、鲈鱼 (10, 0, 4)、其他 (20, 7, 0)。对 50 < x < 100（未归一化后验 0.12、0.30、0.02）：

R(salmon) ∝ 0×0.12 + 2×0.30 + 3×0.02 = 0.66; R(bass) ∝ 10×0.12 + 0 + 4×0.02 = 1.28; R(other) ∝ 20×0.12 + 7×0.30 + 0 = 4.5 ⇒ sell as salmon (minimum risk), although sea bass is the most probable class!R(鲑鱼) ∝ 0×0.12 + 2×0.30 + 3×0.02 = 0.66；R(鲈鱼) ∝ 10×0.12 + 0 + 4×0.02 = 1.28；R(其他) ∝ 20×0.12 + 7×0.30 + 0 = 4.5 ⇒ 当作鲑鱼卖（风险最小），尽管鲈鱼才是最可能的类别！

Probabilities can be estimated empirically (frequencies) or by assuming a parametric model and estimating its parameters (e.g. Gaussian with known Σ: μ^​=xˉ). ✓ simple, efficient, handles uncertainty, combines new information with prior knowledge. ✗ struggles with complex data relationships; choice of priors can be subjective.概率可以经验估计（频率），或假设参数模型再估参数（如已知 Σ 的高斯：μ^​=xˉ）。✓ 简单高效、考虑不确定性、能把新信息与先验结合。✗ 难以处理复杂数据关系；先验选择可能主观。

7.4 Decision trees7.4 决策树

Handle nominal (categorical) data without a natural metric ({high, medium, low}, {red, green, blue}) as well as numeric data via thresholds. Classify by a sequence of questions from the root to a leaf (the leaf holds the label); each internal node tests one feature (binary tree: feature < / ≥ threshold).能处理没有自然度量的名义（类别）数据（{高, 中, 低}、{红, 绿, 蓝}），也可通过阈值处理数值数据。从根到叶依次提问分类（叶子存放标签）；每个内部节点检验一个特征（二叉树：特征 < / ≥ 阈值）。

CONSTRUCTION (greedy, top-down)构建（贪心、自顶向下）
  1. Select a feature for the node (root first).为节点选择特征（先从根）。
  2. One branch per value (nominal) or range (numeric).每个取值（名义）或区间（数值）一个分支。
  3. Recurse on each branch using only the samples that reach it.对每个分支递归，只用到达该分支的样本。
  4. Stop when all samples at a node have the same label (entropy 0).当节点上所有样本标签相同时停止（熵为 0）。
Choose the feature with the highest information gain:选择信息增益最大的特征：
H(S)=−i∑​pi​log2​pi​IG(S,f)=H(S)−v∈values(f)∑​∣S∣∣Sv​∣​H(Sv​)​
LECTURE EXAMPLE (15 fish: 6 salmon, 9 sea bass)讲义例题（15 条鱼：6 条鲑鱼、9 条鲈鱼）
Hbase​=−0.4log2​0.4−0.6log2​0.6=0.97. Length x₁: S (1 salmon, 4 bass), M (2, 5), L (3, 0) ⇒ H(S∣x1​)=155​H(1,4)+157​H(2,5)+153​H(3,0)=0.64, IG = 0.33. Width x₂: S (3,0), M (2,4), L (1,5) ⇒ H(S∣x2​)=0.62, IG = 0.35 ⇒ split on width first; branches with entropy > 0 are split further. (Entropy of the 3-class prior (0.3, 0.6, 0.1) = 1.29 bits.)Hbase​=−0.4log2​0.4−0.6log2​0.6=0.97。长度 x₁：S（1 鲑、4 鲈）、M（2、5）、L（3、0）⇒ H(S∣x1​)=155​H(1,4)+157​H(2,5)+153​H(3,0)=0.64，IG = 0.33。宽度 x₂：S（3,0）、M（2,4）、L（1,5）⇒ H(S∣x2​)=0.62，IG = 0.35 ⇒ 先按宽度分裂；熵 > 0 的分支继续分裂。（三类先验 (0.3, 0.6, 0.1) 的熵 = 1.29 比特。）

✓ easy to interpret; numeric and categorical data; robust to outliers and missing values; indicates feature importance. ✗ tends to overfit; only axis-aligned splits; greedy (may not find the best tree).✓ 易解释；可处理数值和类别数据；对离群点和缺失值鲁棒；能给出特征重要性。✗ 容易过拟合；只能轴对齐划分；贪心（不一定找到最优树）。

7.5 Ensembles and random forests7.5 集成学习与随机森林

Ensemble learning combines several models (different algorithms, parameters, training examples or feature sets) to beat any single one. Random forest (Breiman) = ensemble of decision trees, output = majority vote; overcomes the trees' overfitting.集成学习组合多个模型（不同算法、参数、训练样本或特征集）以超越任何单个模型。随机森林（Breiman）= 决策树的集成，输出 = 多数投票；克服了单棵树的过拟合。

BREIMAN'S ALGORITHM (N instances, M features)Breiman 算法（N 个样本，M 个特征）
Training, repeated B times: sample N instances with replacement (bootstrap); at each node choose m ≪ M features at random and split on the best of them; grow each tree fully (no pruning); m fixed. Testing: push the sample down all B trees, report the majority vote.训练（重复 B 次）：有放回地抽取 N 个样本（自助采样）；每个节点随机选 m ≪ M 个特征，在其中选最佳特征分裂；每棵树完全生长（不剪枝）；m 保持不变。测试：样本经过全部 B 棵树，取多数投票。
ERROR RATE DEPENDS ON (exam favourite)错误率取决于（考试热点）
(1) Correlation between trees: higher correlation ⇒ higher forest error (uncorrelated trees generalise better). (2) Strength of each tree (low individual error): stronger trees ⇒ lower forest error. Reducing m reduces both correlation and strength; increasing m increases both ⇒ an optimal range of m in between.(1) 树之间的相关性：相关性越高 ⇒ 森林误差越高（不相关的树泛化更好）。(2) 每棵树的强度（个体误差低）：树越强 ⇒ 森林误差越低。减小 m 会同时降低相关性和强度；增大 m 会同时提高二者 ⇒ m 存在一个中间的最佳范围。

✓ high accuracy among traditional methods; efficient on large datasets; thousands of features without selection; handles missing values. ✗ less interpretable than one tree; more complex and slower to build. Application: predicting Alzheimer's disease from cortical thickness, Jacobian maps, sulcal depth.✓ 在传统方法中精度高；大数据集上高效；可处理成千上万特征无需特征选择；能处理缺失值。✗ 不如单棵树可解释；构建更复杂、更慢。应用：用皮层厚度、雅可比图、脑沟深度预测阿尔茨海默病。

Practice — Section 7练习 — 第 7 节

(Sample exam) Which statement is correct for random forest classifiers?（样题）关于随机森林分类器，哪项正确？

  1. Increasing the correlation between trees decreases the forest error rate.增加树之间的相关性会降低森林错误率。
  2. Reducing the number of selected features at each node increases the correlation between trees.减少每个节点选择的特征数会增加树之间的相关性。
  3. Reducing the number of selected features at each node increases the strength of the trees.减少每个节点选择的特征数会增加树的强度。
  4. Increasing the strength of the individual trees decreases the forest error rate.增加单棵树的强度会降低森林错误率。
Reducing m reduces both correlation and strength.减小 m 会同时降低相关性和强度。

(Sample exam) Which statement is correct for pattern recognition?（样题）关于模式识别，哪项正确？

  1. Pattern recognition requires training data that contain ground-truth labels.模式识别需要带真值标签的训练数据。
  2. The dimension of feature vectors must be smaller than the number of training samples to avoid overfitting.特征维数必须小于训练样本数以避免过拟合。
  3. The simple kNN classifier needs homogeneous feature types and scales for better performance.简单 kNN 分类器需要同质的特征类型和尺度才能表现更好。
  4. SVM can separate classes even when the feature space shows significant class overlap.即使特征空间中各类大量重叠，SVM 也能把它们分开。
(A) unsupervised PR exists; (B) "must" is too strong — SVMs work even when d > N; (D) SVM does not perform well for overlapping classes.（A）存在无监督模式识别；（B）“必须”太绝对——SVM 在 d > N 时也有效；（D）SVM 对重叠类效果不好。

In the fish example, suppose p(70 cm | salmon) = p(70 cm | sea bass) = 0.5. The Bayesian decision (no losses) is…鱼的例子中，若 p(70 cm | 鲑鱼) = p(70 cm | 鲈鱼) = 0.5，（不考虑损失）贝叶斯决策为……

  1. salmon鲑鱼
  2. sea bass, because its prior (0.6) is larger鲈鱼，因其先验（0.6）更大
  3. undecidable无法决定
  4. other其他
Equal likelihoods ⇒ the prior decides.似然相等 ⇒ 由先验决定。

Unnormalised posteriors for x: A = 0.2, B = 0.5. Losses: deciding A when truth is B costs 5; deciding B when truth is A costs 1; correct decisions cost 0. Minimum-risk decision?对某 x 的未归一化后验：A = 0.2，B = 0.5。损失：真实为 B 却判 A 代价 5；真实为 A 却判 B 代价 1；判对代价 0。最小风险决策是？

  1. B (risk 0.2 vs 2.5)B（风险 0.2 vs 2.5）
  2. A (risk 0.5)A（风险 0.5）
  3. A, because it has lower posteriorA，因为后验更低
  4. reject拒绝
R(A) ∝ 5×0.5 = 2.5; R(B) ∝ 1×0.2 = 0.2 ⇒ B.

A node has 8 samples (4 positive, 4 negative). A feature splits them into {3+,1−} and {1+,3−}. Information gain? (H(0.75, 0.25) = 0.811)某节点有 8 个样本（4 正、4 负）。某特征把它们分成 {3+,1−} 和 {1+,3−}。信息增益？（H(0.75, 0.25) = 0.811）

  1. 0.811
  2. 1.0
  3. 0.189
  4. 0.5
1−(84​⋅0.811+84​⋅0.811)=0.189.

Which is NOT an advantage of kNN?以下哪项不是 kNN 的优点？

  1. No training step没有训练步骤
  2. Non-linear decision surfaces非线性决策面
  3. No a-priori assumptions about the data对数据无先验假设
  4. Fast classification on very large datasets在超大数据集上分类很快
It must compute distances to all training samples.需要计算到所有训练样本的距离。

The nearest class mean classifier performs poorly when…最近类均值分类器在什么情况下效果差？

  1. classes are compact and far apart类紧凑且相距很远
  2. a class is multimodal or non-spherical某类是多峰或非球形
  3. features are normalised特征已归一化
  4. there are only two classes只有两类
One centroid can't represent two separated modes (use subclass centroids).一个质心无法代表两个分开的峰（可用子类质心）。

Which is a known weakness of single decision trees that random forests address?单棵决策树的哪个弱点由随机森林解决？

  1. Overfitting过拟合
  2. Cannot handle categorical data不能处理类别数据
  3. Not interpretable不可解释
  4. Requires feature normalisation需要特征归一化
Averaging many decorrelated trees reduces variance.对许多去相关的树取平均降低方差。

In Breiman's random forest, each tree is trained on…Breiman 随机森林中，每棵树在什么数据上训练？

  1. all N samples without replacement and all M features at every node全部 N 个样本（不放回），每个节点用全部 M 个特征
  2. a random 50% subset and is then pruned随机 50% 子集，然后剪枝
  3. N samples drawn with replacement, choosing among m ≪ M random features at each node, grown without pruning有放回抽取的 N 个样本，每个节点从随机的 m ≪ M 个特征中选择，不剪枝
  4. the misclassified samples of the previous tree上一棵树分错的样本
(D) describes boosting, not random forests.（D）描述的是 boosting，不是随机森林。

8Pattern recognition II: linear classifiers, SVMs, multiclass, evaluation, regression, cross-validation模式识别 II：线性分类器、SVM、多分类、评估、回归、交叉验证

Slides: W4 Pattern Recognition Part 2对应讲义：W4 Pattern Recognition Part 2

🎯 Define (linear) separability; derive the hard-margin SVM and explain soft margins (C) and kernels; build multiclass classifiers from binary ones; compute accuracy, precision, recall, F1, TPR/FPR, ROC/AUC; fit least-squares regression and evaluate with RMSE/MAE/R²; use normalisation and (k-fold) cross-validation correctly.🎯 定义（线性）可分；推导硬间隔 SVM 并解释软间隔（C）与核方法；用二分类器构建多分类器；计算准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、TPR/FPR、ROC/AUC；拟合最小二乘回归并用 RMSE/MAE/R² 评估；正确使用归一化与（k 折）交叉验证。

8.1 Linear classifiers and SVMs8.1 线性分类器与 SVM

Classes are separable if some decision boundary puts only one class in each region; linearly separable if a hyperplane does. Training set {(xi​,yi​)}, yi​∈{−1,+1}. Linear classifier f(x)=wTx+b (line in 2D, plane in 3D, hyperplane in nD); correct classification ⇔ yi​f(xi​)>0. Many hyperplanes separate the data — the one with the maximum margin generalises best and is most stable under input perturbations.若存在某个决策边界使每个区域只含一类，则称可分；若该边界是超平面，则称线性可分。训练集 {(xi​,yi​)}，yi​∈{−1,+1}。线性分类器 f(x)=wTx+b（二维是直线、三维是平面、n 维是超平面）；分类正确 ⇔ yi​f(xi​)>0。能分开数据的超平面很多——间隔最大的那个泛化最好、对输入扰动最稳定。

HARD-MARGIN SVM硬间隔 SVM
Distance of a point to the hyperplane: ∣wTx+b∣/∥w∥. Maximise the distance η to the closest examples: maxw,b​η s.t. yi​(wTxi​+b)/∥w∥≥η. The scale of (w, b) is arbitrary, so fix it by requiring the closest points to satisfy yi​(wTxi​+b)=1 ⇒ margin =1/∥w∥ each side ⇒点到超平面的距离：∣wTx+b∣/∥w∥。最大化到最近样本的距离 η：maxw,b​η 使得 yi​(wTxi​+b)/∥w∥≥η。(w, b) 的尺度任意，于是规定最近点满足 yi​(wTxi​+b)=1 ⇒ 每侧间隔 =1/∥w∥ ⇒
w,bmin​ 21​∥w∥2s.t.yi​(wTxi​+b)≥1  ∀i
A convex quadratic program with linear constraints (dual form via Lagrangian). Test: y^​=sign(wTx+b). Allows no misclassification.带线性约束的凸二次规划（可用拉格朗日得到对偶形式）。测试：y^​=sign(wTx+b)。不允许任何错分。
SOFT-MARGIN SVM软间隔 SVM
w,b,ξmin​ 21​∥w∥2+Ci∑​ξi​s.t.  yi​(wTxi​+b)≥1−ξi​,  ξi​≥0​
Slack ξi​ = distance of xi​ beyond its margin (0 if on the correct side). Small C: more tolerance of misclassified samples, larger margin. Large C: avoid mistakes at the expense of a smaller margin; C→∞ ⇒ hard margin. Still a QP. Better with noisy data.松弛变量 ξi​ = xi​ 越过其间隔的距离（在正确一侧则为 0）。C 小：更容忍错分、间隔更大。C 大：尽量不犯错，代价是间隔更小；C→∞ ⇒ 硬间隔。仍是二次规划。对含噪数据更好。

Nonlinear SVM: map features to a higher-dimensional space where classes become linearly separable; a kernel function does this implicitly (kernel trick) and keeps optimisation tractable (e.g. used with HOG for detection). ✓ very effective in high-dimensional spaces, even when the dimension exceeds the number of samples; among the best for well-separated classes; works well with sparse data; kernel trick. ✗ slow for large datasets; does not perform well for overlapping classes; needs hyperparameter tuning.非线性 SVM：把特征映射到更高维空间使类线性可分；核函数隐式完成这一映射（核技巧）并保持优化可解（如与 HOG 一起做检测）。✓ 高维空间中非常有效，即使维数超过样本数；类分离良好时是最佳算法之一；适合稀疏数据；可用核技巧。✗ 大数据集上慢；类重叠时效果不好；需要调超参数。

8.2 Multiclass classification8.2 多分类

kNN, decision trees and Bayesian methods are natively multiclass. Binary classifiers (e.g. SVM) are combined: one-vs-rest — K classifiers (each class vs all others), assign the class with the highest confidence; one-vs-one — one classifier per pair, K(K−1)/2 classifiers, assign the class with the most votes.kNN、决策树和贝叶斯方法天然支持多分类。二分类器（如 SVM）需组合：一对其余——K 个分类器（每类对其余所有类），选置信度最高的类；一对一——每两类一个分类器，共 K(K−1)/2 个，选得票最多的类。

8.3 Evaluating classifiers8.3 分类器评估

  • Error rate; reject class for objects that fit no known class; a classification error occurs when the true class is Cj​ and the classifier outputs Ci​=Cj​ with Ci​ not the reject class. Rejecting everything makes no errors but is useless ⇒ report empirical error rate and empirical reject rate on independent test data (not used for designing features/classifier; e.g. 80/20 split; representative samples).错误率；无法归入任何已知类的物体放入拒绝类；当真实类为 Cj​、分类器输出 Ci​=Cj​ 且 Ci​ 不是拒绝类时，发生分类错误。全部拒绝虽不出错但毫无用处 ⇒ 在独立测试数据（未用于设计特征/分类器；如 80/20 划分；样本需有代表性）上报告经验错误率和经验拒绝率。
  • Two-class errors are not symmetric: false alarm = false positive = type I (healthy person told they have the disease); false dismissal = false negative = type II (sick person missed) — often more catastrophic, so we may accept more FPs to reduce FNs; the balance depends on the application.二分类的两种错误不对称：误报 = 假阳性 = 第一类错误（健康人被判有病）；漏报 = 假阴性 = 第二类错误（病人被漏诊）——往往更严重，所以可以接受更多假阳性来减少假阴性；平衡点取决于应用。
CONFUSION-MATRIX METRICS混淆矩阵指标
pred P预测 Ppred N预测 N
actual P实际 PTPFN
actual N实际 NFPTN
Acc=TP+TN+FP+FNTP+TN​P=TP+FPTP​R=TPR=TP+FNTP​F1​=P+R2PR​​
FPR = FP/(FP+TN). ROC curve: classify with a threshold on the positive-class probability; sweeping the threshold traces TPR vs FPR; raising detection usually raises false alarms. AUC (area under the ROC) summarises performance (0.5 = random, 1 = perfect). Multiclass confusion matrix: entry (i, j) = # times class i was classified as j; diagonal = successes; large off-diagonal = confusion.FPR = FP/(FP+TN)。ROC 曲线：对正类概率设阈值分类；扫描阈值得到 TPR 对 FPR 的曲线；提高检出率通常也会提高误报。AUC（ROC 下面积）概括性能（0.5 = 随机，1 = 完美）。多类混淆矩阵：第 (i, j) 项 = 类 i 被判为 j 的次数；对角线 = 正确；非对角线大 = 类间混淆。

8.4 Regression8.4 回归

Same setup but yi​∈R. Linear regression: f(x)=w0​+w1​x1​+⋯+wd​xd​=xW with x=[1,x1​,…,xd​]. Least squares: minimise the residual sum of squares设定相同但 yi​∈R。线性回归：f(x)=w0​+w1​x1​+⋯+wd​xd​=xW，x=[1,x1​,…,xd​]。最小二乘：最小化残差平方和

RSS(W)=i∑​(yi​−f(xi​))2=(Y−XW)T(Y−XW)∂W∂RSS​=−2XT(Y−XW)=0⇒ W^=(XTX)−1XTY​

(X full rank ⇒ XTX positive definite ⇒ convex with a unique minimum.) Lecture fish example: weight from length: W=(−1.8,0.0635), RSS = 0.9438; adding width: RSS = 0.9077.（X 满秩 ⇒ XTX 正定 ⇒ 凸且有唯一极小。）讲义鱼重例子：用长度预测重量：W=(−1.8,0.0635)，RSS = 0.9438；再加宽度：RSS = 0.9077。

REGRESSION METRICS回归指标
RMSE=N1​∑(yi​−y^​i​)2​MAE=N1​∑∣yi​−y^​i​∣R2=1−∑(yi​−yˉ​)2∑(yi​−y^​i​)2​Radj2​=1−N−d−1(1−R2)(N−1)​​
RMSE penalises big errors more than MAE; smaller RMSE/MAE and larger R² are better. R² never decreases when features are added; adjusted R² corrects for the number of features d.RMSE 比 MAE 更惩罚大误差；RMSE/MAE 越小、R² 越大越好。增加特征时 R² 不会下降；调整 R² 对特征数 d 做了校正。

8.5 Normalisation and cross-validation8.5 归一化与交叉验证

  • Z-score (x−μ)/σ ⇒ mean 0, std 1 (good for normally distributed data); min–max (x−xmin​)/(xmax​−xmin​) ⇒ [0, 1]. Essential for distance-based classifiers like kNN.Z 分数 (x−μ)/σ ⇒ 均值 0、标准差 1（适合正态数据）；最小–最大 (x−xmin​)/(xmax​−xmin​) ⇒ [0, 1]。对 kNN 等基于距离的分类器必不可少。
  • Train–test split (e.g. 80:20). K-fold CV: split into K folds; each fold is the test set once while the rest train; average the K results. For hyperparameter tuning: hold out a test set, do CV (train/validation) on the rest; the test set must not be used to select hyperparameters.训练–测试划分（如 80:20）。K 折交叉验证：分成 K 份，每份轮流作测试集、其余训练，取 K 次结果的平均。调超参数时：先留出测试集，在其余数据上做交叉验证（训练/验证）；测试集不能用于选择超参数。

Practice — Section 8练习 — 第 8 节

A detector gives TP = 40, FN = 10, FP = 20, TN = 130. Precision and recall?某检测器 TP = 40，FN = 10，FP = 20，TN = 130。精确率与召回率？

  1. P = 0.80, R = 0.67
  2. P = 0.67, R = 0.80
  3. P = 0.85, R = 0.80
  4. P = 0.80, R = 0.87
P = 40/60 = 0.67; R = 40/50 = 0.80; F1 = 2(0.67)(0.8)/1.47 = 0.73; Acc = 170/200 = 0.85.

For an SVM with w=(3,4), the margin width (between the two support hyperplanes) is…SVM 的 w=(3,4)，两条支持超平面之间的间隔宽度为……

  1. 5
  2. 0.2
  3. 0.4
  4. 2.5
2/∥w∥=2/5=0.4.

In a soft-margin SVM, increasing C…软间隔 SVM 中增大 C……

  1. penalises margin violations more, giving a smaller margin and fewer training errors更重地惩罚间隔违反，间隔更小、训练错误更少
  2. gives a larger margin and tolerates more errors间隔更大、容忍更多错误
  3. has no effect on the margin对间隔无影响
  4. turns the problem into a non-convex one把问题变成非凸的
C→∞ recovers the hard-margin SVM.即回到硬间隔 SVM。

How many binary classifiers does one-vs-one need for 6 classes?一对一方法处理 6 类需要多少个二分类器？

  1. 6
  2. 5
  3. 36
  4. 15
6⋅5/2=15 (one-vs-rest: 6).

In medical screening, a false negative is…医学筛查中，假阴性是……

  1. a false alarm (type I error)误报（第一类错误）
  2. a false dismissal (type II error): the patient has the disease but the system says no漏报（第二类错误）：病人有病但系统说没有
  3. a correct dismissal正确排除
  4. a rejection拒绝
Often the most costly error in diagnosis.在诊断中往往代价最大。

Least-squares fit of y=w0​+w1​x to points (0,1), (1,3), (2,5)?用最小二乘把 y=w0​+w1​x 拟合到点 (0,1)、(1,3)、(2,5)？

  1. y = 2 + x
  2. y = 3x
  3. y = 1 + 2x
  4. y = 1.5 + 1.5x
The points lie exactly on y = 1 + 2x, so RSS = 0.三点恰好在 y = 1 + 2x 上，RSS = 0。

Which statement about evaluation is incorrect?关于评估，哪项错误？

  1. The test set may be used to choose hyperparameters as long as it is not used for training weights.只要不用于训练权重，就可以用测试集选择超参数。
  2. K-fold CV uses each fold once as the test fold.K 折交叉验证中每一折恰好作一次测试折。
  3. Adjusted R² accounts for the number of features.调整 R² 考虑了特征数量。
  4. AUC = 0.5 corresponds to random guessing.AUC = 0.5 相当于随机猜测。
Hyperparameters must be chosen with validation data, keeping the test set untouched.超参数必须用验证数据选择，测试集保持不动。

Which statement about SVMs is incorrect?关于 SVM，哪项错误？

  1. Support vectors are the training samples closest to the hyperplane.支持向量是离超平面最近的训练样本。
  2. Training is a convex quadratic programming problem.训练是凸二次规划问题。
  3. Kernels allow nonlinear decision boundaries.核函数允许非线性决策边界。
  4. SVMs perform best when the classes overlap heavily.类严重重叠时 SVM 表现最好。
Listed as a con: does not perform well for overlapping classes.讲义列为缺点：类重叠时效果不好。

Adding an irrelevant feature to a linear regression typically…在线性回归中加入一个无关特征通常会……

  1. decreases R²降低 R²
  2. increases (or keeps) R² but may decrease adjusted R²提高（或不变）R²，但可能降低调整 R²
  3. decreases RSS to zero使 RSS 降到 0
  4. has no effect on any metric对任何指标都无影响
R² tends to always increase with extra features.R² 往往随特征增加而增加。

9Image segmentation I: thresholding, connected components, region growing, watershed, MSER, mean shift, superpixels, CRF, active contours, level sets, evaluation图像分割 I：阈值、连通域、区域生长、分水岭、MSER、均值漂移、超像素、CRF、主动轮廓、水平集、评估

Slides: W5 Image Segmentation Part 1对应讲义：W5 Image Segmentation Part 1

🎯 Define segmentation and related tasks; count connected components with 4-/8-connectivity; describe each advanced method (how it works, strengths, weaknesses); compute sensitivity, specificity, precision, recall, F1, Jaccard and Dice; read ROC curves.🎯 定义分割及相关任务；按 4/8 邻接统计连通域；描述每种高级方法（原理、优缺点）；计算灵敏度、特异度、精确率、召回率、F1、Jaccard 和 Dice；读懂 ROC 曲线。

9.1 What is segmentation?9.1 什么是分割？

Partitioning an image into meaningful segments (regions) for further analysis — one of the oldest, most studied problems. Ideal: regions uniform in some characteristic, adjacent regions significantly different, interiors simple without holes, boundaries smooth and accurate — almost never the case. No single method works for all applications; domain knowledge is essential, and even within one domain (e.g. cell microscopy) images vary widely.把图像划分为有意义的片段（区域）以便进一步分析——最古老、研究最多的问题之一。理想情况：区域在某特性上均匀、相邻区域差别明显、内部简单无洞、边界平滑准确——几乎从不成立。没有一种方法适用于所有应用；领域知识必不可少，即使同一领域（如细胞显微图像）图像差异也很大。

9.2 Basic methods (recap)9.2 基本方法（回顾）

  • Thresholding: fine if regions have sufficiently different intensity distributions; poor if distributions overlap.阈值分割：区域强度分布差异足够大时可行；分布重叠时效果差。
  • K-means clustering (e.g. on colour): works if the number of clusters is known a priori.K-means 聚类（如按颜色）：需事先知道类数。
  • Feature-based pixel classification: compute features of a patch around each pixel and classify with a trained classifier — needs many training patches.基于特征的像素分类：对每个像素周围的图像块计算特征，再用训练好的分类器分类——需要大量训练块。

9.3 Region splitting/merging and connected components9.3 区域分裂/合并与连通域

Split the image recursively based on local statistics, merge pieces hierarchically, or combine both. Simplest: threshold (split) then find connected pixel regions (merge).依据局部统计递归分裂图像、层次合并，或二者结合。最简单：先阈值（分裂），再找连通像素区域（合并）。

CONNECTED COMPONENTS LABELLING (two passes)连通域标记（两遍扫描）
Pass 1: scan top-left → bottom-right; for each object pixel look at its already-visited neighbours (N4 or N8): none labelled ⇒ new label; some labelled ⇒ assign the smallest and record label equivalences. Pass 2: replace each label by the smallest equivalent label; background = 0. The number of objects depends on the connectivity (slide example: 10 objects with 4-connectivity vs 1 with 8-connectivity).第一遍：从左上到右下扫描；对每个目标像素查看已访问的邻居（N4 或 N8）：都没标签 ⇒ 新标签；有标签 ⇒ 取最小的，并记录标签等价关系。第二遍：把每个标签替换为其等价类中最小的标签；背景为 0。物体个数取决于邻接方式（讲义例子：4 邻接 10 个物体，8 邻接只有 1 个）。

Region growing: define a similarity measure; start from a seed pixel; add neighbouring pixels that are similar; repeat until no more similar pixels.区域生长：定义相似性度量；从种子像素出发；把相似的邻接像素加入；重复直到没有相似像素。

9.4 Watershed segmentation9.4 分水岭分割

MEYER'S FLOODING ALGORITHMMeyer 灌水算法
  1. Choose markers (e.g. local minima), each with a different label.选择标记（如局部极小），各赋不同标签。
  2. Put the neighbours of each marker into a priority queue (more similar gray value = higher priority).把每个标记的邻居放入优先队列（灰度越相近优先级越高）。
  3. Pop the highest-priority pixel; if its labelled neighbours all share one label, give it that label; push its never-queued unlabelled neighbours.弹出优先级最高的像素；若其已标记的邻居标签都相同，赋该标签；把从未入队的未标记邻居入队。
  4. Repeat until the queue is empty; unlabelled pixels = watershed lines.重复直到队列为空；未标记的像素 = 分水岭线。
Notes: images have many local minima ⇒ heavy over-segmentation; preprocess (smoothing) to reduce false minima, postprocess (basin merging), or use user-defined markers; invert the image or compute edges/gradient first so objects become basins.注意：图像有大量局部极小 ⇒ 严重过分割；可预处理（平滑）减少假极小、后处理（合并盆地）或用户指定标记；先反转图像或计算边缘/梯度，使目标成为盆地。

9.5 MSER, mean shift, superpixels, CRF9.5 MSER、均值漂移、超像素、CRF

  • Maximally stable extremal regions (MSER): try many thresholds and analyse the connected components; select regions whose shape stays virtually constant over many thresholds.最大稳定极值区域（MSER）：尝试大量阈值并分析连通域；选出在很多阈值下形状几乎不变的区域。
  • Mean shift (alternative to k-means, which needs K, is sensitive to outliers and local minima): seeks modes (peaks) of the density in feature space; does not need the number of clusters. Algorithm: (1) random seed x and window N; (2) weighted mean m(x)=∑K(xi​−x)∑xi​∈N(x)​K(xi​−x)xi​​, K(x)=e−∣x∣2; (3) shift the window to m(x); (4) repeat until convergence. Segmentation: map pixels to feature space (colour, gradients, texture…), start windows at many seeds (regular grid), merge seeds that converge close together, cluster pixels by where their windows end.均值漂移（k-means 的替代：k-means 需 K、对离群点敏感、易陷局部极小）：寻找特征空间中密度的峰（模式）；不需要事先知道类数。算法：(1) 随机种子 x 和窗口 N；(2) 加权均值 m(x)=∑K(xi​−x)∑xi​∈N(x)​K(xi​−x)xi​​，K(x)=e−∣x∣2；(3) 把窗口移到 m(x)；(4) 重复至收敛。用于分割：把像素映射到特征空间（颜色、梯度、纹理…），在许多种子（规则网格）处启动窗口，合并收敛到相近位置的种子，按窗口终点对像素聚类。
    ✓ model-free (no prior cluster shape), single parameter (window size/bandwidth), finds a variable number of modes, robust to outliers. ✗ computationally expensive, output depends on the window size, bandwidth selection not trivial, doesn't scale well with feature-space dimension.✓ 无模型（不假设类的形状）、只有一个参数（窗口大小/带宽）、能找到可变数量的模式、对离群点鲁棒。✗ 计算量大、结果依赖窗口大小、带宽难选、随特征维数增加扩展性差。
  • Superpixels: group similar pixels into an over-segmentation for efficiency; final segmentation done on superpixels.
