SLIC: (1) initialise centres on a grid with step S; (2) move each to the lowest-gradient position in its 3×3 window; (3) for each pixel in a 2S×2S window around Cj​, compute D=dlab2​+S2dxy2​​m2​ (CIELAB colour distance + spatial distance; m weighs colour vs space); (4) assign to the closest centre; (5) recompute centres (mean colour & position); (6) iterate until the residual error is small. Preserves boundaries, fast, memory efficient.超像素：把相似像素组成过分割以提高效率；最终分割在超像素上进行。SLIC：(1) 以步长 S 在网格上初始化中心；(2) 把中心移到 3×3 窗口内梯度最小处；(3) 对 Cj​ 周围 2S×2S 窗口内每个像素计算 D=dlab2​+S2dxy2​​m2​（CIELAB 颜色距离 + 空间距离；m 权衡颜色与空间）；(4) 分给最近的中心；(5) 重算中心（平均颜色和位置）；(6) 迭代直到残差很小。保边界、快、省内存。
  • Conditional random field (CRF): a probabilistic graphical model over superpixels — nodes = superpixels (feature values), edges = adjacency (similarity). Segmentation = energy minimisation E(s,c)=∑i​φ(si​,ci​)+∑ij​ψ(si​,sj​): unary (data) term = cost of superpixel si​ having class ci​ (e.g. from a classifier); pairwise (smoothness) term = cost when similar neighbours get different classes. Solved by graph cut (min-cut/max-flow: maximising flow from source to sink ⇔ minimising energy), possibly with multiple sources/sinks.条件随机场（CRF）：建立在超像素上的概率图模型——节点 = 超像素（特征值），边 = 邻接（相似度）。分割 = 能量最小化 E(s,c)=∑i​φ(si​,ci​)+∑ij​ψ(si​,sj​)：一元（数据）项 = 超像素 si​ 属于类 ci​ 的代价（如来自分类器）；二元（平滑）项 = 相似邻居被分到不同类时的代价。用图割求解（最小割/最大流：最大化源到汇的流 ⇔ 最小化能量），也可用多源/多汇。

9.6 Active contours (snakes) and level sets9.6 主动轮廓（蛇模型）与水平集

  • Active contours: contour-based; represent the curve by control points + interpolation; iteratively move the points to fit the boundary using image forces (follow high gradients), smoothness forces (bridge noisy or missing-gradient areas) and user guidance. Parametric/explicit: needs manual initialisation; hard to change topology; may need reparameterisation for big shape changes.主动轮廓：基于轮廓；用控制点 + 插值表示曲线；利用图像力（沿高梯度）、平滑力（跨越噪声或缺失梯度区域）和用户引导迭代移动控制点拟合边界。参数化/显式：需手动初始化；拓扑难以改变；形状变化大时需重新参数化。
  • Level sets: implicit — the boundary is the zero level set of a higher-dimensional function (2D contour = zero-level of a 3D surface); the function evolves to fit and track objects; easily handles topological changes (splitting/merging); more computationally demanding.水平集：隐式——边界是更高维函数的零水平集（二维轮廓 = 三维曲面的零水平线）；函数演化以拟合并跟踪目标；很容易处理拓扑变化（分裂/合并）；计算量更大。

9.7 Evaluating segmentation9.7 分割评估

With segmented object pixels S and true object pixels T: TP = S ∩ T, TN = Sᶜ ∩ Tᶜ, FP = S ∩ Tᶜ, FN = Sᶜ ∩ T.设分割出的目标像素为 S、真实目标像素为 T：TP = S ∩ T，TN = Sᶜ ∩ Tᶜ，FP = S ∩ Tᶜ，FN = Sᶜ ∩ T。

METRICS指标
Sens=TPR=TP+FNTP​Spec=TNR=TN+FPTN​P=TP+FPTP​F1​=R+P2RP​​
JSC (IoU)=∣S∪T∣∣S∩T∣​=FP+TP+FNTP​DSC=∣S∣+∣T∣2∣S∩T∣​=FP+2TP+FN2TP​​
ROC: plot TPR (sensitivity) vs FPR (1 − specificity) as a free parameter (e.g. the threshold τ from 0 to 256) varies; AUC 0.5 = random, 1.0 = best; higher AUC = better method. (DSC = F1 for binary segmentation; DSC = 2J/(1+J).)ROC：随某自由参数（如阈值 τ 从 0 到 256）变化，绘制 TPR（灵敏度）对 FPR（1 − 特异度）；AUC 0.5 = 随机，1.0 = 最好；AUC 越高方法越好。（二值分割中 DSC = F1；DSC = 2J/(1+J)。）

Practice — Section 9练习 — 第 9 节

(Sample-exam style) How many objects (white) does connected-components labelling find with 4-connectivity? (And with 8-connectivity?)（样题风格）用 4 邻接的连通域标记能找到多少个（白色）物体？（8 邻接呢？）

  1. 7
  2. 9
  3. 11
  4. 13
With 4-connectivity, pixels touching only diagonally are separate objects: 11. With 8-connectivity the diagonal pairs merge: 7 (top-left block + diagonal pixel, the two top-right pixels, the middle L-shape, the two left pixels, the two right pixels, the bottom L-shape, the bottom-right pair).4 邻接时只在对角相接的像素是不同物体：11 个。8 邻接时对角相邻的合并：7 个（左上方块 + 对角像素、右上两像素、中间 L 形、左侧两像素、右侧两像素、底部 L 形、右下两像素）。

(Sample exam) Which statement about segmentation methods is incorrect?（样题）关于分割方法，哪项错误？

  1. Thresholding yields poor results if regions have overlapping intensity distributions.区域强度分布重叠时阈值分割效果差。
  2. Level-set segmentation uses a boundary representation that makes it hard to deal with topological changes.水平集分割使用的边界表示使其难以处理拓扑变化。
  3. Region splitting techniques aim to optimise intra-region similarity and inter-region dissimilarity.区域分裂技术旨在优化区域内相似性和区域间差异性。
  4. Watershed segmentation often results in over-segmentation because regions may contain multiple local minima.分水岭分割常导致过分割，因为区域可能包含多个局部极小。
Level sets handle topological changes easily; it is active contours (explicit) that struggle.水平集很容易处理拓扑变化；困难的是（显式的）主动轮廓。

A segmentation has TP = 60, FP = 20, FN = 20 pixels. Jaccard (IoU) and Dice?某分割 TP = 60、FP = 20、FN = 20 像素。Jaccard（IoU）与 Dice？

  1. 0.60, 0.75
  2. 0.75, 0.60
  3. 0.75, 0.86
  4. 0.60, 0.60
J = 60/100 = 0.6; D = 120/160 = 0.75 = 2J/(1+J).

Which is an advantage of mean shift over k-means for colour segmentation?颜色分割中均值漂移相对 k-means 的优点是？

  1. It is computationally cheaper计算更便宜
  2. It has no parameters at all完全没有参数
  3. It scales well to very high-dimensional feature spaces在超高维特征空间中扩展性好
  4. It does not require knowing the number of clusters and is robust to outliers不需要知道类数，且对离群点鲁棒
It still has one parameter (bandwidth) and is expensive.它仍有一个参数（带宽），且计算昂贵。

In a CRF segmentation energy, the pairwise term…CRF 分割能量中的二元项……

  1. measures how likely each superpixel belongs to a class based on its own features依据自身特征衡量每个超像素属于某类的可能性
  2. counts the number of superpixels统计超像素个数
  3. imposes a cost when similar neighbouring superpixels receive different labels当相似的相邻超像素被赋予不同标签时施加代价
  4. is the gradient magnitude是梯度幅值
(A) is the unary/data term.（A）是一元/数据项。

Which statement about watershed segmentation is correct?关于分水岭分割，哪项正确？

  1. It always produces exactly one region per object.总是每个物体恰好一个区域。
  2. Smoothing beforehand or using markers reduces over-segmentation.事先平滑或使用标记可以减少过分割。
  3. It requires the number of regions in advance.需要事先给定区域数。
  4. Watershed lines are the local minima.分水岭线就是局部极小。
Watershed lines are the dams where basins meet.分水岭线是盆地相遇处的“坝”。

In SLIC, the parameter m…SLIC 中的参数 m……

  1. weighs the influence of spatial distance relative to colour distance权衡空间距离相对颜色距离的影响
  2. is the number of superpixels是超像素个数
  3. is the threshold for MSER是 MSER 的阈值
  4. is the mean-shift bandwidth是均值漂移带宽
D=dlab2​+(dxy​/S)2m2​: larger m ⇒ more compact, regular superpixels.m 越大 ⇒ 超像素越紧凑规则。

MSER selects regions that…MSER 选择的区域是……

  1. have the highest mean intensity平均强度最高的
  2. are local minima of the gradient梯度局部极小的
  3. are grown from user seeds由用户种子生长的
  4. keep virtually the same shape over a wide range of thresholds在很宽的阈值范围内形状几乎不变的
"Maximally stable".即“最大稳定”。

For a thresholding method, the ROC curve is obtained by…对阈值分割方法，ROC 曲线如何得到？

  1. plotting precision against recall for one threshold对单个阈值绘制精确率对召回率
  2. plotting Dice against the threshold绘制 Dice 对阈值
  3. computing sensitivity and 1 − specificity for all thresholds and plotting TPR against FPR对所有阈值计算灵敏度和 1 − 特异度，绘制 TPR 对 FPR
  4. plotting the histogram绘制直方图
Compare methods by the area under the curve.用曲线下面积比较方法。

10Image segmentation II: mathematical morphology (binary & gray-scale)图像分割 II：数学形态学（二值与灰度）

Slides: W5 Image Segmentation Part 2对应讲义：W5 Image Segmentation Part 2

🎯 Define dilation, erosion, opening, closing with structuring elements; design algorithms from them (edges, outlines, reconstruction, removing border objects, filling holes, distance transform, ultimate erosion, separating touching objects, Voronoi, skeleton); extend to gray-scale (umbra, max/min filters, smoothing, gradient, Laplacian, top-hat).🎯 用结构元定义膨胀、腐蚀、开、闭；由它们设计算法（边缘、轮廓、重建、去除边界物体、填洞、距离变换、极限腐蚀、分离粘连物体、Voronoi、骨架）；推广到灰度（本影、最大/最小滤波、平滑、梯度、拉普拉斯、顶帽）。

Mathematical morphology = nonlinear image processing based on set theory. Used to clean up background/object noise, separate touching objects, close holes, extract contours, compute distances. A binary image is a set of foreground coordinates I={(x,y)}. Set operations: translation Ax​, reflection Ar={−a}, complement Ac, union, intersection, difference A−B, cardinality |A|.数学形态学 = 基于集合论的非线性图像处理。用于清除背景/目标噪声、分离粘连目标、填洞、提取轮廓、计算距离。二值图像是前景坐标的集合 I={(x,y)}。集合运算：平移 Ax​、反射 Ar={−a}、补集 Ac、并、交、差 A−B、基数 |A|。

10.1 Binary dilation, erosion, opening, closing10.1 二值膨胀、腐蚀、开运算、闭运算

DEFINITIONS (S = structuring element, dot = origin)定义（S = 结构元，点 = 原点）
I⊕S={x∣Sxr​∩I=∅}I⊖S={x∣Sx​⊆I}​
I∘S=(I⊖S)⊕S  (opening)I∙S=(I⊕S)⊖S  (closing)​
Dilation adds pixels (grows objects, fills small gaps); erosion removes pixels (shrinks objects, deletes small ones). Opening eliminates details smaller than S outside the object (thin protrusions, small specks); closing eliminates details smaller than S inside the object (small holes, gaps). Any shape of S is possible; the symmetric 3×3 square is used most.膨胀增加像素（目标变大、填小缝）；腐蚀去掉像素（目标变小、删小目标）。开运算消除目标外部比 S 小的细节（细小突起、小斑点）；闭运算消除目标内部比 S 小的细节（小洞、缝隙）。S 可为任意形状；最常用对称的 3×3 方块。

Dimensional decomposition: dilating/eroding with the 3×3 square = doing it with a 1×3 row then a 3×1 column (faster); larger elements = iterate small ones (I⊕5×5=(I⊕3×3)⊕3×3).维度分解：用 3×3 方块膨胀/腐蚀 = 先用 1×3 行、再用 3×1 列（更快）；大结构元 = 迭代小结构元（I⊕5×5=(I⊕3×3)⊕3×3）。

10.2 Morphological algorithms (binary)10.2 形态学算法（二值）

Goal目标Recipe做法
Edges (inner + outer)边缘（内 + 外）(I⊕S)−(I⊖S)
One-pixel-thick outline单像素厚的轮廓inner: I−(I⊖S); outer: (I⊕S)−I内轮廓：I−(I⊖S)；外轮廓：(I⊕S)−I
Reconstruction重建 (keep selected objects)（保留选中的物体）marker R0​ = seed pixels inside the wanted objects; iterate Ri​=(Ri−1​⊕S)∩I until Ri​=Ri−1​ (conditional dilation)标记 R0​ = 目标物体内的种子；迭代 Ri​=(Ri−1​⊕S)∩I 直到 Ri​=Ri−1​（条件膨胀）
Remove objects touching the border去除接触边界的物体seeds B = border pixels of I; reconstruct R from B; output O=I−R种子 B = I 的边界像素；从 B 重建 R；输出 O=I−R
Fill all holes填充所有洞take Ic; seeds = border pixels of Ic; reconstruct R of Ic; output Rc取 Ic；种子 = Ic 的边界像素；在 Ic 中重建 R；输出 Rc
Distance transform距离变换Ii​=Ii−1​⊖S; pixels eroded in iteration i get value i ⇒ distance to backgroundIi​=Ii−1​⊖S；第 i 次被腐蚀掉的像素赋值 i ⇒ 到背景的距离
Ultimate erosion (object centres)极限腐蚀（物体中心）local maxima of the distance transform (= last pixels before an object vanishes)距离变换的局部极大（= 物体消失前的最后像素）
Separate touching objects分离粘连物体ultimate erosion, then reconstruction with the constraint that objects may not merge (works best for roughly circular objects; elongated ones give multiple maxima)先极限腐蚀，再在“物体不得合并”约束下重建（最适合近似圆形物体；细长物体会有多个极大）
Ultimate dilation极限膨胀dilate repeatedly without merging ⇒ Voronoi (Dirichlet) tessellation: background points equidistant to objects在不合并约束下反复膨胀 ⇒ Voronoi（Dirichlet）镶嵌：与各物体等距的背景点
Skeletonisation骨架化repeated conditional erosion (thinning) that doesn't break connectivity and keeps single/end pixels ⇒ one-pixel-thick centreline反复做不破坏连通性、保留孤立/端点像素的条件腐蚀（细化）⇒ 单像素中心线

All of this extends to nD (3D: 3×3×3 voxel element; 3D dilation, erosion, opening, closing…).以上都可推广到 n 维（三维：3×3×3 体素结构元；三维膨胀、腐蚀、开、闭……）。

10.3 Gray-scale morphology10.3 灰度形态学

A 2D gray-scale image = a 3D binary image: each column is a stack of voxels with height = gray value; the landscape surface with the volume below is the umbra U(I). Gray-scale dilation/erosion = binary dilation/erosion of the umbrae, converted back: I⊕S=U−1[U(I)⊕U(S)].二维灰度图 = 三维二值图：每列是一摞体素，高度 = 灰度值；地形表面连同其下方体积称为本影 U(I)。灰度膨胀/腐蚀 = 对本影做二值膨胀/腐蚀再转换回来：I⊕S=U−1[U(I)⊕U(S)]。

(I⊕S)(x)=pmax​{I(x−p)+S(p)}(I⊖S)(x)=pmin​{I(x+p)−S(p)}​

For a flat, symmetric S: dilation = local max filter, erosion = local min filter. Opening/closing defined as before.对平坦、对称的 S：膨胀 = 局部最大值滤波，腐蚀 = 局部最小值滤波。开、闭定义同前。

  • Morphological smoothing: opening removes bright structures smaller than S; closing removes dark ones — size- and shape-selective, impossible with linear filters.形态学平滑：开运算去除比 S 小的亮结构；闭运算去除暗结构——按尺寸和形状选择，线性滤波做不到。
  • Gradient: G=D−E (dilated − eroded) = outer gradient D−I + inner gradient I−E. Laplacian: L=D+E−2I (outer − inner gradient).梯度：G=D−E（膨胀 − 腐蚀）= 外梯度 D−I + 内梯度 I−E。拉普拉斯：L=D+E−2I（外梯度 − 内梯度）。
  • Top-hat filtering: subtract an opening (white top-hat: I−I∘S) or use a closing (black top-hat) with a large S to remove background shading while keeping small structures.顶帽滤波：减去开运算结果（白顶帽：I−I∘S）或用闭运算（黑顶帽），使用大结构元以去除背景阴影并保留小结构。
SUMMARY小结
Binary (after segmentation, postprocessing): close holes, find inner/outer outlines, detect and separate touching objects, extract representative shapes, compute distances. Gray-scale (before segmentation, preprocessing): remove gray-scale noise, remove background shading, remove unwanted structures.二值（分割后，后处理）：填洞、求内/外轮廓、检测并分离粘连物体、提取代表形状、计算距离。灰度（分割前，预处理）：去灰度噪声、去背景阴影、去除不需要的结构。

Practice — Section 10练习 — 第 10 节

(Sample exam) Binary input I: (1) copy C = I; (2) copy the boundary pixels of C into B; (3) compute the reconstruction R of C from B; (4) O = I − R. What does O contain?（样题）二值输入 I：(1) C = I 的副本；(2) 把 C 的边界像素复制到 B；(3) 以 B 为种子在 C 中重建得 R；(4) O = I − R。O 包含什么？

  1. The same objects as the input whatever the input无论输入如何都与输入相同
  2. The same objects but with holes filled相同物体但洞被填上
  3. The same objects except the boundary objects除接触边界的物体外的其余物体
  4. The same objects with touching objects separated相同物体但粘连的被分开
R = all objects that touch the image border; subtracting removes them.R = 所有接触图像边界的物体；相减后将其去除。

(Sample exam) Goal: binary edge image of the objects using only thresholding, dilation/erosion and subtraction. Which algorithm will not work?（样题）目标：只用阈值、膨胀/腐蚀和减法得到物体的二值边缘图。哪种算法不能实现？

  1. Threshold (T), erode (E), subtract E − T阈值（T），腐蚀（E），相减 E − T
  2. Erode (E), subtract I − E, threshold腐蚀（E），相减 I − E，再阈值
  3. Threshold (T), dilate (D), subtract D − T阈值（T），膨胀（D），相减 D − T
  4. Dilate (D), subtract D − I, threshold膨胀（D），相减 D − I，再阈值
E ⊆ T, so E − T is empty (should be T − E). B: gray inner gradient then threshold ✓; C: outer edge ✓; D: gray outer gradient then threshold ✓.E ⊆ T，所以 E − T 为空（应为 T − E）。B：灰度内梯度再阈值 ✓；C：外边缘 ✓；D：灰度外梯度再阈值 ✓。

To remove small isolated white specks (noise) outside objects in a binary image, use…要去除二值图中物体外部的小白点（噪声），应使用……

  1. closing闭运算
  2. opening开运算
  3. dilation alone只膨胀
  4. ultimate dilation极限膨胀
Erosion deletes them, dilation restores the larger objects.腐蚀删除它们，膨胀恢复较大的物体。

Small dark holes inside bright objects are removed by…亮物体内部的小暗洞用什么去除？

  1. erosion腐蚀
  2. opening开运算
  3. skeletonisation骨架化
  4. closing闭运算
Closing removes details smaller than S inside the object.闭运算去除物体内部比 S 小的细节。

For a flat symmetric structuring element, gray-scale dilation is equivalent to…对平坦对称结构元，灰度膨胀等价于……

  1. a mean filter均值滤波
  2. a median filter中值滤波
  3. a local maximum filter局部最大值滤波
  4. a local minimum filter局部最小值滤波
Erosion = local min.腐蚀 = 局部最小。

How do you find representative centre points of roughly circular blobs?如何找到近似圆形斑点的代表中心点？

  1. skeletonisation骨架化
  2. ultimate erosion: local maxima of the distance transform极限腐蚀：距离变换的局部极大
  3. morphological gradient形态学梯度
  4. Voronoi tessellationVoronoi 镶嵌
Combine with constrained reconstruction to separate touching blobs.再结合约束重建即可分离粘连斑点。

Which recipe fills all holes in all objects?哪种做法能填充所有物体中的所有洞？

  1. Reconstruct the complement Ic from its border pixels, then take the complement of the result以 Ic 的边界像素为种子在 Ic 中重建，再对结果取补
  2. Dilate once with a 3×3 square用 3×3 方块膨胀一次
  3. Subtract the eroded image from I用 I 减去腐蚀结果
  4. Compute the distance transform计算距离变换
Background connected to the border is "real" background; whatever is not reached are holes.与边界连通的才是真正背景；没被重建到的就是洞。

A microscope image has uneven background illumination. Which gray-scale operation helps most before thresholding?显微图像背景光照不均。阈值前哪种灰度运算最有帮助？

  1. morphological Laplacian形态学拉普拉斯
  2. binary skeleton二值骨架
  3. dilation with a 3×3 element3×3 膨胀
  4. top-hat filtering with a large structuring element大结构元的顶帽滤波
The opening/closing with a large S estimates the background; subtracting it removes the shading.大结构元的开/闭估计背景；相减即去除阴影。

11Deep learning I: from linear classifiers to CNNs, architectures (LeNet → ViT), training深度学习 I：从线性分类器到 CNN、经典结构（LeNet → ViT）、训练

Slides: W7 Deep Learning Part 1-1 & 1-2对应讲义：W7 Deep Learning Part 1-1 & 1-2

🎯 Explain why nonlinearity and depth; list CNN building blocks and convolution hyper-parameters (channels, filter size, stride, padding, dilation); compute output sizes and parameter counts; know the landmark architectures and their key idea; diagnose over/underfitting and apply the remedies; explain data augmentation and transfer learning.🎯 解释为何需要非线性与深度；列出 CNN 组件和卷积超参数（通道、卷积核大小、步长、填充、膨胀）；计算输出尺寸和参数量；了解里程碑结构及其核心思想；诊断过/欠拟合并应用对策；解释数据增强与迁移学习。

11.1 From linear classifiers to deep networks11.1 从线性分类器到深度网络

Vision challenges: viewpoint variation, illumination, occlusion (hidden parts), background clutter. A linear classifier f(x)=Wx+b (a single-layer network: one template per class) fails on hard cases; better hand-crafted features help but cannot always solve them. Stack layers: f=W2​max(0,W1​x) — a 2-layer MLP of fully connected (FC) layers. The activation function (ReLU = max(0, z) is a good default; also sigmoid, tanh, leaky ReLU, maxout, ELU) is essential: without it the whole network is linear. Deep learning = machine learning with deep networks; relies on large data and deep architectures (CNNs, RNNs, GANs, Transformers…). Applications: classification, detection, segmentation, depth estimation, NeRF 3D, deblurring, captioning, VQA, text-to-image (DALL·E).视觉挑战：视角变化、光照、遮挡（部分不可见）、背景杂乱。线性分类器 f(x)=Wx+b（单层网络：每类一个模板）在困难情形下失败；更好的手工特征有帮助但不总能解决。叠加多层：f=W2​max(0,W1​x)——由全连接（FC）层构成的两层 MLP。激活函数（ReLU = max(0, z) 是很好的默认选择；还有 sigmoid、tanh、leaky ReLU、maxout、ELU）至关重要：没有它整个网络就是线性的。深度学习 = 使用深层网络的机器学习；依赖大数据和深层结构（CNN、RNN、GAN、Transformer…）。应用：分类、检测、分割、深度估计、NeRF 三维、去模糊、图像描述、视觉问答、文生图（DALL·E）。

11.2 Convolutional neural networks11.2 卷积神经网络

A CNN is composed of convolution, pooling and fully connected layers and automatically and adaptively learns spatial hierarchies of features by backpropagation: edges/lines early → object parts → whole-object representations, gradually transforming the image into a representation where classes are linearly separable. Advantages: automatic, hierarchical feature extraction (no hand-crafted features); parameter sharing (efficient); translation invariance; transfer learning via pre-training; robustness; scalability.CNN 由卷积层、池化层和全连接层组成，通过反向传播自动、自适应地学习空间层次特征：前面层学边缘/线条 → 物体部件 → 整体物体表示，逐步把图像变换到类别线性可分的表示。优点：自动、层次化地提取特征（无需手工特征）；参数共享（高效）；平移不变；可通过预训练做迁移学习；鲁棒；可扩展。

BUILDING BLOCKS组件
  • Convolution layer: several filters extract features; computes the dot product of each filter with local input regions. A filter extends through the full depth of the input (5×5×3 on an RGB image); per-channel responses are summed ⇒ one activation map per filter; F filters ⇒ F output channels (out_channels; in_channels = previous out_channels).卷积层：多个滤波器提取特征；计算每个滤波器与局部输入区域的点积。滤波器贯穿输入的整个深度（RGB 图上为 5×5×3）；各通道响应求和 ⇒ 每个滤波器一张激活图；F 个滤波器 ⇒ F 个输出通道（out_channels；in_channels = 上一层的 out_channels）。
  • ReLU: element-wise, negatives → 0, introduces nonlinearity ⇒ rectified feature map.ReLU：逐元素，负数 → 0，引入非线性 ⇒ 整流特征图。
  • Pooling: down-sampling that reduces feature-map size (max/average pooling).池化：下采样，减小特征图尺寸（最大/平均池化）。
  • Flattening: multi-dimensional maps → 1D vector for FC layers.展平：多维特征图 → 一维向量，供全连接层使用。
  • FC layers and the output layer (one neuron per class, softmax ⇒ probabilities summing to 1).全连接层与输出层（每类一个神经元，softmax ⇒ 和为 1 的概率）。

Local connectivity: each neuron connects only to a local spatial region of the input (its receptive field) but to the full depth. Neurons in the same activation map share parameters.局部连接：每个神经元只连接输入的局部空间区域（其感受野），但贯穿全部深度。同一激活图中的神经元共享参数。

CONVOLUTION HYPER-PARAMETERS & SIZES卷积超参数与尺寸
  • Filter size: 3×3, 5×5… (odd sizes preferred: input pixels symmetric around the output pixel; avoid very large filters — more weights to learn).卷积核大小：3×3、5×5…（偏好奇数：输入像素围绕输出像素对称；避免过大——要学的权重更多）。
  • Stride: pixels moved per step; larger stride ⇒ smaller output, broader/more global features.步长：每步移动的像素数；步长越大 ⇒ 输出越小、特征越全局。
  • Padding: extra pixels around the border to control output size and keep border information. Modes: zeros, reflect ([1,2,3,4] → [2,1,2,3,4,3]), replicate ([1,1,2,3,4,4]), circular ([4,1,2,3,4,1]).填充：在边界外加像素以控制输出尺寸、保留边界信息。模式：零填充、反射（[1,2,3,4] → [2,1,2,3,4,3]）、复制（[1,1,2,3,4,4]）、循环（[4,1,2,3,4,1]）。
  • Dilation: spacing between kernel elements ⇒ larger receptive field without more weights (3×3 with dilation 2 covers 5×5).膨胀（空洞）：卷积核元素之间留间隔 ⇒ 不增加权重而扩大感受野（膨胀率 2 的 3×3 覆盖 5×5）。
output=(1+sJ+2P−M​)×(1+sK+2P−N​)#params=F×(M⋅N⋅Cin​+1)​
AlexNet CONV1 (lecture)AlexNet 第一卷积层（讲义）
Input 227×227×3, 96 kernels 11×11, stride 4, no padding ⇒ 1 + (227 − 11)/4 = 55 ⇒ 96 maps of 55×55; parameters = 96 × (11·11·3 + 1) = 34,944.输入 227×227×3，96 个 11×11 卷积核，步长 4，无填充 ⇒ 1 + (227 − 11)/4 = 55 ⇒ 96 张 55×55 特征图；参数 = 96 × (11·11·3 + 1) = 34,944。

11.3 Datasets and landmark architectures11.3 数据集与里程碑结构

MNIST (70,000 grayscale 28×28 digits), CIFAR-10 (60,000 colour 32×32, 10 classes, 50k/10k split; CIFAR-100), ImageNet (14M images, 21k+ classes, ~1M with boxes; ILSVRC with 1000 classes), COCO (detection, segmentation, captioning).MNIST（7 万张 28×28 灰度数字）、CIFAR-10（6 万张 32×32 彩色、10 类、5 万/1 万划分；另有 CIFAR-100）、ImageNet（1400 万张、2.1 万多类、约 100 万张带框；ILSVRC 用 1000 类）、COCO（检测、分割、描述）。

Model模型Key idea核心思想
LeNet-5 (1989)first use of backprop to learn visual features; 2 conv (no padding, stride 1) + 3 FC; subsampling stride 2; scaled tanh首次用反向传播学习视觉特征；2 个卷积（无填充、步长 1）+ 3 个 FC；步长 2 下采样；缩放 tanh
AlexNet (2012)ILSVRC winner; 8 layers (5 conv + 3 FC); ReLU; local response normalisation; data augmentation; dropout; 2 GPUsILSVRC 冠军；8 层（5 卷积 + 3 FC）；ReLU；局部响应归一化；数据增强；dropout；两块 GPU
VGG (2014)stacks of small 3×3 kernels instead of 11×11/5×5; deeper, more nonlinearity, fewer parameters; removed LRN; VGG-19 ≈ 144M params用堆叠的小 3×3 核代替 11×11/5×5；更深、非线性更强、参数更少；去掉 LRN；VGG-19 约 1.44 亿参数
GoogLeNet (2014)Inception module: parallel multi-size filters concatenated channel-wise; auxiliary losses; global average pooling before the final FC (fewer parameters); 22 layersInception 模块：多尺寸卷积并行、按通道拼接；辅助损失；最后 FC 前用全局平均池化（减少参数）；22 层
ResNet (2015)deeper plain nets got worse training and test error (not overfitting) ⇒ residual/skip connections carry identity forward and preserve the gradient更深的普通网络训练和测试误差都更差（不是过拟合）⇒ 残差/跳跃连接把恒等映射前传并保留梯度
SENetsqueeze-and-excitation: content-aware channel weighting using global information挤压–激励：利用全局信息对通道加权
DenseNetdense blocks: each layer connected to all previous ones; transition layers (1×1 conv, average pooling)稠密块：每层连接到之前所有层；过渡层（1×1 卷积、平均池化）
EfficientNetcompound scaling: uniformly scale depth, width (channels) and resolution with fixed coefficients复合缩放：用固定系数同时均匀缩放深度、宽度（通道）和分辨率
ViT (2020)"An image is worth 16×16 words": split into patches, linear patch embedding (= a conv with kernel = stride = patch size), learnable <cls> token, positional embeddings, Transformer encoder (LayerNorm, multi-head self-attention, GELU, dropout); many modern ViTs use global average pooling instead of <cls>“一张图值 16×16 个词”：切成图像块，线性块嵌入（= 核大小 = 步长 = 块大小的卷积），可学习的 <cls> 词元，位置嵌入，Transformer 编码器（LayerNorm、多头自注意力、GELU、dropout）；很多现代 ViT 用全局平均池化代替 <cls>
ConvNeXt (2022)a ConvNet modernised with Transformer-era design ("patchify" stem, etc.), restoring image-specific inductive biases用 Transformer 时代的设计（“patchify” 输入层等）现代化的卷积网络，保留图像特有的归纳偏置
WHY SMALL KERNELS (VGG)为什么用小卷积核（VGG）
Three stacked 3×3 conv layers (stride 1) have the same effective receptive field as one 7×7 layer, but with C channels: 3×(3⋅3⋅C)⋅C=27C2 vs 7⋅7⋅C⋅C=49C2 parameters, and three nonlinearities instead of one.三层堆叠的 3×3 卷积（步长 1）与一层 7×7 的有效感受野相同，但在 C 个通道下参数为 3×(3⋅3⋅C)⋅C=27C2 vs 7⋅7⋅C⋅C=49C2，且有三个非线性而不是一个。

Trends: foundation models (LVMs, LLMs, VLMs), multimodal AI, reasoning & agentic AI, generative AI (diffusion, flow matching), embodied vision (VLA), efficient adaptation (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), continual/test-time learning, efficient AI (distillation, quantisation, sparse MoE), responsible AI.趋势：基础模型（LVM、LLM、VLM）、多模态 AI、推理与智能体 AI、生成式 AI（扩散、流匹配）、具身视觉（VLA）、高效适配（LoRA、PEFT、RLHF）、持续/测试时学习、高效 AI（蒸馏、量化、稀疏 MoE）、可信 AI。

11.4 Training CNNs11.4 训练 CNN

Loss: usually categorical cross-entropy; minimised by gradient-based optimisers (SGD, momentum, Nesterov, AdaGrad, AdaDelta, RMSProp, Adam) with backpropagation. Small training error ≠ small test error: monitor training and validation loss. Underfitting: poor on both. Overfitting: good on training, poor on validation.损失通常为类别交叉熵；用基于梯度的优化器（SGD、动量、Nesterov、AdaGrad、AdaDelta、RMSProp、Adam）配合反向传播最小化。训练误差小 ≠ 测试误差小：同时监控训练与验证损失。欠拟合：两者都差。过拟合：训练好、验证差。

MITIGATING OVERFITTING缓解过拟合
  • More training data — costly, time-consuming, may need experts.更多训练数据——昂贵、耗时，可能需要专家。
  • Early stopping — stop when validation performance starts to degrade; trigger = no improvement / a decrease over some epochs; use some "patience".早停——验证性能开始下降时停止；触发条件 = 若干轮无改进/下降；设置一定“耐心”。
  • Data augmentation — generate new training data by transforming existing data: noise, cropping, flipping, rotation, scaling, translation, brightness, contrast, saturation, even GANs. Handles data scarcity and improves robustness; does not change the model.数据增强——对已有数据做变换生成新训练数据：加噪、裁剪、翻转、旋转、缩放、平移、亮度、对比度、饱和度，甚至 GAN。缓解数据不足、提高鲁棒性；不改变模型。
  • Regularisation: weight decay (L1: absolute values; L2: squared magnitudes) added to the loss; dropout randomly drops neurons during training.正则化：在损失中加权重衰减（L1：绝对值；L2：平方）；dropout 在训练中随机丢弃神经元。
  • Batch normalisation: stable, faster training; reduces internal covariate shift and the dependence of gradients on parameter scale.批归一化：训练更稳更快；减少内部协变量偏移以及梯度对参数尺度的依赖。

Preprocessing: pixel normalisation (to 0–1), centring (zero mean), standardisation (zero mean, unit variance). Hyperparameters (learning rate, epochs, dropout rate, batch size, # layers/units, activation, initialisation…) are set before training; tune by values from similar work/experience ("part art, part science"), grid search, or automated search (Bayesian optimisation, evolutionary; Optuna, Hyperopt).预处理：像素归一化（到 0–1）、中心化（零均值）、标准化（零均值单位方差）。超参数（学习率、轮数、dropout 率、批大小、层数/单元数、激活、初始化…）在训练前设定；调参方法：借鉴类似工作/经验（“一半艺术一半科学”）、网格搜索、自动搜索（贝叶斯优化、进化算法；Optuna、Hyperopt）。

TRANSFER LEARNING迁移学习
Leverage knowledge learned on a resource-rich source domain/task to help a low-resource target task (sometimes called domain adaptation): take a pretrained model (e.g. on ImageNet) and fine-tune it — with little data, freeze most layers and retrain the last (FC) layer(s); with more data, fine-tune more layers. Works best when the source features are general (domain-independent). Common in all applications (detection, captioning…).利用在资源丰富的源领域/任务上学到的知识，帮助资源匮乏的目标任务（有时称域适应）：拿一个预训练模型（如 ImageNet）进行微调——数据少时冻结大部分层、只重训最后（FC）层；数据多时微调更多层。源特征越通用（与领域无关）效果越好。在各种应用（检测、图像描述…）中都很常见。

(Sample exam) What is the purpose of convolutional layers in CNNs?（样题）CNN 中卷积层的作用是？

  1. Reducing the size of the feature maps减小特征图尺寸
  2. Calculating the dot product of the input and kernels计算输入与卷积核的点积
  3. Applying a nonlinear activation function施加非线性激活函数

(A) pooling; (C) ReLU layer.（A）是池化；（C）是 ReLU 层。

(Sample exam) The key benefit of CNNs over traditional ANNs for image classification?（样题）图像分类中 CNN 相对传统 ANN 的关键优势？

MLPs are also nonlinear; the distinctive benefit is learned spatial feature hierarchies.MLP 也是非线性的；独特优势是学习空间特征层次。

(Sample exam) The purpose of transfer learning?（样题）迁移学习的目的？

(Sample exam) Which statement about data augmentation for CNN classification is correct?（样题）关于 CNN 分类的数据增强，哪项正确？

Flip, crop, rotate, scale, noise, colour jitter…翻转、裁剪、旋转、缩放、加噪、颜色扰动……

Input 32×32×3, 10 filters of 5×5, padding 2, stride 1. Output size and number of parameters?输入 32×32×3，10 个 5×5 滤波器，填充 2，步长 1。输出尺寸与参数量？

  1. 32×32×10; 760
  2. 28×28×10; 750
  3. 32×32×10; 250
  4. 30×30×10; 760
1 + (32 + 4 − 5)/1 = 32; 10 × (5·5·3 + 1) = 760.

Why did VGG replace a 7×7 convolution by three 3×3 convolutions?VGG 为什么用三个 3×3 卷积替换一个 7×7 卷积？

  1. Larger receptive field感受野更大
  2. Fewer layers层数更少
  3. To remove the need for pooling不再需要池化
  4. Same receptive field with fewer parameters (27C² vs 49C²) and more nonlinearities感受野相同但参数更少（27C² vs 49C²）且非线性更多
Effective receptive field of three stacked 3×3 = 7×7.三层 3×3 的有效感受野 = 7×7。

A 56-layer plain CNN has higher training error than a 20-layer one. ResNet's explanation and fix?56 层普通 CNN 的训练误差高于 20 层的。ResNet 的解释与解决办法？

  1. Overfitting — add dropout过拟合——加 dropout
  2. Too little data — augment数据太少——数据增强
  3. Optimisation difficulty (degradation), not overfitting — add residual skip connections优化困难（退化），而非过拟合——加入残差跳跃连接
  4. Learning rate too high — use Adam学习率太高——用 Adam
A deeper model should be at least as good (it could learn identity layers); skip connections make that easy.更深的模型至少应一样好（可学成恒等层）；跳跃连接让这变得容易。

A ViT with 16×16 patches on a 224×224 image processes how many patch tokens (excluding <cls>)?ViT 在 224×224 图像上用 16×16 的块，处理多少个块词元（不含 <cls>）？

  1. 196
  2. 256
  3. 14
  4. 3,136
(224/16)² = 14² = 196.

What does dilation (2) do to a 3×3 convolution?膨胀率 2 对 3×3 卷积有什么作用？

  1. Doubles the number of weights权重数加倍
  2. Enlarges the receptive field to 5×5 with the same 9 weights用同样 9 个权重把感受野扩大到 5×5
  3. Halves the output size输出尺寸减半
  4. Applies the filter twice应用滤波器两次
Every other pixel of a 5×5 window affects the output.5×5 窗口中每隔一个像素参与计算。

Training loss keeps decreasing while validation loss increases after epoch 20. Which is the least appropriate response?第 20 轮后训练损失持续下降而验证损失上升。以下哪种做法最不合适？

  1. Early stopping around epoch 20在第 20 轮左右早停
  2. Data augmentation数据增强
  3. Dropout / weight decayDropout / 权重衰减
  4. Train much longer and add more layers训练更久并加更多层
That's overfitting; more capacity and longer training worsen it.这是过拟合；更大容量和更长训练会加剧它。

Which is the main idea of GoogLeNet?GoogLeNet 的核心思想是？

  1. Residual connections残差连接
  2. Compound scaling复合缩放
  3. Inception modules: parallel multi-size filters concatenated channel-wise, plus global average poolingInception 模块：多尺寸滤波器并行、按通道拼接，加全局平均池化
  4. Patch embeddings with self-attention块嵌入 + 自注意力
Also auxiliary losses for extra supervision.另有辅助损失提供额外监督。

12Deep learning II: object detection (R-CNN family, SSD, YOLO, FPN, RetinaNet)深度学习 II：目标检测（R-CNN 系列、SSD、YOLO、FPN、RetinaNet）

Slides: W8 Deep Learning Part 2-1对应讲义：W8 Deep Learning Part 2-1

🎯 Compute IoU; explain why detection is harder than classification; trace the evolution R-CNN → SPP-Net → Fast R-CNN → Faster R-CNN (what bottleneck each removed); explain anchors, RPN, NMS, OHEM; contrast two-stage and one-stage detectors (SSD, YOLO); explain FPN and focal loss/RetinaNet.🎯 计算 IoU；解释检测为何比分类难；理清 R-CNN → SPP-Net → Fast R-CNN → Faster R-CNN 的演进（各自解决了哪个瓶颈）；解释锚框、RPN、NMS、OHEM；对比两阶段与单阶段检测器（SSD、YOLO）；解释 FPN、focal loss 与 RetinaNet。

12.1 Detection = what + where12.1 检测 = 是什么 + 在哪里

Classification: one label per image. Detection: locate objects with bounding boxes (x,y,w,h) and classify them. Semantic segmentation: label every pixel. Instance segmentation: also distinguish instances. For one object, a CNN with two FC heads: class scores (e.g. 4096 → 1000, cross-entropy loss) and box coordinates (4096 → 4, L2 regression loss), trained jointly.分类：整图一个标签。检测：用边界框 (x,y,w,h) 定位目标并分类。语义分割：每个像素一个标签。实例分割：还要区分实例。对单个目标：CNN 接两个 FC 头——类别分数（如 4096 → 1000，交叉熵损失）和框坐标（4096 → 4，L2 回归损失），联合训练。

INTERSECTION OVER UNION交并比
IoU=area(Bpred​∪Bgt​)area(Bpred​∩Bgt​)​
Example: boxes [0,4]×[0,4] and [2,6]×[2,6]: intersection 2×2 = 4, union 16 + 16 − 4 = 28 ⇒ IoU = 0.14.例：框 [0,4]×[0,4] 与 [2,6]×[2,6]：交集 2×2 = 4，并集 16 + 16 − 4 = 28 ⇒ IoU = 0.14。

Datasets: PASCAL VOC (20 classes: person; animals; vehicles; indoor objects), MS COCO. The difficulty: an unknown, variable number of objects ⇒ variable number of outputs. Naive fix: apply a CNN to many crops (locations, scales, aspect ratios) and classify each as object/background — far too expensive.数据集：PASCAL VOC（20 类：人；动物；交通工具；室内物品）、MS COCO。难点：目标数量未知且可变 ⇒ 输出数量可变。朴素做法：对大量裁剪块（位置、尺度、长宽比）用 CNN 分类为目标/背景——代价太高。

12.2 Two-stage (proposal-based) detectors12.2 两阶段（基于候选框）检测器

SELECTIVE SEARCH (region proposals)选择性搜索（候选区域）
Propose ~2000 regions likely to contain objects (a few seconds on CPU) by bottom-up hierarchical grouping: (1) over-segment into superpixels (Felzenszwalb–Huttenlocher graph-based); (2) compute similarity of adjacent regions (colour, texture, size, fill); (3) merge the most similar pair; (4) add every region's bounding box to the proposals; (5) repeat until one region ⇒ proposals at all scales. Diversified strategies. It is a fixed algorithm — no learning.通过自底向上的层次合并提出约 2000 个可能含目标的区域（CPU 上几秒）：(1) 过分割为超像素（Felzenszwalb–Huttenlocher 图方法）；(2) 计算相邻区域相似度（颜色、纹理、大小、填充度）；(3) 合并最相似的一对；(4) 把每个形成区域的外接框加入候选；(5) 重复直到只剩一个区域 ⇒ 各尺度的候选框。策略多样化。它是固定算法——没有学习。
Model模型How it works工作方式Problem left遗留问题
R-CNN (2014)~2k selective-search RoIs → warp each to a fixed size → CNN features for each → linear SVMs classify + box regression约 2k 个选择性搜索 RoI → 每个变形到固定尺寸 → 对每个提 CNN 特征 → 线性 SVM 分类 + 框回归very slow: multi-stage training (fine-tune CNN, SVMs, regressors); features written to disk (hundreds of GB); VGG-16: 2.5 GPU-days for 5k images; ~2000 forward passes, 47 s per test image极慢：多阶段训练（微调 CNN、SVM、回归器）；特征写盘（数百 GB）；VGG-16 训练 5k 张图需 2.5 GPU 天；约 2000 次前向，每张测试图 47 秒
SPP-NetCNN needs fixed size only because of FC layers ⇒ spatial pyramid pooling pools features of any region to a common size; no warping; faster at test timeCNN 需要固定尺寸只因 FC 层 ⇒ 空间金字塔池化把任意区域特征池化到统一尺寸；无需变形；测试更快training still slow, multi-stage, not end-to-end (SVMs, post-hoc box regression)训练仍慢、多阶段、非端到端（SVM、事后框回归）
Fast R-CNN (2015)pass the whole image once through the CNN; crop RoIs from the feature map; RoI pooling to fixed size; FC layers replace SVMs/regressors; multi-task loss; end-to-end; no disk cache; higher mAP整幅图只过一次 CNN；在特征图上裁 RoI；RoI 池化到固定尺寸；用 FC 层代替 SVM/回归器；多任务损失；端到端；不写盘；mAP 更高test time now dominated by computing region proposals (selective search)测试时间主要花在计算候选区域（选择性搜索）上
Faster R-CNN (2015)Region Proposal Network predicts proposals from the same conv features; jointly trained with 4 losses区域候选网络从同一卷积特征预测候选框；用 4 个损失联合训练"real-time"-ish; still two stages接近“实时”；仍是两阶段
RPN, ANCHORS, NMS, OHEMRPN、锚框、NMS、OHEM
  • Anchors: predefined boxes of chosen sizes/aspect ratios (from training-set object sizes), typically 3 scales × 3 ratios = k = 9 per feature-map position.锚框：预设尺寸/长宽比的框（依据训练集目标尺寸选择），通常 3 尺度 × 3 比例 = 每个特征图位置 k = 9 个。
  • RPN: slide a small window over the feature map; for each anchor output an objectness score (cls layer: 2k scores) and a box transform from anchor to proposal (reg layer: 4k outputs).RPN：在特征图上滑动小窗口；对每个锚框输出目标性分数（cls 层：2k 个分数）和从锚框到候选框的框变换（reg 层：4k 个输出）。
  • Four losses: RPN classification (object / not), RPN regression (anchor → proposal), object classification (background or class), object regression (proposal → final box).四个损失：RPN 分类（是否目标）、RPN 回归（锚框 → 候选框）、目标分类（背景或某类）、目标回归（候选框 → 最终框）。
  • e.g. an 11×15 feature map × 9 anchors = 1485 heavily overlapping proposals ⇒ Non-Maximum Suppression: take the most probable box, remove others with IoU > threshold (0.7) with it, repeat with the remaining boxes.例如 11×15 的特征图 × 9 个锚框 = 1485 个高度重叠的候选 ⇒ 非极大值抑制：取概率最高的框，删去与它 IoU > 阈值（0.7）的其他框，在剩余框上重复。
  • Class imbalance: overwhelmingly many easy background examples. OHEM (online hard example mining) samples examples non-uniformly by current loss; keep negatives:positives ≤ 3:1 for Fast R-CNN; Faster R-CNN uses 256 anchors per mini-batch, 128 positive + 128 negative (pad with negatives).类别不平衡：简单背景样本极多。OHEM（在线难例挖掘）按当前损失非均匀采样；Fast R-CNN 中负:正 ≤ 3:1；Faster R-CNN 每个小批量 256 个锚框，128 正 + 128 负（正样本不足用负样本补）。

Later: RoI Align (Mask R-CNN) fixes the slight misalignment of RoI pooling (quantisation) — important for pixel-level masks.后来：RoI Align（Mask R-CNN）修正了 RoI 池化（量化）造成的轻微错位——对像素级掩码很重要。

12.3 One-stage (proposal-free) detectors12.3 单阶段（无候选框）检测器

  • Two-stage (R-CNN family, R-FCN, Mask R-CNN): (1) propose RoIs (selective search or RPN), (2) classify them. One-stage (SSD, YOLO, RetinaNet): a single network predicts boxes and classes directly.两阶段（R-CNN 系列、R-FCN、Mask R-CNN）：(1) 提出 RoI（选择性搜索或 RPN），(2) 分类。单阶段（SSD、YOLO、RetinaNet）：单个网络直接预测框和类别。
  • SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector): removes proposals and resampling; pretrained backbone + SSD head; small convolutional predictors for categories and box offsets (instead of FC); separate filters per aspect ratio; predictions from multiple feature maps ⇒ multiple scales. Findings: data augmentation is crucial; more default-box shapes and multi-resolution outputs are better.SSD（单次多框检测器）：去掉候选与重采样；预训练主干 + SSD 头；用小的卷积预测器输出类别和框偏移（而非 FC）；不同长宽比用不同滤波器；在多个特征图上预测 ⇒ 多尺度。结论：数据增强至关重要；更多默认框形状、多分辨率输出更好。
  • YOLO (You Only Look Once): detection as a single regression problem from pixels to box coordinates and class probabilities; one network on the full image; divide into an S×S grid; each cell predicts B boxes (4 coordinates + 1 objectness each) and C class probabilities ⇒ output S×S×(5B+C) = 7×7×30 for S = 7, B = 2, C = 20 (VOC). Looks at the image once ⇒ ~1000× faster than R-CNN, 100× faster than Fast R-CNN.YOLO（你只看一次）：把检测当作从像素到框坐标与类别概率的单一回归问题；整图过一个网络；分成 S×S 网格；每格预测 B 个框（每个 4 个坐标 + 1 个目标性）和 C 个类别概率 ⇒ 输出 S×S×(5B+C)，S = 7、B = 2、C = 20（VOC）时为 7×7×30。只看一次 ⇒ 比 R-CNN 快约 1000 倍、比 Fast R-CNN 快 100 倍。
WHY ONE-STAGE TRAILED IN ACCURACY → FPN + FOCAL LOSS = RetinaNet单阶段为何精度落后 → FPN + Focal Loss = RetinaNet
Two-stage: proposals cut candidates to ~2k, and sampling fixes the fg:bg ratio (1:3) or uses OHEM. One-stage must process ~100k densely sampled locations ⇒ extreme foreground–background class imbalance. Feature Pyramid Network (FPN): deeper layers have higher semantic value but lower resolution; a top-down pathway + lateral connections combine low-resolution, semantically strong features with high-resolution, semantically weak ones ⇒ rich semantics at all levels (good for small objects). RetinaNet = FPN backbone + class subnetwork + box subnetwork + focal loss (down-weights easy examples to handle the imbalance). 两阶段：候选把目标位置减到约 2k，并通过采样固定前景:背景比例（1:3）或用 OHEM。单阶段要处理约 10 万个密集采样位置 ⇒ 极端的前景–背景类别不平衡。特征金字塔网络（FPN）：深层语义强但分辨率低；通过自顶向下通路 + 横向连接把低分辨率强语义特征与高分辨率弱语义特征结合 ⇒ 各层都有丰富语义（利于小目标）。RetinaNet = FPN 主干 + 分类子网 + 框回归子网 + focal loss（降低简单样本权重以应对不平衡）。

Practice — Section 12练习 — 第 12 节

Boxes [0,4]×[0,4] and [2,6]×[2,6]. IoU?框 [0,4]×[0,4] 与 [2,6]×[2,6]。IoU？

  1. 0.14
  2. 0.25
  3. 0.5
  4. 0.33
4/28 = 0.143.

What was the main bottleneck that Faster R-CNN removed from Fast R-CNN?Faster R-CNN 消除了 Fast R-CNN 的哪个主要瓶颈？

  1. Warping each proposal对每个候选框变形
  2. Storing features on disk把特征存盘
  3. Computing region proposals with selective search用选择性搜索计算候选区域
  4. Using SVM classifiers使用 SVM 分类器
The RPN shares conv features to predict proposals. (A, B, D were fixed earlier by SPP-Net/Fast R-CNN.)RPN 共享卷积特征来预测候选框。（A、B、D 早已由 SPP-Net/Fast R-CNN 解决。）

In Fast R-CNN, RoI pooling is needed because…Fast R-CNN 中为什么需要 RoI 池化？

  1. proposals must be warped before the CNN候选框必须在 CNN 前变形
  2. FC layers need fixed-size inputs, but RoIs on the feature map have variable sizesFC 层需要固定尺寸输入，而特征图上的 RoI 大小不一
  3. it replaces the region proposal method它替代候选区域方法
  4. it performs non-maximum suppression它执行非极大值抑制
Conv layers accept any size; FC layers don't.卷积层接受任意尺寸；FC 层不行。

A YOLO-style detector uses a 7×7 grid, B = 3 boxes per cell and C = 80 classes. Output tensor?YOLO 式检测器用 7×7 网格、每格 B = 3 个框、C = 80 类。输出张量？

  1. 7×7×83
  2. 7×7×30
  3. 7×7×240
  4. 7×7×95
5B + C = 15 + 80 = 95.

Non-maximum suppression…非极大值抑制……

  1. keeps the highest-scoring box and removes boxes overlapping it by IoU above a threshold, then repeats保留得分最高的框，删除与之 IoU 超过阈值的框，然后重复
  2. removes boxes with low IoU with the ground truth during training训练中删除与真值 IoU 低的框
  3. suppresses background pixels in segmentation抑制分割中的背景像素
  4. is the same as max pooling等同于最大池化
Reduces redundant overlapping proposals/detections.减少冗余的重叠候选/检测。

Why did one-stage detectors initially trail two-stage ones in accuracy?单阶段检测器最初为何精度不如两阶段？

  1. They use no CNN不使用 CNN
  2. They cannot predict boxes不能预测框
  3. They evaluate ~100k dense locations, causing extreme foreground–background imbalance dominated by easy negatives要评估约 10 万个密集位置，导致由简单负样本主导的极端前景–背景不平衡
  4. They require selective search需要选择性搜索
RetinaNet's focal loss addresses this.RetinaNet 的 focal loss 解决此问题。

The Feature Pyramid Network improves detection mainly by…FPN 主要通过什么改进检测？

  1. removing all pooling layers去掉所有池化层
  2. combining high-resolution, semantically weak features with low-resolution, semantically strong ones via a top-down pathway and lateral connections通过自顶向下通路与横向连接，把高分辨率弱语义特征与低分辨率强语义特征结合
  3. using selective search at multiple scales在多尺度上用选择性搜索
  4. increasing the number of classes增加类别数
Rich semantics at all pyramid levels — good for small objects.金字塔各层都有丰富语义——利于小目标。

Which statement about R-CNN is incorrect?关于 R-CNN，哪项错误？

  1. It uses about 2000 selective-search proposals per image.每张图使用约 2000 个选择性搜索候选框。
  2. It warps each proposal to a fixed size before the CNN.在 CNN 前把每个候选框变形到固定尺寸。
  3. It classifies proposals with linear SVMs.用线性 SVM 对候选框分类。
  4. It is trained end-to-end with a single multi-task loss.用单一多任务损失端到端训练。
End-to-end multi-task training came with Fast R-CNN.端到端多任务训练始于 Fast R-CNN。

With k anchors per position, the RPN's classification and regression layers output…每个位置 k 个锚框时，RPN 的分类层和回归层分别输出……

  1. 2k objectness scores and 4k box coordinates2k 个目标性分数和 4k 个框坐标
  2. k scores and k coordinatesk 个分数和 k 个坐标
  3. C·k class scores and 4 coordinatesC·k 个类别分数和 4 个坐标
  4. 4k scores and 2k coordinates4k 个分数和 2k 个坐标
Object / not-object for each anchor; (Δx, Δy, Δw, Δh) for each anchor.每个锚框“是/否目标”；每个锚框 (Δx, Δy, Δw, Δh)。

13Deep learning II: semantic & instance segmentation, vision + language foundation models深度学习 II：语义与实例分割、视觉 + 语言基础模型

Slides: W8 Deep Learning Part 2-2对应讲义：W8 Deep Learning Part 2-2

🎯 Explain why patch-wise classification is inefficient; describe FCNs with down- and up-sampling; compute unpooling/max-unpooling and explain transposed convolution; describe U-Net and its variants; describe Mask R-CNN and RoI Align; explain foundation models, contrastive pre-training (CLIP, zero-shot) and VLMs (LLaVA).🎯 解释为何逐块分类低效；描述带下/上采样的 FCN；计算反池化/最大反池化并解释转置卷积；描述 U-Net 及变体；描述 Mask R-CNN 与 RoI Align；解释基础模型、对比预训练（CLIP、零样本）与视觉语言模型（LLaVA）。

13.1 Semantic segmentation13.1 语义分割

Classify every pixel; trained with an annotated (ground-truth) mask per image. Sliding window: classifying single pixels has no context ⇒ extract a patch around each pixel and classify its centre with a CNN — works but very inefficient (no reuse of shared features between overlapping patches).对每个像素分类；用每幅图的标注（真值）掩码训练。滑动窗口：单独分类像素没有上下文 ⇒ 取每个像素周围的图像块用 CNN 分类其中心——可行但非常低效（重叠块之间的共享特征没有复用）。

Fully Convolutional Network (FCN) (Long et al. 2015): only convolutional layers, output H×W class scores (argmax per pixel). Convolutions at full resolution throughout are very expensive ⇒ downsample (pooling, strided conv) then upsample (unpooling, strided transpose conv) inside the network, learned end-to-end — gradually rather than one sudden blow-up.全卷积网络（FCN）（Long 等 2015）：只有卷积层，输出 H×W 的类别分数（逐像素 argmax）。全程在原分辨率卷积代价太高 ⇒ 在网络内部先下采样（池化、带步长卷积）再上采样（反池化、带步长转置卷积），端到端学习——逐步上采样而非一次性放大。

Transposed convolution (learnable upsampling): each input value gives the weight for a copy of the filter placed in the output; with stride 2 the filter moves 2 output pixels for every 1 input pixel; overlapping contributions are summed. (Regular strided conv: the filter moves s input pixels per output pixel — transpose conv swaps the roles.)转置卷积（可学习的上采样）：每个输入值作为放在输出中的一份滤波器副本的权重；步长 2 时输入每移动 1 个像素，滤波器在输出中移动 2 个像素；重叠部分求和。（普通带步长卷积：每个输出像素对应滤波器在输入中移动 s 个像素——转置卷积交换了二者的角色。）

U-Net (Ronneberger et al. 2015, biomedical)U-Net（Ronneberger 等 2015，生物医学）
Encoder–decoder (contracting path + expanding path with up-convolutions) plus skip connections that feed encoder feature maps directly into the decoder at the same resolution (concatenated) ⇒ precise localisation + context; trained end-to-end. Variants: Attention U-Net (attention-gated skip connections), ResUNet (residual blocks), TransUNet (Transformer encoder).编码器–解码器（收缩路径 + 用上卷积的扩张路径）加上跳跃连接，把编码器的特征图直接送入同分辨率的解码器（拼接）⇒ 精确定位 + 上下文；端到端训练。变体：Attention U-Net（注意力门控跳跃连接）、ResUNet（残差块）、TransUNet（Transformer 编码器）。

13.2 Instance segmentation: Mask R-CNN (He et al. 2017)13.2 实例分割：Mask R-CNN（He 等 2017）

  • Extension of Faster R-CNN: detect and delineate each object at pixel level by adding a binary mask branch (small FCN) per RoI, parallel to classification and box regression.Faster R-CNN 的扩展：为每个 RoI 增加一个二值掩码分支（小型 FCN），与分类、框回归并行，从而在像素级检测并勾画每个目标。
  • RoI Align replaces RoI Pooling: RoI pooling's quantisation misaligns region features — negligible for boxes but a problem for pixel masks; RoI Align uses bilinear interpolation without rounding.用 RoI Align 替代 RoI 池化：RoI 池化的量化会使区域特征错位——对框影响不大，但对像素掩码是问题；RoI Align 用双线性插值、不取整。
  • Backbone: ResNet / ResNeXt (50, 101) + FPN; head: Faster R-CNN head + mask branch. Multi-task loss per sampled RoI: L=Lcls​+Lbox​+Lmask​.主干：ResNet / ResNeXt（50、101 层）+ FPN；头部：Faster R-CNN 头 + 掩码分支。每个采样 RoI 的多任务损失：L=Lcls​+Lbox​+Lmask​。

13.3 Foundation models: CLIP and LLaVA13.3 基础模型：CLIP 与 LLaVA

Foundation model: pre-train one model (many parameters, lots of data, usually a self-supervised objective) that serves as the foundation for many tasks; adapt by slight fine-tuning on a small downstream dataset ⇒ better generalisation. Language: BERT, T5, GPT; image embeddings: CLIP, CoCa; vision + language: LLaVA, GPT, Gemini, Qwen; also Segment Anything (SAM), Stable Diffusion, Flux.基础模型：预训练一个模型（参数多、数据多、通常是自监督目标）作为众多任务的基础；在小的下游数据上轻微微调即可适配 ⇒ 泛化更好。语言：BERT、T5、GPT；图像嵌入：CLIP、CoCa；视觉 + 语言：LLaVA、GPT、Gemini、Qwen；还有 Segment Anything（SAM）、Stable Diffusion、Flux。

CLIP (Contrastive Language–Image Pre-training)CLIP（对比式语言–图像预训练）
Contrastive self-supervised learning: pull matching concepts together, push different ones apart. ~400M image–text pairs; image encoder + text encoder map into a shared embedding space; for a batch, compute all image–text similarities and minimise a symmetric (two-way) InfoNCE loss that maximises similarities on the diagonal (matched pairs). Instead of predicting the exact caption words, it only has to match the right description. After training: zero-shot classification (embed prompts "a photo of a {class}" and pick the most similar), or transfer the encoder with a linear classifier to classification, detection, segmentation. 对比式自监督学习：把匹配的概念拉近、不同的推远。约 4 亿图文对；图像编码器 + 文本编码器映射到共享嵌入空间；对一个批次计算所有图文相似度，最小化对称（双向）InfoNCE 损失，使对角线（匹配对）上的相似度最大。它不需要逐词预测描述，只需匹配正确的描述。训练后：零样本分类（嵌入提示词 “a photo of a {class}”，选最相似的），或把编码器接线性分类器迁移到分类、检测、分割。

LLaVA (Large Language and Vision Assistant): LLMs do autoregressive next-token prediction and can do many tasks at inference; a VLM takes images + text (questions/instructions) and outputs text. How? Convert the image into visual tokens (e.g. from a CLIP vision encoder + projection) and insert them into the LLM's input sequence; train with visual instruction tuning.LLaVA（大型语言与视觉助手）：LLM 做自回归下一词预测，推理时可完成多种任务；VLM 接收图像 + 文本（问题/指令）输出文本。怎么做？把图像转成视觉词元（如 CLIP 视觉编码器 + 投影），插入 LLM 的输入序列；用视觉指令微调训练。

Practice — Section 13练习 — 第 13 节

(Sample exam) Which network is most suited for image segmentation?（样题）哪种网络最适合图像分割？

  1. Multilayer perceptron (MLP)多层感知机（MLP）
  2. Fully convolutional network (FCN)全卷积网络（FCN）
  3. Region proposal network (RPN)区域候选网络（RPN）
  4. Recurrent neural network (RNN)循环神经网络（RNN）
FCNs output a dense per-pixel prediction map of the input's size.FCN 输出与输入同尺寸的稠密逐像素预测图。

Why is sliding-window patch classification a poor way to do semantic segmentation?为什么滑动窗口逐块分类不适合语义分割？

  1. It cannot use context无法利用上下文
  2. It needs bounding boxes需要边界框
  3. It is very inefficient: features of overlapping patches are recomputed instead of shared非常低效：重叠块的特征被重复计算而非共享
  4. It cannot be trained with cross-entropy不能用交叉熵训练
Patches do add context (vs single pixels) — the issue is efficiency.图像块确实带来了上下文（相对单像素）——问题在于效率。

What distinguishes U-Net from a plain encoder–decoder FCN?U-Net 与普通编码器–解码器 FCN 的区别是？

  1. Skip connections that pass encoder feature maps to the decoder at the same resolution把编码器特征图传到同分辨率解码器的跳跃连接
  2. It has no downsampling没有下采样
  3. It uses fully connected layers for the output输出用全连接层
  4. It predicts bounding boxes预测边界框
Fine spatial detail lost by downsampling is recovered from the skips.下采样丢失的空间细节通过跳跃连接找回。

Why does Mask R-CNN use RoI Align instead of RoI Pooling?为什么 Mask R-CNN 用 RoI Align 代替 RoI 池化？

  1. It is faster更快
  2. It produces more proposals产生更多候选框
  3. It removes the need for an FPN不再需要 FPN
  4. RoI Pooling's quantisation slightly misaligns features — fine for boxes but harmful for pixel-accurate masksRoI 池化的量化会让特征轻微错位——对框无妨，但对像素级掩码有害
RoI Align uses bilinear interpolation without rounding.RoI Align 用双线性插值、不取整。

Which upsampling method has learnable parameters?哪种上采样方法有可学习参数？

  1. Nearest-neighbour unpooling最近邻反池化
  2. Transposed convolution转置卷积
  3. Max unpooling最大反池化
  4. Bed-of-nails unpooling钉床反池化
Its kernel is learned; overlapping outputs are summed.其卷积核可学习；输出重叠处求和。

CLIP is trained by…CLIP 如何训练？

  1. predicting the exact caption words from the image从图像逐词预测描述
  2. supervised ImageNet classificationImageNet 监督分类
  3. a symmetric contrastive (InfoNCE) loss that maximises similarity of matched image–text pairs and minimises it for mismatched pairs对称对比（InfoNCE）损失：最大化匹配图文对的相似度、最小化不匹配对的相似度
  4. reconstructing masked pixels重建被遮像素
Enables zero-shot classification via text prompts.可通过文本提示实现零样本分类。

Mask R-CNN's training loss per RoI is…Mask R-CNN 每个 RoI 的训练损失为……

  1. Lcls​+Lbox​+Lmask​
  2. Lmask​ only仅
  3. focal lossfocal loss
  4. InfoNCEInfoNCE
Multi-task: classification + box regression + mask.多任务：分类 + 框回归 + 掩码。

How does LLaVA let a language model "see"?LLaVA 如何让语言模型“看见”？

  1. By converting images to captions with OCR用 OCR 把图像转成描述
  2. By training an LLM from scratch on pixels在像素上从头训练 LLM
  3. By using selective search使用选择性搜索
  4. By encoding the image into visual tokens and inserting them into the LLM's input sequence把图像编码为视觉词元并插入 LLM 的输入序列
Then visual instruction tuning.再做视觉指令微调。

14Motion estimation: change detection, sparse (template matching), dense (optical flow)运动估计：变化检测、稀疏（模板匹配）、稠密（光流）

Slides: W9 Part 1 Motion Estimation对应讲义：W9 Part 1 Motion Estimation

🎯 Run the image-subtraction algorithm; detect interest points and match templates with CC/SAD/SSD/MI (know which to maximise/minimise); derive the optical-flow constraint and explain the aperture problem; solve Lucas–Kanade by least squares.🎯 执行图像相减算法；检测兴趣点并用 CC/SAD/SSD/MI 做模板匹配（知道哪个最大化、哪个最小化）；推导光流约束方程并解释孔径问题；用最小二乘求解 Lucas–Kanade。

Adding time: 3D = 2D + t. Changes in an image sequence let us detect moving objects, compute trajectories, analyse motion, recognise objects by behaviour, compute viewer motion, recognise activities. Applications: gait recognition, surveillance, video indexing, HCI (gesture, gaze), traffic monitoring, vehicle navigation. Scenarios: still camera with constant background (single/multiple moving objects) or moving camera with relatively constant scene (coherent motion).加入时间：3D = 2D + t。图像序列中的变化可用于检测运动目标、计算轨迹、分析运动、按行为识别目标、计算观察者自身运动、识别活动。应用：步态识别、监控、视频索引、人机交互（手势、视线）、交通监测、车辆导航。场景：固定相机 + 恒定背景（单/多个运动目标），或移动相机 + 相对恒定场景（一致运动）。

14.1 Change detection by image subtraction14.1 图像相减的变化检测

An object moving over a constant background: its front and rear edges move a few pixels per frame ⇒ subtracting It−Δt​ (or a static background/model image) from It​ reveals changes.在恒定背景上移动的目标：其前后边缘每帧移动几个像素 ⇒ 用 It​ 减去 It−Δt​（或静态背景/模型图像）即可揭示变化。

ALGORITHM算法
  1. Iout​(x,y)=1 if若 ∣It​(x,y)−It−Δt​(x,y)∣>τ, else 0否则为 0
  2. Connected components extraction on Iout​.对 Iout​ 提取连通域。
  3. Remove small regions (noise).去除小区域（噪声）。
  4. Closing with a small disk to fuse neighbouring regions.用小圆盘做闭运算以融合相邻区域。
  5. Bounding boxes of remaining regions; return Iout​ and the boxes.求剩余区域的外接框；返回 Iout​ 与框。

14.2 Sparse motion estimation (template matching)14.2 稀疏运动估计（模板匹配）

A motion field is an array of 2D motion vectors (displacement of a 3D point's image from t to t + Δt; instantaneous velocity). Zoom out/in and panning give characteristic fields. Sparse: (1) detect interesting points at t; (2) find corresponding points at t + Δt. Assumption: intensities of interesting points and their neighbours stay nearly constant.运动场是二维运动向量的阵列（三维点的像从 t 到 t + Δt 的位移；瞬时速度）。缩小/放大与平移会产生特征性的运动场。稀疏：(1) 在 t 时刻检测兴趣点；(2) 在 t + Δt 找对应点。假设：兴趣点及其邻域的强度几乎不变。

  • Interest points: Canny edges, Hessian ridges, Harris corners, SIFT, CNN features, or an interest operator: intensity variance along horizontal, vertical and both diagonals in a window; interest point if the minimum of the four variances exceeds a threshold.兴趣点：Canny 边缘、Hessian 脊、Harris 角点、SIFT、CNN 特征，或兴趣算子：在窗口内沿水平、竖直和两条对角线方向计算强度方差，四个方差的最小值超过阈值即为兴趣点。
  • Template matching: take the neighbourhood T of point Pi​ in It​ and find the best-matching neighbourhood N in It+Δt​ within a limited search region R ⇒ motion vector.模板匹配：取 It​ 中点 Pi​ 的邻域 T 作为模板，在 It+Δt​ 的有限搜索区域 R 内找最匹配的邻域 N ⇒ 运动向量。
SIMILARITY MEASURES相似性度量
CC=T∑​It​(x,y)It+Δt​(x+Δx,y+Δy)  ↑SAD=T∑​∣It​−It+Δt​∣  ↓​
SSD=T∑​(It​−It+Δt​)2  ↓MI(A,B)=a∑​b∑​PAB​(a,b)log2​PA​(a)PB​(b)PAB​(a,b)​  ↑​
↑ = maximise, ↓ = minimise. Mutual information uses intensity probabilities and joint probabilities — robust when intensities are related but not equal (e.g. multimodal registration CT ↔ MRI).↑ = 最大化，↓ = 最小化。互信息使用强度概率与联合概率——当强度相关但不相等时（如多模态配准 CT ↔ MRI）很鲁棒。

14.3 Dense motion estimation: optical flow14.3 稠密运动估计：光流

Assumptions over Δt: light sources unchanged, object distance unchanged, appearance unchanged ⇒ any small neighbourhood just shifts: Nt​(x,y)=Nt+Δt​(x+Δx,y+Δy) (brightness constancy). Not exactly true, but useful.在 Δt 内假设：光源不变、物距不变、外观不变 ⇒ 任意小邻域只是平移：Nt​(x,y)=Nt+Δt​(x+Δx,y+Δy)（亮度恒定）。并不严格成立，但很有用。

OPTICAL FLOW CONSTRAINT光流约束方程
Taylor: f(x+Δx,y+Δy,t+Δt)≈f+fx​Δx+fy​Δy+ft​Δt; with brightness constancy the extra terms sum to 0; divide by Δt:泰勒展开：f(x+Δx,y+Δy,t+Δt)≈f+fx​Δx+fy​Δy+ft​Δt；由亮度恒定，附加项之和为 0；除以 Δt：
fx​vx​+fy​vy​=−ft​⟺∇f⋅v=−ft​​
One equation per pixel but two unknowns (vx​,vy​) ⇒ no unique solution (only the flow component along the gradient is determined — the aperture problem) ⇒ extra constraints needed, e.g. a group of adjacent pixels has the same velocity.每个像素一个方程，却有两个未知数 (vx​,vy​) ⇒ 无唯一解（只能确定沿梯度方向的分量——孔径问题）⇒ 需要额外约束，如相邻像素具有相同速度。
LUCAS–KANADELucas–Kanade
Assume the equation holds for all n pixels pi​ in a neighbourhood:假设邻域内所有 n 个像素 pi​ 都满足该方程：
A=​fx​(p1​)⋮fx​(pn​)​fy​(p1​)⋮fy​(pn​)​​b=​−ft​(p1​)⋮−ft​(pn​)​​Av=b ⇒ v=(ATA)−1ATb​
Works when the neighbourhood has gradients in different directions (textured); fails in flat regions or along straight edges (ATA singular).当邻域内梯度方向多样（有纹理）时有效；在平坦区域或沿直边缘失败（ATA 奇异）。
MINI EXAMPLE小例题
Two pixels: p1​: fx​=1,fy​=0,ft​=−2; p2​: fx​=0,fy​=1,ft​=1. Equations vx​=2, vy​=−1 ⇒ v=(2,−1). With only p1​ we would know vx​=2 but not vy​ (aperture problem).两个像素：p1​：fx​=1,fy​=0,ft​=−2；p2​：fx​=0,fy​=1,ft​=1。方程 vx​=2、vy​=−1 ⇒ v=(2,−1)。只有 p1​ 时只能得到 vx​=2，无法确定 vy​（孔径问题）。

Practice — Section 14练习 — 第 14 节

(Sample exam) Which statement about motion analysis is incorrect?（样题）关于运动分析，哪项错误？

  1. Detecting moving objects by subtracting successive images works best if the background is constant.用相邻帧相减检测运动目标在背景恒定时效果最好。
  2. Sparse motion estimation can be done by template matching and minimising the mutual information measure.稀疏运动估计可通过模板匹配并最小化互信息来完成。
  3. Dense motion estimation using optical flow assumes each small neighbourhood remains constant over time.光流稠密运动估计假设每个小邻域随时间保持不变。
  4. Optical flow provides an equation for each pixel but requires further constraints to solve it uniquely.光流为每个像素提供一个方程，但需要额外约束才能唯一求解。
Mutual information (and cross-correlation) must be maximised; SAD/SSD are minimised.互信息（和互相关）应最大化；SAD/SSD 才是最小化。

Which similarity measure is best for matching templates between images of different modalities (CT vs MRI)?在不同模态（CT vs MRI）图像间匹配模板，哪种相似性度量最好？

  1. SSD
  2. SAD
  3. Cross-correlation互相关
  4. Mutual information互信息
MI only requires a statistical relation between intensities, not equality.互信息只要求强度间存在统计关系，而不要求相等。

The optical-flow constraint fx​vx​+fy​vy​=−ft​ follows from…光流约束 fx​vx​+fy​vy​=−ft​ 来自……

  1. brightness constancy plus a first-order Taylor expansion亮度恒定假设加一阶泰勒展开
  2. the Fourier shift theorem傅里叶平移定理
  3. Bayesian inference贝叶斯推断
  4. template matching with SSD基于 SSD 的模板匹配
Higher-order terms are dropped.忽略高阶项。

The interest operator declares a pixel interesting when…兴趣算子在什么情况下认为像素是兴趣点？

  1. the maximum of the four directional variances exceeds a threshold四个方向方差的最大值超过阈值
  2. its intensity is the brightest in the window其强度在窗口中最亮
  3. the minimum of the horizontal, vertical and two diagonal variances exceeds a threshold水平、竖直和两条对角线方差中的最小值超过阈值
  4. its gradient is zero梯度为零
Min ensures variation in all directions (corner-like), not just across an edge.取最小值确保在所有方向都有变化（类角点），而不仅仅是穿过边缘。

Why does Lucas–Kanade fail inside a uniform region?为什么 Lucas–Kanade 在均匀区域内失败？

  1. The temporal derivative is too large时间导数太大
  2. All spatial gradients are ≈ 0, so ATA is (near) singular and v is undetermined所有空间梯度 ≈ 0，ATA （近）奇异，v 无法确定
  3. It requires colour images需要彩色图像
  4. The neighbourhood is too small邻域太小
No texture ⇒ no information about motion.没有纹理 ⇒ 没有运动信息。

In the image-subtraction algorithm, why is a closing with a small disk applied?图像相减算法中为什么要用小圆盘做闭运算？

  1. To remove the background去除背景
  2. To compute bounding boxes计算外接框
  3. To remove large regions去除大区域
  4. To fuse neighbouring changed regions belonging to the same object融合属于同一物体的相邻变化区域
Small noisy regions are removed before that by size filtering.在此之前已按大小去除小的噪声区域。

15Object tracking: Bayesian inference, Kalman filter, particle filter — and biomedical applications目标跟踪：贝叶斯推断、卡尔曼滤波、粒子滤波——及生物医学应用

Slides: W9 Part 2 Object Tracking · Part 3 Biomedical Applications对应讲义：W9 Part 2 Object Tracking · Part 3 Biomedical Applications

🎯 State the tracking problem, challenges and motion assumptions; write the prediction and correction steps and the two independence assumptions (HMM); compute EAP/MAP estimates; know the Kalman filter's assumptions and equations; explain particle filtering; know the biomedical examples and MSD analysis.🎯 陈述跟踪问题、难点与运动假设；写出预测与校正步骤以及两个独立性假设（HMM）；计算 EAP/MAP 估计；掌握卡尔曼滤波的假设与公式；解释粒子滤波；了解生物医学例子与 MSD 分析。

Tracking = inferring the motion of an object from a time series of images. Applications: motion capture, recognition from motion, surveillance, targeting. Challenges: information loss (3D → 2D), noise, complex motion, non-rigid/articulated objects, partial/full occlusion, complex shapes, illumination changes, real-time requirements. When objects lack unique texture/colour, use motion assumptions: location changes smoothly; velocity changes smoothly; an object is in only one place at a time; two objects can't occupy the same place. Human perception integrates space-time well but isn't accurate/reproducible; computers need a probabilistic approach ⇒ Bayesian estimation.跟踪 = 从图像时间序列推断目标的运动。应用：动作捕捉、基于运动的识别、监控、目标瞄准。难点：信息丢失（3D → 2D）、噪声、复杂运动、非刚性/铰接目标、部分/完全遮挡、复杂形状、光照变化、实时要求。目标缺乏独特纹理/颜色时，利用运动假设：位置平滑变化；速度平滑变化；一个目标同一时刻只在一处；两个目标不能占据同一位置。人的感知善于整合时空但不精确、不可复现；计算机需要概率方法 ⇒ 贝叶斯估计。

15.1 Tracking as Bayesian inference15.1 把跟踪视为贝叶斯推断

State Xi​ (position, velocity, acceleration, shape, intensity, colour…) evolves over time; measurement Yi​ (image features) at each time. Three steps: prediction (from y0​..yi−1​ predict Xi​), association (select the measurements related to the object), correction (update with yi​).状态 Xi​（位置、速度、加速度、形状、强度、颜色…）随时间演化；每个时刻有测量 Yi​（图像特征）。三步：预测（由 y0​..yi−1​ 预测 Xi​）、关联（选出与目标相关的测量）、校正（用 yi​ 更新）。

INDEPENDENCE ASSUMPTIONS ⇒ HIDDEN MARKOV MODEL独立性假设 ⇒ 隐马尔可夫模型
(1) The current state depends only on the immediate past: P(Xi​∣X0​..Xi−1​,Y0​..Yi−1​)=P(Xi​∣Xi−1​). (2) Measurements depend only on the current state: P(Yi​∣X0​..Xi​,Y0​..Yi−1​)=P(Yi​∣Xi​).(1) 当前状态只依赖于前一时刻：P(Xi​∣X0​..Xi−1​,Y0​..Yi−1​)=P(Xi​∣Xi−1​)。(2) 测量只依赖于当前状态：P(Yi​∣X0​..Xi​,Y0​..Yi−1​)=P(Yi​∣Xi​)。
PREDICTION & CORRECTION预测与校正
Prediction:P(Xi​∣Y0:i−1​)=∫dynamics modelP(Xi​∣Xi−1​)​​ posterior at i−1P(Xi−1​∣Y0:i−1​)​​dXi−1​​
Correction:P(Xi​∣Y0:i​) ∝ measurement modelP(Yi​∣Xi​)​​ predictionP(Xi​∣Y0:i−1​)​​​
Two models must be designed (application dependent): the dynamics model P(Xi​∣Xi−1​) and the measurement model P(Yi​∣Xi​). Final estimates from the posterior: EAP (expected a posteriori) x^i​=∫xP(Xi​=x∣Y0:i​)dx (the mean); MAP x^i​=argmaxx​P(Xi​=x∣Y0:i​) (the mode).需要设计两个模型（取决于应用）：动力学模型 P(Xi​∣Xi−1​) 与测量模型 P(Yi​∣Xi​)。由后验得到最终估计：EAP（后验期望）x^i​=∫xP(Xi​=x∣Y0:i​)dx（均值）；MAP x^i​=argmaxx​P(Xi​=x∣Y0:i​)（众数）。
EAP vs MAP EXAMPLEEAP vs MAP 例子
Posterior over position: P(x=1) = 0.5, P(x=4) = 0.3, P(x=5) = 0.2. MAP = 1; EAP = 0.5 + 1.2 + 1.0 = 2.7 (which may fall where the object is unlikely to be — for multimodal posteriors the choice matters).位置后验：P(x=1) = 0.5，P(x=4) = 0.3，P(x=5) = 0.2。MAP = 1；EAP = 0.5 + 1.2 + 1.0 = 2.7（可能落在目标不太可能在的位置——多峰后验时选择很重要）。

15.2 Kalman filter (linear + Gaussian)15.2 卡尔曼滤波（线性 + 高斯）

If the dynamics and measurement models are linear and the noise is additive Gaussian, all densities stay Gaussian N(μ,Σ):若动力学与测量模型是线性的，且噪声为加性高斯，则所有密度都保持高斯 N(μ,Σ)：

xi​=Axi−1​+qi−1​,  q∼N(0,Q)yi​=Hxi​+ri​,  r∼N(0,R)​
KALMAN FILTER ALGORITHM卡尔曼滤波算法
Prediction:预测：
xi−​=Axi−1​Pi−​=APi−1​AT+Q​
Correction:校正：
Ki​=Pi−​HT(HPi−​HT+R)−1xi​=xi−​+Ki​(yi​−Hxi−​)Pi​=(I−Ki​H)Pi−​​
Kalman gain K: large when the prediction is uncertain (big P−) relative to measurement noise R ⇒ trust the measurement; small ⇒ trust the prediction.卡尔曼增益 K：预测不确定性（P− 大）相对测量噪声 R 较大时 K 大 ⇒ 更信测量；K 小 ⇒ 更信预测。
1-D EXAMPLE (A = H = 1)一维例子（A = H = 1）
xi−1​=10, Pi−1​=4, Q=1, R=5, measurement yi​=16. Predict: x−=10, P−=5. Gain K=5/(5+5)=0.5. Correct: x=10+0.5(16−10)=13, P=(1−0.5)⋅5=2.5.xi−1​=10, Pi−1​=4, Q=1, R=5，测量 yi​=16。预测：x−=10, P−=5。增益 K=5/(5+5)=0.5。校正：x=10+0.5(16−10)=13，P=(1−0.5)⋅5=2.5。

15.3 Particle filter (nonlinear, non-Gaussian)15.3 粒子滤波（非线性、非高斯）

Represent the conditional state density by a set of weighted samples (particles): P(Xi​∣Y0:i​)→{si(n)​,πi(n)​}n=1N​. Each step: resample according to the weights, propagate each sample with the dynamics model (+ noise), re-weight with the measurement model. No need for linear/Gaussian (parameterised) models. Also called sequential Monte Carlo, bootstrap filtering, CONDENSATION (Isard & Blake 1998: tracking active contours; pedestrians with state (x, y, w, h) in clutter).用一组带权样本（粒子）表示条件状态密度：P(Xi​∣Y0:i​)→{si(n)​,πi(n)​}n=1N​。每一步：按权重重采样，用动力学模型（+ 噪声）传播每个样本，再用测量模型重新加权。不要求线性/高斯（参数化）模型。也称序贯蒙特卡洛、自举滤波、CONDENSATION（Isard & Blake 1998：跟踪主动轮廓；在杂乱背景中跟踪状态为 (x, y, w, h) 的行人）。

15.4 Biomedical applications15.4 生物医学应用

  • Change detection: digital subtraction angiography (live − mask X-ray, contrast stretched), with automatic motion correction by local template matching.变化检测：数字减影血管造影（实时像 − 掩模 X 光，对比度拉伸），并用局部模板匹配做自动运动校正。
  • Template matching / registration: cell motion correction in microscopy; monomodal brain MRI registration to a template (development studies); multimodal CT–MRI registration (mutual information) for joint visualisation.模板匹配/配准：显微图像中的细胞运动校正；单模态脑 MRI 配准到模板（发育研究）；多模态 CT–MRI 配准（互信息）以联合显示。
  • Optical flow: heart tissue (cardiomyocyte) motion in phase-contrast microscopy at 24 fps — rich texture makes gradients accurate, so optical flow works well; vectors shown by colour (direction) and intensity (magnitude).光流：相差显微镜下 24 帧/秒的心肌组织（心肌细胞）运动——纹理丰富使梯度准确，光流效果好；用颜色（方向）和亮度（幅值）显示运动向量。
  • Tracking: single vs multiple object tracking (MOT); Bayesian framework with state Xt​=(r,v,a,s,I,…); MOT state space grows exponentially with the number of objects ⇒ use a mixture of single-object densities P(Xt​∣Yt​)=∑n​wn,t​Pn​(Xt​∣Yt​) with heuristics for object number/identity; microtubule tips; deep-learning tracking with RNNs as dynamics models; heart motion in MRI (strain); neuron reconstruction by tracking in space (Hessian eigenvalues λ₃ ≪ λ₂ ≈ λ₁ for tubular seeds); cell tracking (segmentation by thresholding, watershed, active contours, level sets, U-Net, SAM; linking by contour evolution); cell lineage reconstruction; embryogenesis.跟踪：单目标 vs 多目标跟踪（MOT）；贝叶斯框架，状态 Xt​=(r,v,a,s,I,…)；MOT 状态空间随目标数指数增长 ⇒ 用单目标密度的混合 P(Xt​∣Yt​)=∑n​wn,t​Pn​(Xt​∣Yt​)，并用启发式管理目标数/身份；微管末端跟踪；以 RNN 为动力学模型的深度学习跟踪；MRI 心脏运动（应变）；在空间中跟踪实现神经元重建（管状种子点：Hessian 特征值 λ₃ ≪ λ₂ ≈ λ₁）；细胞跟踪（用阈值、分水岭、主动轮廓、水平集、U-Net、SAM 分割；用轮廓演化关联）；细胞谱系重建；胚胎发育跟踪。
MEAN SQUARED DISPLACEMENT (trajectory analysis)均方位移（轨迹分析）
MSD(t)=N−t1​i=1∑N−t​d2(pi​,pi+t​)d(pi​,pj​)=∥pj​−pi​∥2​​
Normal diffusion: MSD=cDt (linear); directed + diffusion: cDt+(vt)2 (curves up); anomalous: cDtα; confined: levels off. c = 4 (2D), 6 (3D); D = diffusion coefficient; v = speed.正常扩散：MSD=cDt（线性）；定向 + 扩散：cDt+(vt)2（向上弯）；反常扩散：cDtα；受限：趋于平台。c = 4（二维）、6（三维）；D = 扩散系数；v = 速度。

Practice — Section 15练习 — 第 15 节

(Sample exam) Which statement about object tracking is incorrect?（样题）关于目标跟踪，哪项错误？

  1. Particle filtering assumes that the dynamics and measurement models can be parameterised.粒子滤波假设动力学和测量模型可以参数化。
  2. The hidden Markov model assumes measurements depend only on the current state.隐马尔可夫模型假设测量只依赖当前状态。
  3. The prediction step assumes the current state depends only on the previous state.预测步假设当前状态只依赖前一状态。
  4. Kalman filtering assumes additive Gaussian dynamics and measurement noise.卡尔曼滤波假设动力学与测量噪声为加性高斯。
Particle filters represent arbitrary (nonlinear, non-Gaussian) densities with samples — no parameterised model needed; that is the Kalman filter's restriction.粒子滤波用样本表示任意（非线性、非高斯）密度——不需要参数化模型；那是卡尔曼滤波的限制。

Kalman: predicted x−=20, P−=3, measurement noise R = 1, H = 1, measurement y = 24. Corrected state?卡尔曼：预测 x−=20，P−=3，测量噪声 R = 1，H = 1，测量 y = 24。校正后的状态？

  1. 20
  2. 22
  3. 23
  4. 24
K = 3/(3+1) = 0.75 ⇒ x = 20 + 0.75·4 = 23; P = 0.25·3 = 0.75.

In the correction step, the posterior is proportional to…校正步中，后验正比于……

  1. dynamics model × previous posterior动力学模型 × 前一后验
  2. measurement likelihood P(Yi​∣Xi​) × prediction P(Xi​∣Y0:i−1​)测量似然 P(Yi​∣Xi​) × 预测 P(Xi​∣Y0:i−1​)
  3. prior × evidence先验 × 证据
  4. Kalman gain × innovation卡尔曼增益 × 新息
(A) is the prediction integrand.（A）是预测步积分中的被积项。

Posterior: P(x=0) = 0.4, P(x=10) = 0.35, P(x=12) = 0.25. MAP and EAP?后验：P(x=0) = 0.4，P(x=10) = 0.35，P(x=12) = 0.25。MAP 与 EAP？

  1. MAP 10, EAP 6.5
  2. MAP 0, EAP 0
  3. MAP 12, EAP 6.5
  4. MAP 0, EAP 6.5
EAP = 0 + 3.5 + 3.0 = 6.5; MAP = argmax = 0.

Why is multiple-object tracking usually done with a mixture of single-object densities?为什么多目标跟踪通常用单目标密度的混合？

  1. Because Kalman filters cannot track one object因为卡尔曼滤波跟踪不了单个目标
  2. To make the problem linear为了让问题线性化
  3. The joint state space of all objects grows exponentially with the number of objects所有目标的联合状态空间随目标数指数增长
  4. Objects never interact目标之间从不交互
Heuristics then keep track of the number of objects and identities.再用启发式管理目标数量与身份。

An MSD curve that bends upward (super-linear) indicates…向上弯曲（超线性）的 MSD 曲线表示……

  1. directed motion plus diffusion, cDt+(vt)2定向运动加扩散，cDt+(vt)2
  2. normal diffusion正常扩散
  3. confined motion受限运动
  4. no motion不动
Confined motion levels off; normal diffusion is linear in t.受限运动趋于平台；正常扩散对 t 线性。

Why does optical flow work well on beating cardiomyocyte cultures?为什么光流在跳动的心肌细胞培养上效果好？

  1. The images have no texture图像没有纹理
  2. Rich image texture allows accurate local gradients, and frame rate (24 fps) keeps motion small丰富的纹理使局部梯度准确，且帧率（24 fps）使运动较小
  3. The cells don't move细胞不动
  4. It uses mutual information它使用互信息
Both brightness-constancy and small-motion assumptions are met.亮度恒定和小运动两个假设都满足。

a* is green–red (not blue) · log expands low (not high) intensities · high-pass enhances (not smooths) details · SIFT rotation invariance via orientation (not scales) · RF: stronger trees help, correlated trees hurt · kNN needs homogeneous scales; SVM is bad with overlap · level sets handle topology easily · MI is maximised · particle filters do not need parameterised models · FFT uses wrapping · convolution is distributive, a(f∗g)=(af)∗(ag). a* 是绿–红（不是蓝）· 对数扩展低强度（不是高）· 高通增强（不是平滑）细节 · SIFT 旋转不变靠方向分配（不是多尺度）· 随机森林：树更强有益、树相关有害 · kNN 需要同质尺度；SVM 在类重叠时表现差 · 水平集容易处理拓扑 · 互信息要最大化 · 粒子滤波不需要参数化模型 · FFT 用环绕 · 卷积满足分配律，a(f∗g)=(af)∗(ag)。
